label: ADNAN MAZAREI
summary: ADNAN MAZAREI | HUMANIST RESURGENCE OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE. HE HAS REPLACED THE NOW-DISCREDITED WORD, "RESURGENCE" (RASTAKHIZ) IN THE TITLE. THAT EFFORT QUICKLY ABORTED ONCE THE SHAH.S DISPLEASURE BECAME EVIDENT. IN PRACTICAL TERMS,THE GROUP IS APPARENTLY A MODERATE, PRO-WEST, REFORMIST PARTY. HE SAYS HE IS IN CONTACT WITH THE DERAKHSHESH GROUP, AND THAT EITHER WILL HELP THE OTHER IF ONE OF THEM APPEARS CLOSE TO SUCCESS. THE NATIONAL FRONT, HOWEVER, IS MERELY "A GROUP OF OLD MEN LIVING ON THE MEMORY OF MOSSADEGH." THEY LACK AN IDEOLOGY AND CANNOT THEREFORE INSPIRE THE PUBLIC. MAZAREI CLAIMS ABOUT 150 HARD-CORE MEMBERS, MOSTLY ACADEMICS AND LAWYERS, PLUS A THOUSAND OR SO SYMPATHIZERS. | GROUP ALLEGEDLY HAS CHAPTERS IN SEVERAL CITIES BESIDES TEHRAN. MAZAREI PLANS TO HOLD WEEKLY MEETINGS AND TO START A NEWSPAPER. HIS AMBITION IS TO ONE DAY HEAD A MAJOR POLITICAL PARTY. | REGARDING THE PRESENT POLITICAL SITUATION, MAZAREI ECHOED THE VIEWS OF MANY OTHER CONTACTS IN ARGUING THAT KHOMEINI IS IN COMMAND BECAUSE OF WIDESPREAD RESENTMENT OF THE SHAH. IF THE SHAH WERE GONE, DIVISIONS WOULD INSTANTLY APPEAR, AND RAMA, NATIONAL FRONT, AND OTHERS WOULD DECLARE INDEPENDENCE FROM KHOMEINI. NONE CAN DO SO NOW, HOWEVER, FOR ANYONE WHO OPPOSES KHOMEINI APPEARS TO SUPPORT THE SHAH, AND POPULAR SENTIMENT TURNS AGAINST HIM. HE THEREFORE STRONGLY URGED THAT THE SHAH LEAVE THE COUNTRY, EVEN IF UNDER CONDITIONS WHICH WOULD PERMIT A POSSIBLE RETURN. NO SETTLEMENT CAN COME AS LONG AS THE SHAH REMAINS. | MAZAREI IS IN NO HURRY FOR ELECTIONS, BECAUSE IF HELD NOW THEY WOULD BRING VICTORY TO RELIGIOUS FUNDAMENTALISTS. | MAZAREI WAS MADE TO UNDERSTAND THAT WHILE WE ARE INTERESTED IN DISCUSSING THESE ISSUES WITH PERSONS ACTIVE POLITICALLY, WE COULD NOT SUPPORT (IN THE OLD-FASHIONED SENSE) ANY OF THEM. HE DOES NOT EXPECT FINANCIAL SUPPORT, BUT DOES SEEK "MORAL SUPPORT." HE HOPES TO ESTABLISH REGULAR CONTACT WITH US TO EXCHANGE INFORMATION. WE AGREED TO MEET AGAIN AND TO KEEP ABREAST OF HIS POLITICAL EFFORTS. | ADNAN MAZAREI

label: AHMAD KOOROS
summary: AHMAD KOOROS | THE VACANCIES CREATED BY THESE MOVES AS WELL AS THE POTENTIAL FOR SECOND-LEVEL MOVES AT THE CBI AND MEAF HAVE THE BUREAUCRACY WAITING FOR THE OTHER "SHOE TO FALL". IN THE MEAF, NOT ONLY IS THE DEPUTY MIN VACANCY IMPORTANT, BUT THE POSITIONS OF UNDERSECRETARIES DR AHMAD KOOROS (FOR ECONOMICS) AND DR JAMSHI ASHRAFI (FOR INTERNATIONAL INVESTMENT AND CREDITS) ARE CONSIDERED SHAKY. NO CHANGES ARE ANTICIPATED UNTIL MINISTER YEGANEH RETURNS FROM KUWAIT. | SUMMARY. THE MEAF IS STILL HIGHLY POLITICIZED WITH LITTLE WORK OCCURRING. UNDER SECRETARY DR. AHMAD KOOROS (ALSO KUROS) WAS SUMMARILY DISMISSED ON APRIL 24 AND REPLACED BY DR. IBRAHIM-ZADEH. THAT AND SEVERAL OTHER SEPARATIONS ADD TO THE SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF REFUGEES RETURNING TO THE CENTRAL BANK, WHERE THEY HAVE CAREER PROTECTION. A NEW SALARY SCALE WAS ANNOUNCED IN THE MEAF APRIL 24, WHICH REDUCES COMPENSATION CONSIDERABLY; IT IS ASSUMED TO APPLY TO THE ENTIRE CIVIL SERVICE. THE MEAF'S REVOLUTIONARY KOMITAY CONTINUES TO EXERCISE SUBSTANTIAL POWER. REVOLUTIONARY SUSPICION OF AUTHORITY EXTENDS EVEN TO THE DIRECTOR GENERAL LEVEL AND ERRODES EFFORTS TO REESTABLISH DISCIPLINE. END SUMMARY. | A HIGHLY RELIABLE SENIOR MEAF OFFICIAL INFORMED EMBOFF THAT UNDER SECRETARY DR. AHMAD KOOROS FOUND UPON ARRIVING AT WORK APRIL 24 A SEPARATION NOTICE. LEFT CBI IN 1977 AND UNTIL HIS - RETURN IN MARCH 1979 WORKED UNDER MEAF'S DR. - AHMAD KOOROS ON ECONOMIC POLICY. THE - CBI'S REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE VERY EARLY SEVERED - HIS CBI STATUS (WE ASSUME HE KNOWS, ALTHOUGH HE - DID NOT KNOW WHEN EMBOFF SAW HIM MARCH 6.) DR. AHMAD KOOROS, RECENTLY DISMISSED FROM HIS UNDERSECRETARY - POST AT MEAF (SEE REF D), HAS CBI CAREER PROTECTION - BUT WE DOUBT HE WILL RETURN FOR ACTIVE DUTY IF HE - CAN LEAVE IRAN, SINCE HIS FAMILY IS IN U.S. | AHMAD KOOROS

label: AHMAD MOFTIZADEH
summary: AHMAD MOFTIZADEH | IN THE FACE OF CONTINUING FIGHTING IN SANANDAJ, TWO HIGH-LEVEL DELEGATIONS WERE DISPATCHED TO THE CITY ON MARCH 21. ONE GROUP, COMPOSED OF AYATOLLAH TALAGHANI AND TWO OF KHOMEINI'S CLOSEST CONFIDANTS, REPORTEDLY MET WITH A GROUP OF KURDISH LEADERS HEADED BY AHMAD MOFTIZADEH LATE LAST NIGHT. THE GOVERNMENT-CONTROLLED VOICE OF THE IRANIAN REVOLUTION (VOIR) ANNOUNCED EARLY MARCH 22 THAT THE TALEGHANI AND MOFTIZADEH GROUPS WOULD NONTINUE THEIR DISCUSSIONS TODAY. | THAT IS A COMMODITY THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT MAY NOT HAVE AGREAT DEAL OF. THE GOVERNMENT IS PREDISPOSED TO RECOGNIZE ONLY RELATIVELY MODERATE KURDISH LEADERS SUCH AS AHMAD MOFTIZADEH OF SANANDAJ AND SHEIKH EZEDDIN HOSSEINI OF MAHABAD, WHEREAS THOSE FAVORING AMORE RADICAL SOLUTION APPEAR INCREASINGLY TO BE IN THE ASCENDANT. | IN KURDESTAN, AHMAD MOFTIZADEH, A KURDISH MODERATE WHO PLAYED A PROMINENT ROLE IN THE SANANDAJ NEGOTIATIONS WITH TALAGHANI, URGED ALL KURDS TO VOTE FOR AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IN THE REFERENDUM MARCH 30. SEVEN OTHER KURDISH POLITICAL ORGANIZATIONS. | THE FARSI LANGUAGE PRESS IS ATTRIBUTING THE CANCELLATION LATE LAST WEEK OF AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI'S TRIP TO GONBAD KAVOUS TO MEDIATE THE DISPUTE TO THE LACK OF ANY LOCAL TURKOMAN LEADERS WITH WHOM HE COULD NEGOTIATE. IT DOES APPEAR THAT THERE IS NO ONE IN GONBAD KAVOUS WHO MIGHT PLAY AN IMPORTANT INTERMEDIARY ROLE AS DID MODERATE KURDISH LEADER AHMAD MOFTIZADEH IN SANANDAJ, BUT THE GOVERNMENT ITSELF ATTRIBUTED THE CANCELLATION TO THE HELICOPTER TALEGHANI WAS IN HAVING BEEN FIRED UPON AS IT APPROACHED THE TOWN. | THESE INDIVIDUALS REPUTEDLY HAVE HIRED IRAQI MERCENARIES WITH THE OBJECTIVE OF RESTORING THE SHAH TO POWER. ANOTHER PUBLICATION, THE IRAN POLITICAL DIGEST, REPORTS THAT KURDESTAN IS EFFECTIVELY UNDER THE CONTROL OF THE KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY, WITH THE SHIA KURD WHO HEADED THE SANANDAJ REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE AND WHO ACTED AS KHOMEINI'S REPRESENTATIVES LOCALLY HAVING FLED THE PROVINCE AND MODERATE KURDISH LEADER AHMAD MOFTIZADEH HAVING BEEN STRIPPED OF INFLUENCE. | AHMAD MOFTIZADEH

HE STATED THAT, IN HIS OPINION, THE SHAH WILL REMAIN IN POWER, DESPITE HIS PRESENT DIFFICULTIES. | IN RESPONSE TO A QUESTION, AHY STATED THAT THE IRANIANS WERE NOT SURPRISED AND IN FACT HAD EXPECTED THE REPETITION OF THE BREZHNEV WARNING ON IRAN IN THE SOVIET-AFGHAN COMMUNIQUE. HE ADDED THAT THE TREATY AND THE WARNING'S REPETITION WERE BAD FOR IRAN, WHICH MUST FACE SOVIET PRESSURES FROM DIFFERENT DIRECTIONS. | AHY AGREED WITH THE PAKISTANI DIPLOMAT'S OBSERVATION THAT THE SOVIETS ARE CONCERNED THAT MUSLIM CONSERVATIVE INFLUENCE, AS REFLECTED IN ANTI-SHAH TURMOIL, MIGHT SPREAD INTO MUSLIM AREA OF THE USSR; HE REMARKED THAT THIS MAY PROVIDE A BRAKE ON POSSIBLE SOVIET ENTHUSIASM FOR THE OPPOSITION IN IRAN. (COMMENT: NEITHER AHY NOR THE PAKISTANI DIPLOMAT CITED EVIDENCE TO SUPPORT THEIR SPECULATION ON POTENTIAL FOR MUSLIM UNREST IN THE SOVIET UNION. EMBASSY HAS SEEN NOTHING THUS FAR TO SUPPORT SUCH SPECULATION, AND MANY DIPLOMATIC OBSERVERS SHARE OUR ASSESSMENT THAT THIS FACTOR WOULD ONLY MARGINALLY BEAR ON SOVIET POLICY-MAKERS VIS-A-VIS IRAN OVER THE SHORT-TERM.) (C-ENTIRE TEXT) TOON | EMBOFF ASKED AHY WHAT HE HAD IN MIND FOR A DIALOGUE BETWEEN THE SHAH AND SHARIATMADARI. AHY REPLIED PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS BY THE SHAH TO CONTACT SHARIATMADARI HAD BEEN AD HOC AFFAIRS WITH NO FOLLOW THROUGH. SHARIATMADARI IS A PROUD, OLD PERSIAN; HE NEEDS PERSONAL STROKING. AHY'S UNCLE IS CONSIDERING GETTING TOGETHER 5 OR 10 KEY INDIVIDUALS ACROSS THE IRANIAN POLITICAL SPECTRUM AND DISCUSSING THE PROBLEM WITH THE SHAH, THEN CALLING ON SHARIATMADARI. | AHY ahy

label: AIR TAXI
summary: AIR TAXI | DURING THE COURSE OF MR. MILLER'S TESTIMONY, A QUESTION WAS RAISED ABOUT A PAYMENT OF $2.9 MILLION BY BELL HELICOPTER, A DIVISON OF TEXTRON, TO AIR TAXI IN CONNECTION WITH THE SALE OF 489 HELICOPTERS TO IRAN DURING THE PERIOD OF 1973-1975. IT WAS ALLEGED THAT GENERAL MOHAMMED KHATAMI HAD AN OWNERSHIP INTEREST IN AIR TAXI. THE COMMITTEE HAS BEEN CONDUCTING AN INVESTIGATION INTO FACTS SURROUNDING BELL'S PAYMENT TO AIR TAXI, INCLUDING WHAT KNOWLEDGE TEXTRON AND BELL HELICOPTER OFFICIALS, INCLUDING G. WILLIAM MILLER, MAY HAVE HAD RESPECTING GENERAL KHATAMI'S OWNERSHIP INTEREST IN AIR TAXI. | SENATORS ARE. THE PAYMENT OF THE DOLS 2.9 MILLION FEE TO AIR TAXI WAS A NORMAL DISCHARGE OF A COMMERCIAL OBLIGATION TO A COMPANY WHICH BELL HELICOPTER HAD HAD AN ASSOCIATION FOR THE PREVIOUS 15 YEARS. THIS PAYMENT IN LARGE MEASURE REPRESENTED COMPENSATION FOR EXPENSES AND SERVICES AIR TAXI HAD UNDERTAKEN ON BELL HELICOPTERS BEHALF AND WAS THE CONSEQUENCE OF AN ENTIRELY CORRECT AND RESPECTABLE, PRINCIPAL-AGENT RELATIONSHIP. | TOUFANIAN SAID THAT AIR TAXI HAD BEEN EASED OUT OF THE BELL HELICOPTER SALES PICTURE BECAUSE IT HAD INITIALLY INDICATED ITS TERMS FOR THE SALE WAS TEN PERCENT FOR HELICOPTERS AND 25 PERCENT FOR SPARES. label: ALGERIA
summary: ALGERIA | AS WE HAVE REPORTED PREVIOUSLY, THERE IS A GOOD DEAL OF TALK IN ALGIERS THAT ALGERIANS NOT HAPPY WITH LIBYAN INITIATIVE ON MAGHREB UNITY, AND AT LEAST ONE HIGH GOA OFFICIAL HAS REACTED COOLY TO IDEA IN RECENT CONVERSATION WITH FOREIGN JOURNALISTS. | GENERALLY SPEAKING, OUR IMPRESSION HAS ALWAYS BEEN THAT ALGERIANS WILLING TO GO ALONG WITH QUADHAFI'S UNITY SCHEMES AS LONG AS THESE REMAINED THEORETICAL. THEY SEEM LESS ENTHUSIASTIC, HOWEVER, WHEN IT COMES TO GETTING DOWN TO CASES. AT TIME OF ALGERIAN-LIBYAN RAPPROCHEMENT IN LATE 1975 AND EARLY 1976, FOREIGN MINISTRY OFFICIAL TOOK POSITION IN CONVERSATION WITH US THAT EACH COUNTRY OF REGION MUST ACCORD FIRST PRIORITY TO ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT. ONLY AFTER REASONABLE LEVEL OF DEVELOPMENT ACHIEVED WOULD IT BE POSSIBLE TO THINK OF MAGHREB UNITY, OFFICIAL COMMENTED. | OTHER ASPECTS OF LIBYA'S "REORIENTATION" TOWARD THE MAGHREB APPEAR LIKELY TO HAVE ONLY A MARGINAL IMPACT ON THE REGION. AS NOTED IN THE ALGIERS REFTEL (ALGIERS 2615), THE ALGERIAN GOVERNMENT IS NO DOUBT UNRECEPTIVE TO CONCRETE LIBYAN UNITY SCHEMES FOR THE MAGHREB. THIS IS ESPECIALLY TRUE SINCE ONE ASPECT OF LIBYA'S POLICY IN THE PAST HAS BEEN TO ENCOURAGE SOME FORM OF FAR-REACHING AUTONOMOUS SAHARAN POLITY COMPRISED OF PORTIONS OF SEVERAL STATES, INCLUDING ALGERIA. | WITHOUT BEING SPECIFIC HE POSITED THAT LIBYANS HAVE TAKEN RENEWED INTEREST IN THE MAGHREB AND HAVE IMPROVED THEIR RELATIONS WITH TUNISIANS. ALGERIANS ARE CERTAINLY NOT HAPPY, HE THOUGH, BUT DID NOT KNOW MORE SPECIFICS OF ANY ALGERIAN REACTION TO THESE EFFORTS. | JOINING THE GOI IN 1953, HE SERVED AS JUDGE IN THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE FOR FIVE YEARS. SINCE JOINING THE MFA IN 1957 HE HAS BEEN POSTED IN VIENNA (1960); PRAGUE (1936); GENEVA (1966); AND WAS CHARGE IN ALGERIA (1973). AT HOME HE HAS SERVED IN THE DEPT OF INFORMATION AND PRESS, THE DEPT OF STUDIES AND RESEARCH, AND WAS FOR FOUR YEARS HEAD OF THE WESTERN EUROPEAN DEPARTMENT. | ALGERIA

summary: ALINASSABI | OLDEST AND APPARENTLY MOST RESPECTED BAZAARI, ALINASSABI, GAVE A SHORT SPEECH, A MIXTURE OF SOPHISTICATION AND NAIVETE, IN WHICH HE DESCRIBED HOW FOLLOWING HUGE INCREASE IN OIL REVENUES IMPORTS CLIMBED SWIFTLY TO AROUND $15 BILLION, WITH MUCH OF THIS BEING WASTEFUL EXPENDITURE ON LUXURY GOODS AND INAPPAROPRIATE TECHNOLOGY. label: ARAFAT
summary: ARAFAT | VINOGRADEV'S COMMENT THAT ARAFAT WAS TOTALLY UNAWARE OF ATTACK ON ISRAELI BUS IS NOT WORTH MUCH IN OUR VIEW. ABU JIHAD'S "OCCUPIED TERRITORIES OFFICE" IN FATAH WAS RESPONSIBLE FOR MARCH 11 ATTACK. ABU JIHAD IS CLOSE TO ARAFAT, AND IT IS UNLIKELY HE WOULD HAVE ACTED WITHOUT LATTER'S KNOWLEDGE AND APPROVAL ON OPERATION OF THIS MAGNITUDE AND SIGNIFICANCE. ATTACK REPRESENTED DELIBERATE CHANGE IN FATAH POLICY, REFLECTING DECISION WHICH MUST HAVE BEEN TAKEN AT HIGHEST LEVELS, MEANING ARAFAT. | THREE FACTORS ARE IMPORTANT TO THESE MEMBERS AND SHOULD BE EMPHASIZED: (1) THE SOVIET UNION IS NOT NOW PART OF THE PEACE PROCESS BUT STANDS TO GAIN IF SADAT FAILS; (2) THE PLO, POLITICALLY UNPOPULAR IN THE U.S., IS LIKEWISE NOT INVOLVED (PAUL FINDLEY, WHO ALONG WITH HELEN MEYNER AND LARRY WINN MET WITH ARAFAT IN DAMASCUS, IS PRACTICALLY ALONE IN THE FEELING THEY SHOULD BE INVOLVED; AND | WHILE HE WAS PREDICTABLY AND PIOUSLY OUTRAGED BY THE ISRAELI ACTION IN SOUTH LEBANON, I FOUND HIM SURPRISINGLY SENSITIVE ON THE SUBJECT OF THE PLO TERRORIST ATTACK IN ISRAEL. HE ADMITTED THAT THE SOVIETS WERE EMBARRASSED BY THE FACT THIS ATTACK TOOK PLACE IMMEDIATELY AFTER ARAFAT'S VISIT TO MOSCOW. | FOR WHAT IT MAY BE WORTH, VINOGRADOV SAID THAT HE FELT ARAFAT WAS TOTALLY UNAWARE OF THE ATTACK, WHICH HE BELIEVED WAS CARRIED OUT BY PLO LEFT-WING EXTREMISTS. HOWEVER, HE ALSO FELT ARAFAT HAD TO TAKE RESPONSIBILITY FOR THE ACTION IN ORDER TO PRESERVE HIS POSITION WITHIN THE PLO. | VINOGRADOV FURTHER STATED THAT SOVIETS BELIEVE ARAFAT HAS "MATURED" SIGNIFICANTLY IN RECENT TIMES. HE SAID SOVIETS HAVE BEEN WORKING WITH HIM TO ADVANCE THIS "MATURING" PROCESS. AT THE SAME TIME, SOVIETS FELT ARAFAT HAD SERIOUS PROBLEMS IN MAINTAINING HIS POSITION OF PRIMACY WITHIN THE PLO. | ARAFAT

label: ARDEBIL
summary: ARDEBIL | HE ALSO REPORTED (AS DID BUSINESS SOURCE) THAT IT WAS BAD DAY IN KERMANSHAH YESTERDAY, WITH NUMEROUS DEAD, WIDESPREAD BURNING (INCLUDING GOVERNORGENERAL'S HOUSE), ETC. PRESS SOURCES HAVE REPORTS OF VIOLENCE IN ARDEBIL AND NUMBER OF OTHER TOWNS IN TABRIZ AREA. | SEVERAL MAJOR CITIES SHOW VIRTUAL REPLACEMENT OF REGULAR SECURITY FORCES BY "THE PEOPLES" SECURITY FORCE, PRESS REPORTS THAT IN KERMANSHAH, ARDEBIL, AND ILAM, POPULAR FORCES ARE MAINTAINING LAW AND ORDER. CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS THESE NEW "POLICEMEN" ARE DIRECTING TRAFFIC. | REFERRING TO "DISTRUBING REPORTS" FROM GONBAD KAVOUS, ZAHEDAN (THE PROVINCIAL CAPITAL OF SISTAN AND BALUCHISTAN) AND ARDEBIL (IN EAST AAZARBAIJAN PROVINCE), KHOMEINI SAID THAT "CERTAIN DECADENT FACTIONS ARE BUSY SPREADING POISON AND PROMOTING DIVISIVENESS," THAT "THESE FACTIONS HAVE SPREAD THE RUMOR THAT CLERGYMEN WILL DEPRIVE THE SUNNI BROTHERS OF THEIR RIGHTS." KHOMEINI CONTINUED THAT "THESE MISLED PEOPLE, WHO GET THEIR INSPIRATION FROM AMERICA AND APPEAR IN THE GUISE OF LEFTISTS, ARE PLANNING TO RESTORE THE PERIOD OF LOOTINGS OF THE PREVIOUS REGIME IN ANOTHER FORM IN OUR DEAR COUNTRY." AN INDIRECT CONFIRMATION THAT TROUBLE MAY BE BREWING IN BALUCHISTAN WAS THE ANNOUNCEMENT MARCH 29 THAT DEFENSE MINISTER MEDANI HAS BEEN DISPATCHED TO ZAHEDAN. | NUMBEROUS POLLING STATIONS RAN OUT OF BALLOTS. EARLY MARCH 31 IRANIAN AIR FORCE PLANES WERE REPORTEDLY RUSHING ADDITIONAL SUPPLIES TO POLLING STATIONS AS SCATTERED AS CHAH BAHAR AND ARDEBIL. IN ADDITION, VOTERS IN GONBAD KAVOUS WERE NOT ABLE TO VOTE AT ALL BECAUSE OF CONTINUING FIGHTING BETWEEN THE LOCAL TURKOMAN POPULATION AND GOVERNMENT FORCES. | IN ADDITION TO DEFENSE MINISTER MADANI'S MISSION TO ZAHEDAN REPORTED EARLIER, ANOTHER DELEGATION FROM KHOMEINI HAS BEEN DISPATCHED TO THE PROVINCE. MOREOVER, A TEAM HAS BEEN SENT TO ARDEBIL TO INVESTIGATE DISTRUBANCES BETWEEN THE SHIA AND SUNNI COMMUNITIES IN THE ARDEBILZANJAN AREA. FINALLY, THE MINISTERY OF INTERIOR HAS SENT A NEW TEAM TO GONBAD KAVOUS IN THE LATEST ATTEMPT TO NEGOTIATE A CEASEFIRE. | ARDEBIL

summary: ASHTAL | AT OUR INITIATIVE, ASSISTANT SECRETARY ATHERTON MET IN NEW YORK JUNE 22 WITH PDRY PERMANENT REPRESENTATIVE ASHTAL. ATHERTON ASKED ASHTAL TO CONVEY TO HIS GOVERNMENT THAT,IN ACCORDANCE WITH PRESIDENT'S POLICY OF SEEKING TO IMPROVE RELATIONS WHEREVER POSSIBLE, WE WOULD LIKE TO ENTER INTO A HIGH-LEVEL DIALOGUE WITH A VIEW TO IMPROVING RELATIONS WITH SOUTH YEMEN LOOKING TOWARD THE RESTORATION OF DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS. TO THAT END, WE PROPOSED A MEETING OF SENIOR OFFICIALS OF OUR TWO GOVERNMENTS IN ADEN, WASHINGTON, NEW YORK OR WHEREVER THE YEMENIS FOUND CONVENIENT. | ASHTAL ASKED ABOUT TIMING AND ATHERTON SAID WHENEVER IT WAS CONVENIENT FOR PDRY BUT FROM OUR POINT OF VIEW, THE SOONER THE BETTER. ASHTAL SAID HE WANTED TO INFORM US THAT THERE WOULD BE OPPORTUNITY FOR HIGH-LEVEL CONTACT THIS FALL SINCE THE CHAIRMAN OF THE PDRY PRESIDENTIAL COUNCIL, SALIM RUBAYYA ALI, WOULD BE COMING TO NEW YORK FOLLOWING A VISIT TO CUBA TO ADDRESS THE UNGA ON SEPTEMBER 29. MEANWHILE, HE WOULD CONVEY OUR SUGGESTION TO ADEN AND WAS CERTAIN HE WOULD RECEIVE AN EARLY REPLY. ASHTAL INDICATED HIS HOPE THAT TODAY'S MEETING WOULD BE KEPT CONFIDENTIAL. ATHERTON SAID THIS WAS OUR INTENTION. | IN GENERAL DISCUSSION THAT FOLLOWED, ASHTAL NOTED RECENT PUBLICATION OF DEPARTMENT LETTER TO CONGRESS ON TERRORISM WHICH HAD MENTIONED PDRY AND SAID THIS HAD CREATED A BAD IMPRESSION WITH HIS GOVERNMENT. ATHERTON SAID WE WERE RESPONDING TO A CONGRESSIONAL INQUIRY AND HAD TO PROVIDE FACTUAL INFORMATION AS WE KNEW IT. | IN RESPONSE TO ATHERTON'S QUERY ABOUT PDRY RELATIONS WITH ITS NEIGHBORS, ASHTAL SAID THERE WERE MUCH IMPROVED AND CITED IN PARTICULAR SAUDI ARABIA, KUWAIT AND NORTH YEMEN. PDRY WANTED TO PURSUE ITS OWN INDEPENDENT NATIONAL POLICY AND TO FOCUS ITS EFFORTS ON INTERNAL ECONOMIC PROBLEMS. ASHTAL SAID HIS GOVERNMENT HOPED U.S. COMPANIES WOULD BECOME INTERESTED IN PDRY; HE ACKNOWLEDGED THAT REESTABLISHMENT OF RELATIONS MIGHT ENCOURAGE SUCH INTEREST. ASHTAL THEN COMMENTED THAT SITUATION "IN OUR AREA" WAS BECOMING EXPLOSIVE. HE MADE PARTICULAR REFERENCE TO HORN OF AFRICA AND SITUATION BETWEEN ETHIOPIA AND SOMALIA. | ASHTAL

label: ASSEMBLY
summary: ASSEMBLY | WHEN ASKED IF THE DRAFT RECENTLY PUBLISHED WAS CLOSE TO THE INITIAL DRAFT HIS COMMITTEE HAD PREPARED, MINACHI SAID THAT KHOMEINI HAD MADE ONLY "A FEW MINOR CHANGES." SAHABI STRESSED THAT THE DRAFT IS JUST THAT, I.E., A WORKING DOCUMENT WHICH MAY BE AMENDED BY THE ASSEMBLY WHEN IT TAKES IT UP FOR DEBATE. ALL IRANIANS THEORETICALLY HAVE A RIGHT TO COMMENT UPON THE DRAFT AND THE ASSEMBLY IS SUPPOSED TO TAKE THEIR VIEWS INTO CONSIDERATION. MINACHI SAID THAT SAHABI'S OFFICE IS RESPONSIBLE FOR COLLATING THESE VIEWS AND PRESENTING THEM TO THE ASSEMBLY IN SOME FORM THAT WILL ALLOW IT TO MAKE APPROPRIATE AMENDMENTS. | THIS DEMAND WAS REJECTED, THUS PUTTING THE MPRP ON THE EVE OF THE ELECTIONS IN A POSITION TO GO EITHER WAY, I.E., PREPARED TO REJECT THE ELECTIONS EX POST FACTO SHOULD ITS CANDIDATES DO POORLY OR TO PARTICIPATE IN THE ASSEMBLY AS THE VOICE OF ISLAMIC MODERATION IF ITS CANDIDATES DO WELL. | NAZARI THOUGHT IT EXTREMELY UNLIKELY THAT THE ASSEMBLY WOULD BE ABLE TO STICK TO ITS THIRTY-DAY SCHEDULE FOR COMPLETION OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL REVIEW. HE ESTIMATED THAT IT WOULD BE THE END OF THE YEAR BEFORE THE CONSTITUTION COULD BE PROMULGATED AND ELECTIONS HELD. DESPITE THE ASSEMBLY MEMBERSHIP'S LACK OF EXPERIENCE WITH PARLIAMENTARY PROCEDURE AND THE CONSEQUENT PROSPECT FOR DELAYED COMPLETION OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL REVIEW PROCESS, NAZARI BELIEVED THERE IS ONE POSITIVE ASPECT OF THE ASSEMBLY'S SESSIONS: HE ANTICIPATED THAT MANY MEMBERS WILL ALSO BE ELECTED TO THE MAJLES, AND HENCE THE LEGISLATIVE EXPERIENCE THEY ARE NOW GAINING WILL STAND THEM IN GOOD STEAD LATER. | THE ASSEMBLY HAS BEGUN TO FACE THE FORMIDABLE TASK OF ANSWERING QUESTIONS OF THE LEGISLATURE, THE JUDICIARY, AND THE CABINET. UNLESS THE PACE OF WORK IS SPEEDED UP, THERE SEEMS LITTLE PROSPECT FOR THE COUNCIL TO FINISH ITS WORK BEFORE THE END OF 1979. ON 19 SEPT, HOWEVER, KHOMEINI AGAIN URGED THE ASSEMBLY TO EXPEDITE PASSAGE OF THE CONSTITUTION GIVING INDICATION THAT HE MAY BE BECOMING IMPATIENT WITH THE ASSEMBLY'S SNAIL LIKE PACE. SHOULD KHOMEINI STEP IN HE COULD UNDOUBTEDLY SPEED UP THE PROCESS. | ACCORDING TO LOCAL JOURNALIST WHO HAS BEEN FOLLOWING ASSEMBLY SESSIONS, DURING LAST 10 DAYS ASSEMBLY HAS MADE SIGNIFICANT CHANGE IN ITS DRAFTING PROCEDURE. ARTICLES ARE NO LONGER WRITTEN BY FUNCTIONAL COMMITTEES, BUT ARE DRAFTED BY A COORDINATING COMMITTEE MADE UP OF SENIOR DELEGATES. THESE DRAFT ARTICLES ARE THEN SENT TO THE SPECIALIZED COMMITTEE BEFORE BEING SUBMITTED TO A VOTE OF THE ENTIRE ASSEMBLY. THIS SHIFT APPARENTLY CAME AS RECOGNITION OF THE IMPORTANCE OF THE FIRST DRAFT IN SHAPING THE ARTICLES OF THE CONSTITUTION. DRAFT ARTICLES EMERGING FROM THE FUNCTIONAL COMMITTEES, LACKED THE EXPLICIT APPROVAL OF MANY SENIOR DELEGATES AND WERE ENCOUNTERING DIFFICULTY ON THE FLOOR OF THE ASSEMBLY. | ASSEMBLY

label: ATHERTON
summary: ATHERTON | AT OUR INITIATIVE, ASSISTANT SECRETARY ATHERTON MET IN NEW YORK JUNE 22 WITH PDRY PERMANENT REPRESENTATIVE ASHTAL. ATHERTON ASKED ASHTAL TO CONVEY TO HIS GOVERNMENT THAT,IN ACCORDANCE WITH PRESIDENT'S POLICY OF SEEKING TO IMPROVE RELATIONS WHEREVER POSSIBLE, WE WOULD LIKE TO ENTER INTO A HIGH-LEVEL DIALOGUE WITH A VIEW TO IMPROVING RELATIONS WITH SOUTH YEMEN LOOKING TOWARD THE RESTORATION OF DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS. TO THAT END, WE PROPOSED A MEETING OF SENIOR OFFICIALS OF OUR TWO GOVERNMENTS IN ADEN, WASHINGTON, NEW YORK OR WHEREVER THE YEMENIS FOUND CONVENIENT. | IN RESPONSE TO ASHTAL'S QUESTION ABOUT LEVEL OF U.S. REPRESENTATIVE FOR PROPOSED MEETING, ATHERTON SAID WE HAD NOT DECIDED PRECISELY BUT IT WOULD BE A SENIOR OFFICIAL, POSSIBLY UNDER SECRETARY HABIB WHO HAD RECENTLY VISITED BAGHDAD FOR SIMILAR MISSION. | ASHTAL ASKED ABOUT TIMING AND ATHERTON SAID WHENEVER IT WAS CONVENIENT FOR PDRY BUT FROM OUR POINT OF VIEW, THE SOONER THE BETTER. ASHTAL SAID HE WANTED TO INFORM US THAT THERE WOULD BE OPPORTUNITY FOR HIGH-LEVEL CONTACT THIS FALL SINCE THE CHAIRMAN OF THE PDRY PRESIDENTIAL COUNCIL, SALIM RUBAYYA ALI, WOULD BE COMING TO NEW YORK FOLLOWING A VISIT TO CUBA TO ADDRESS THE UNGA ON SEPTEMBER 29. MEANWHILE, HE WOULD CONVEY OUR SUGGESTION TO ADEN AND WAS CERTAIN HE WOULD RECEIVE AN EARLY REPLY. ASHTAL INDICATED HIS HOPE THAT TODAY'S MEETING WOULD BE KEPT CONFIDENTIAL. ATHERTON SAID THIS WAS OUR INTENTION. | IN GENERAL DISCUSSION THAT FOLLOWED, ASHTAL NOTED RECENT PUBLICATION OF DEPARTMENT LETTER TO CONGRESS ON TERRORISM WHICH HAD MENTIONED PDRY AND SAID THIS HAD CREATED A BAD IMPRESSION WITH HIS GOVERNMENT. ATHERTON SAID WE WERE RESPONDING TO A CONGRESSIONAL INQUIRY AND HAD TO PROVIDE FACTUAL INFORMATION AS WE KNEW IT. THIS WAS THE KIND OF THING THAT COULD BE DISCUSSED PRIVATELY BETWEEN US IF WE HAD A BETTER DIALOGUE. | FINALLY, ATHERTON DESCRIBED BRIEFLY OUR MIDDLE EAST PEACE EFFORTS, CITING IN PARTICULAR VICE PRESIDENT MONDALE'S RECENT SAN FRANCISCO SPEECH AND STRESSING THAT WE ARE DETERMINED TO CONTINUE TO WORK FOR JUST MIDDLE EAST | ATHERTON

label: AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY
summary: AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY | MORE OBSCURE AND PUZZLING HAVE BEEN THE CIRCUMSTANCES SURROUNDING DEMONSTRATIONS BY RELIGIOUS PERSONS OR IN THE NAME OF RELIGION. TWO INCIDENTS ARE DOCUMENTED INVOLCING A RELIGIOUS PREACHER CRITICIZING THE PRESENT STATE OF AFFAIRS AND CALLING FOR THE RETURN OF AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY, A LEFTIST NATIONALIST LEADER WHO HAS FOR MANY YEARS TAKEN REFUGEE IN IRAQ. OTHER DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE BEEN ALLEGED BY THE PRESS AND GOVERNMENT TO INVOLVE EFFORTS BY RELIGIOUS FANATICS AGAINST THE DESEGREGATION OF WOMEN IN UNIVERSITIES ANDOTHER AGITATION TO REVERSE THE LIBERALIZING REFORMS OF THE SHAH-PEOPLE, OR "WHITE", REVOLUTION. | IT IS NECESSARY TO REJECT SUCH PLANS AS WELL AS THE INDIVIDUAL WHO FAVORS THEM." THE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY ------------------018282 131113Z /11 FM AMEMBASSY PARIS TO AMEMBASSY TEHRAN PRIORITY INFO SECSTATE WASHDC 8755 GOES ON TO ASK FOR THE DISMISSAL AND TRIAL OF ALL THE PEOPLE WHO HAD IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS IN THE SERVICE OF THE PAHLEVI DYNASTY. "THERE ARE NO BASIC DIFFERENCES BETWEEN THE PEOPLE WHO FAVOR THE GOVERNMENT AND THOSE WHO, BY OPPORTUNISM AND DUPLICITY, HAVE BECOME OPPONENTS, AND ARE NOISILY TALKING OF FREE ELECTIONS AND THE APPLICATION OF THE CONSTITUTION. | ANY POLITICAL REGIME WHICH COMES TO POWER THANKS TO THE INTERVENTION OF FOREIGN POWERS, ESPECIALLY THE U.S., THE USSR AND GREAT BRITAIN, WILL BE AN INSTRUMENT TO MAINMAINTAIN THE NATION IN REGRESSION, DISTRESS, OPPRESSION, RANSACKING AND DESPOTISM." FINALLY, THE AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY EXPOSED "THE DUTIES OF THE STUDENTS AND OF THE PUPILS: TO INCITE THE ARMY TO BREAK THE CHAINS OF DOMINATION AND TO LIBERATE ITSELF FROM THE SHAME OF BEING LED BY FOREIGN COUNSELLORS, TO ENCOURAGE A GENERAL UPHEAVAL AND TO BE VIGILANT REGARDING THE PROVOCATIONS AND THE DIVERSIONS ORGANIZED BY GOVERNMENTAL ELEMENTS WHO WANT TO FRIGHTEN THE POPULATION BY PASSING ON COMMUNIST ORDERS." UNQUOTE. | FOLLOWING IS TEXT OF AFP ITEM CONTAINING OCTOBER 25 INTERVIEW WITH AYATOLLAH: BEGIN TEXT: AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY, WHO DIRECTS FROM HIS PARIS EXILE , THE RELIGIOUS OPPOSITION TO THE REGIME OF THE SHAH WEDNESDAY REJECTED ALL POSSIBILITY OF A COMMON STRATEGY WITH THE POLITICAL OPPOSITION FOR THE INSTALLATION OF A TRANSITION GOVERNMENT AS LONG AS THE SOVEREIGN HAS NOT LEFT THE COUNTRY. "REPLYING TO AFP QUESTIONS THE CHIEF IRANIAN SHIITE PRONOUNCED HIMSELF FOR CONTINUATION OF A WAR OF ATTRITION AGAINST IRANIAN GOVERNMENT UNTIL VICTORY. "I HAVE BEEN FROM THE BEGINNING AND REMAIN IRREVOCABLY OPPOSED TO CONCILIATION AND COMPROMISE WHICH CANNOT EITHER GET IRAN OUT OF ITS IMPASSE OR END REPRESSION AND MASSACRES," AFFIRMED AYATOLLAH. "IF THE ENTIRE IRANIAN PUBLIC OPINION RANGES ITSELF WITH THE IDEA THAT THE REGIME MUST GO, THE REGIME WILL BE OBLIGED TO RENOUNCE REPRESSION AND THE HOUR OF THE PEOPLES VICTORY WILL BE HASTENED." AYATOLLAH DECLARED THAT HE DID NOT FEAR A AGGRAVATION OF SOCIAL AND ECONOMIC CHAOS BECAUSE OF THE ABSENCE OF POWER. "A VOID ALREADY EXISTS IN IRAN. | THOSE WHO WILL BE SHOWN CAPABLE OF OVERTHROWING THE REGIME WILL ALSO BE CAPEBLE OF RUNNING THE COUNTRY." QUESTIONED ON THE DANGER OF BEING OUTFLANKED BY THE COMMUNIST LEFT, AYATOLLAH EXPRESSED HIS CONVICTION THAT THE YOUNG MALCONTENTS WHO TODAY CLAIM COMMUNISM, WILL TOMORROW RALLY TO THE ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT. "EVEN SUPPOSING THOSE WHO DEMONSTRATE WITH COMMUNIST SLOGANS ARE MARXISTS, THEY DO NOT CONSTITUTE A FORCE IN THE FACE OF THIRTY MILLION PERSIANSWHO ARE IN REVOLT IN THE NAME OF ISLAM. "AFTER THE INSTALLATION OF AN ISLAMIC GOVERNMENT AND THE ENLARGEMENT OF LIBERTIES AND THE CHANCES FOR PROGRESS WHICH WILL ACCOMPANY IT, IT WILL BE POSSIBLE TO DRAW TO ISLAM THOSE WHO SEARCH FOR TRUTH AND JUSTICE." AYATOLLAH REAFFIRMED IN THE CLEAREST TERMS HIS DETERMINATION NOT TO END HIS VOLUNTARY EXILE--WHICH HAS LASTED FIFTEEN YEARS. "AS LONG AS THE SHAH REMAINS IN POWER I WILL NOT RETURN TO IRAN." DOES NOT AYATOLLAH FEAR UPSETTING WESTERN OPINION BY THE ANATHEMAS THAT HE CEASELESSLY LANCES AGAINST THE GREAT POWERS?" I CONDEMN VIOLATIONS OF HUMAN RIGHTS BY THE GREAT POWERS AND NOT THE PEOPLES OF THESE COUNTRIES. | AYATOLLAH KHOMEINY

label: AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI
summary: AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI | MINATCHI SAID DECISION HAD BEEN TAKEN TO GIVE SHAH SEVERAL NAMES TO PICK FROM, AND IN CASE OF REGENCY COUNCIL, OPEN CHOICE ON TWO ACTIVE DUTY MILITARY COMMANDERS AND SELECTION FROM LIST OF ONE RETIRED OFFICER. AFTER LISTS WERE READY, AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI WOULD DEPART FOR PARIS TO GET KHOMEINI'S TACIT APPROVAL. THEN, SAID MINATCHI, CDHRF WOULD LIKE TO PRESENT LIST TO U.S. | EMBOFF REPLIED THERE WERE SOME BIG IF'S ALONG ROAD TO MEETING--WOULD GROUP AGREE ON LIST FIRST, AND THEN WOULD KHOMEINI ACCEPT IDEA. MINATCHI THOUGHT GETTING GROUP TO AGREE ON NAMES WOULD BE MOST DIFFICULT PART; AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI THOUGHT KHOMEINI WOULD AGREE TO SOLUTION WITH PROPOSED REGENCY COUNCIL. EMBOFF SAID THIS WAS MAJOR SUBSTANTIVE PROBLEM--SHAH HAD NOT AGREED TO THIS BEFORE; WHAT MADE CDHRF THINK WE WOULD DO SO NOW? | SIX CANDIDATES WERE NAMED FOR FOUR CIVILIAN SPOTS, WITH ADDITIONAL POSITION RESERVED FOR KHOMEINI NOMINEE IF AYATOLLAH DEIGNS TO SELECT SOMEONE. CIVILIAN NOMINEES ARE: ABDOLLAH ENTEZAM, EX-FOREIGN MINISER; ALLAHYAR SALEH, EX-MINISTER OF INTERIOR UNDER MOSSADEQ; DR. ALI AKBAR SIASSI, FORMER FOREIGN MINISTER AND TEHRAN UNIVERSITY DEAN; DR. (FNU) AHZAR, EX-MOSSADEQ MINISTER; MR. (FNU) NAJMOLMOLK; AND A MR. MOHAMMAD SOURI, A FORMER MINISTER AYATGOLLAH MONTAZERI, A KHOMEINI LOYALIST, WILL LEAVE FOR PARIS IN TWO OR THREE DAYS TO LAY THIS PROPOSAL BEFORE KHOMEINI. IF HE APPROVES, THEN DR. ALI AMINI AND EX-PRIME MINISTER SHARIF-EMAMI WOULD PRESENT PROPOSAL TO SHAH. | TURNING TO KHOMEINI ORGANIZATION WITHIN IRAN, COTTAM SAID REAL ORGANIZATION LEADER IS SEYED MOHAMMAD BEHESTI, A GHOLHAK MULLAH WHO PILOTS MOVEMENT AND IS MAIN CONTACT WITH PARIS. AYATOLLAHS TALEQANI, RAFSANJANI, AND MONTAZERI ARE KEY TITULAR LEADERS, BUT THERE IS NO RPT NO DOUBTTHAT BEHESHTI AND HIS GROUP OF YOUNGER MULLAHS AND SECULAR ASSOCIATES, INCLUDING HOSSEIN NAZIEH, THE PROGRESSIVE HEAD OF BAR ASSOCIATION ARE DOING THE MAIN WORK. BAZARGAN IS IMPORTANT TITULAR LEADER BUT NOT A REAL ORGANIZER. | AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI IS DUE BACK IN IRAN FROM PARIS IN TWO OR THREE DAYS. HE HAD TRIED TO FLY IN JAN 3, BUT PLANE HAD BEEN DIVERTED TO SYRIA. | AYATOLLAH MONTAZERI

LEADING CONSERVATIVE URDU DAILY NAWA-I-WAQT, IN A STRONGLY-WORDED EDITORIAL, TERMED THE REMARKS "UNBELIEVABLE" AND "CRUDE" AND DEMANDED THAT FOREIGN ADVISER AGHA SHAHI CLARIFY THE NATURE OF HIS RECENT TALKS IN TEHRAN. | CLARIFICATION ACTUALLY CAME ON MAY 21 WHEN THE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR REPORTEDLY CALLED ON FONSEC SHAHNAWAZ -- ON INSTRUCTIONS -- TO CONVEY THE VIEW THAT THE STATEMENT OF THE IRANIAN PRIMIN AS BROADCAST BY THE BBC WAS INCORRECT. ALL PAPERS CARRIED THIS SOMEWHAT STILTED FORMULATION, WITH NO FURTHER AMPLIFICATION ON MAY 22; THE URDU LANGUAGE JANG, FOR ONE, CHARACTERIZED THE CLARIFICATION AS INSUFFICIENT, URGING THE SHAH TO ISSUE A "SATISFACTORY DENIAL." label: BEHESHT EZARA CEMETERY
summary: BEHESHT EZARA CEMETERY | TODAY IS ANOTHER DAY OF MOURNING. KHOMEINI CALLED FOR IT, BUT EVERYONE ELSE HAS CLIMBED ABOARD, INCLUDING THE GOVERNMENT, SO COMMERCIAL LIFE REMAINS HALTED EXCEPT FOR THE LINES AT GAS STATIONS. MARCHERS ARE ACTIVE IN VARIOUS PARTS OF THE CITY BUT HAVE NOT MASSED IN GREAT NUMBERS. THERE IS PROBABLY A LARGE CROWD OUTSIDE TOWN AT BEHESHT-EZARA CEMETARY WHERE A RALLY IS PLANNED FOR THIS AFTERNOON. THIS MORNING A CROWD OF 1500-2000 GATHERED OUTSIDE TALEGHANI'S HOUSE AT EAST END OF SHAH REZA. TROOPS DISPERSED MOST OF CROWD, BUT 3-400 SAT DOWN AND DARED SOLDIERS TO SHOOT. TROOPS WERE FINALLY ABLE TO BREAK THEM UP WITHOUT FIRING INTO THEM. | SPECIAL COMMITTEE ARRANGING RETURN OF KHOMEINI ANNOUNCED HE WILL ARRIVE 9 A.M. TOMORROW. THIS IS CONFIRMED BY OTHER SOURCES. ACCORDING TO AN ARRANGEMENT WORKED OUT BY RELIGIOUS LEADERS AND THE MILITARY, TROOPS WILL PROVIDE SECURITY BETWEEN AIRPORT AND SHAHYAD MONUMENT. KHOMEINI'S OWN PEOPLE WILL PROVIDE SECURITY AFTER THAT. AS PREVIOUSLY INDICATED, KHOMEINI WILL GO TO BEHESHT-EZARA CEMETARY FOR HIS GREETING SPEECH, THEN SETTLE TEMPORARILY IN HIS HEADQUARTERS NEAR THE MAJLIS BUILDING. HE WILL IN THE NEAR FUTURE GO TO QOM, HIS FORMER HOME. WHILE THE SPECIFIC ISSUE OF HIS ARRIVAL APPEARS SETTLED, THE POLITICAL FUTURE REMAINS TROUBLED. | BEHESHT EZARA CEMETERY

label: BEHESHT E ZAHRA
summary: BEHESHT E ZAHRA | KASHANI CLAIMS TO HAVE SEEN THE WRECK OF THE HOUSE AND THE PORTIONS OF THE DEAD MAN'S BODY WHICH WERE DISPLAYED OUTSIDE IT ON JAN 1. label: BEHESHT E ZAHRA CEMETERY
summary: BEHESHT E ZAHRA CEMETERY | CROWD ESTIMATED BY VARIOUS SOURCES AT 3-10 THOUSAND GATHERED AT BEHEST-E-ZAGRA CEMETERY SEVERAL KILOMETERS SOUTH OF TEHRAN LATE AFTERNOON SEPT. 14 TO MARK SEVENTH DAY AFTER SEPT 8 "MASSACRE" OF DEMONSTRATORS. LED BY MINOR MULLLAHS, CROWD SHOUTED ANTI-SHAH AND ANTI-GOVERNMENT SLOGANS BUT WAS QUIETED DOWN BY APPEAL OVER LOUDSPEAKER FROM ARMY OFFICER WHO SPOKE TO CROWD AS "BROTHERS" WHOM MILITARY HAD NO DESIRE TO HURT. ONE REPORT HAS IT THAT TROOPS EVEN PRESENTED DEMONSTRATORS WITH FLOWERS, WHILE OTHER REPORTS SAY DEMONSTRATORS GAVE FLOWERS TO TROOPS. CROWD DISPERSED PEACEFULLY, RETURNING TO TEHRAN IN RENTED BUSES AND PRIVATE CARS. | THIS AND OTHER MARCHES HAVE BEEN APTLY DESCRIBED AS "RIPPLES AFTER THE BIG WAVE." OTHER COMMEMORATIVE RALLIES HAVE BEEN PLANNED FOR MARCH 20 AT MARTYRS' SQUARE (FORMERLY JALEH SQUARE) AND ON MARCH 21 AT BEHESHTE-ZAHRA CEMETERY. AYATOLLAH NOURI WILL ADDRESS BOTH GROUPS. AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI, PRIME MINISTER BAZARGAN AND MEMBERS OF HIS CABINET WILL ALSO ADDRESS THE LARGE GROUPS EXPECTED TO ATTEND NO RUZ CEREMONIES TOMORROW AT ARYA MEHR STADIUM (NEW NAME UNKNOWN). ON MARCH 22 A MARCH/RALLY IS ALSO BEING PLANNED THROUGHOUT IRAN BY THE ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY. | THE DEATH OF AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI CAUSED A GREAT OUTPOURING OF PUBLIC GRIEF IN TEHRAN AND THE PROVINCES. VAST CROWDS IN TEHRAN YESTERDAY PREVENTED THE FUNERAL FROM BEING HELD UNTIL 6:30 AM THIS MORNING (SEPT. 11). AN ESTIMATED ONE MILLION PEOPLE SPENT THE NIGHT IN BEHESHT-E-ZAHRA CEMETARY AWAITING TALEGHANI'S BURIAL. THE RADIO AND TELEVISION HAVE DISCONTINUED THEIR NORMAL PROGRAMMING FOR THREE DAYS OF NATIONAL MOURNING. CROWDS OF EMOTIONAL MOURNERS THROUGHTOUT THE COUNTRY SHOUTED SLOGANS SUCH AS "MOTAHARI: YOU HAVE A GUEST", AND "TALEGHANI: CONGRATULATIONS ON YOUR MARTYRDOM". | TALEGHANI'S POPULARITY DURING HIS LIFETIME WAS MOST VIVIDLY DEMONSTRATED IN HIS PERFORMING THE DUTIES OF THE IMAM-E-JOM'EH (FRIDAY PREACHER) IN TEHRAN. HIS WEEKLY PRAYERS AT THE UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN (AND HIS LAST AT BEHESHT-E-ZAHRA CEMETERY ON SEPT 7) WOULD ATTRACT AN ESTIMATED TWO MILLION WORSHIPPERS WHO SOUGHT TO PRAY BEHIND HIM. THE SELECTION OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AS THE SITE OF FRIDAY PRAYERS WAS HIGHLY SYMBOLIC OF TALEGHANI'S ROLE AS CONCILIATOR BETWEEN THE RELIGIOUS CLASSES AND THE SECULAR INTELLECTUALS. | BEHESHT E ZAHRA CEMETERY

label: BEHESHT E ZARAH CEMETERY
summary: BEHESHT E ZARAH CEMETERY | KHOMEINI ARRIVAL IS SET PER REFTELS. BOTH MINATCHI AND LIBERATION MOVEMENT SOURCE CONFIRMED PLANS ARE SET. MINATCHI SAID MILITARY WILL MAINTAIN AIRPORT SECURITY AND DELIVER KHOMEINI MOTORCADE TO SHAHYAD SQUARE, WHERE LIBERATION MOVEMENT SECURITY MARSHALLS WILL TAKEOVER. ARMY WILL APPARENTLY BE STANDING BY ROUTE ON MARCH TO BEHESHT-E-ZARAH CEMETARY, BUT NOT VERY VISIBLY. MINOR GLITCH HAS DEVELOPED WITH RESPECT TO THOSE WHO ARE TO GREET THE AYATOLLAH. APPARENTLY 1200 CARDS HAD BEEN ISSUED TO ALLOW ENTRANCE TO AIRPORT. MILITARY BALKED AT THIS, AND SAID GREETING HALL COULD HOLD AT MOST 50. ALL CARDS WILL BE CANCELLED, AND MASTER LIST DRAWN UP. | PROGRAM CAME ON SHORTLY BEFORE AYATOLLAHS' ARRIVAL WITH NORMAL LOGO. MOTTO AT BOTTOM, WHICH HAD HERETOFORE SAID "NATIONAL IRANIAN RADIO AND TELEVISION," WAS REPLACED WITH SENTENCE SAYING "THE SPRING BLOOMING OF IRAN." ANNOUNCER NOTED NIRT HAD SET UP COVERAGE AT AIRPORT, IN FRONT OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND AT BEHESHT-E-ZARAH CEMETARY, WHERE KHOMEINI IS SCHEDULED TO SPEAK. TECHNICAL DIFFICULTIES PLAGUED ENTIRE 30-MINUTE BROADCAST, AND PROGRAM WAS PULLED OFF AIR JUST AS KHOMEINI ARRIVED AT TERMINAL AFTER DEPLANING. ANNOUNCER SAID LIVE COVERAGE WAS ENDING DUE TO TECHNICAL DIFFICULTIES, BUT ENTIRE PROGRAM WOULD BE FILMED AND SHOWN LATER (NO TIME GIVEN). | BEHESHT E ZARAH CEMETERY

label: BEHESHT E ZARA CEMETERY
summary: BEHESHT E ZARA CEMETERY | MASSIVE MILITARY PRESENCE COMBINED WITH RESTRAINT ON BOTH SIDES CREATED GENERALLY PEACEFUL MOURNING DAY IN MAJOR CITIES. LARGE CROWD GATHERED AT BEHESHT-E-ZARA CEMETARY OUTSIDE TEHRAN WHERE JALEH SQUARE VICTIMS ARE BURIED; TROOPS WATCHED WITHOUT INTERFERING, AND NO VIOLENCE RESULTED. SMALL DEMONSTRATION ON ELIZABETH BOULEVARD WAS DISPERSED WITHOUT INJURY. PRESS REPORTSD BRIEF, SPORADIC DEMONSTRATIONS WITH TOTAL 40 INJURED. ONE PAPER (ETELAAT) REPORTED VIOLENT CLASH LEAVING THREE DEAD, BUT GOI DENIES THIS, AND OTHER REPORTERS BELIEVE STORY FALSE. CONSULATES REPORT TABRIZ, KERMANSHAH, SHIRAZ AND ISFAHAN ALSO QUIET WITH NO DEMONSTRATIONS REPORTED. | ABOUT 1,000 STRIKING JOURNALISTS HELD RALLY AT BEHESHT-E-ZARA CEMETARY OUTSIDE TEHRAN DEC 22, ACCOMPANIED BY ABOUT 4,000 SYMPATHIZERS. TWENTY-TWO OPPOSITION MAJLIS DEPUTIES HAVE SENT LETTER TO STRIKERS ANNOUNCING THEIR SUPPORT. CEMETARY HAS BECOME FAVORITE RALLYING PLACE FOR PROTESTORS, PROBABLY DUE TO AUTHORITIES. RELUCTANCE TO INTERVENE. | DEMONSTRATIONS TOOK PLACE THROUGHOUT IRAN YESTERDAY. MAJOR TEHRAN CROWD NUMBERING MANY THOUSANDS ASSEMBLED AT BEHESHT-E-ZARA CEMETARY, BUT SMALLER GROUPS WERE ACTIVE IN VARIOUS PARTS OF TOWN. PRESS REPORTS TWO BANKS BURNED. GROUPS GENERALLY CONTINUED OLD TACTIC OF HIT AND RUN, SETTING FIRES IN STREETS. SNOW SINCE EARLY MORNING HAS BLANKETED CITY TODAY AND WE HAVE NO REPORTS OF ANY SIGNIFICANT INCIDENTS IN THE CITY AS OF NOON. | ON MORE IMPORTANT QUESTION OF KHOMEINI BEHAVIOR UPON HIS RETURN, MINATCHI TOLD US IN STRICTEST CONFIDENCE (MOST MEMBERS OF EITHER CAMP DO NOT KNOW) THAT KHOMEINI HAD WRITTEN SHARIATMADARI ASKING HIS VIEWS ON NAMING THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. SHARIATMADARI HAD REPLIED IN GOOD AYATOLLAHIC TRADITION THAT SUBJECT SHOULD BE DISCUSSED BY MAJOR AYATOLLAHS IN COUNTRY, AND KHOMEINI HAD AGREED. THEREFORE, PLANNING FOR KHOMEINI RETURN SEES HIM ARRIVING MORNING JAN 26 (MINATCHI PROMISED ETA LATER), PROCEEDING TO BEHESHT-E-ZARA CEMETARY (OUTSIDE TEHRAN CENTER), SPEAKING, THEN RETIRING TO A PREDETERMINED LOCATION TO AWAIT THE HOMAGE OF THE ULEMA. KHOMEINI WOULD REMAIN IN TEHRAN FOR TWO OR THREE DAYS, THEN SOJOURN TO QOM. | PLANS FOR HIS ARRIVAL ARE ESSENTIALLY THOSE WORKED OUT EARLIER (SEE REFTEL): KHOMEINI WILL ARRIVE, BE MET BY SELECT COMMITTEE THEN TAKEN TO BEHESHT-E-ZARA CEMETERY VIA SHAHYAD MONUMENT (SPEECH THERE). AFTER SPEECH AT CEMETERY, HE WOULD RETIRE TO HIS QUARTERS TO RECEIVE VISITS FROM IRAN'S ULEMA AND PERHAPS PRIME MINISTER BAKHTIAR AND CABINET. | BEHESHT E ZARA CEMETERY

BEHZADNIA ADDED, SOMEWHAT OMINOUSLY, THAT CLAIBOURNE OF THE WASHINGTON POST, HERE TEMPORARILY, AND THE REUTERS REPRESENTATIVE WOULD ALSO BE ASKED TO LEAVE. SOME FARSI LANGUAGE NEWSPAPERS MAY ALSO BE CLOSED, HE SAID. | BEHZADNIA

label: BOTHA
summary: BOTHA | FOREIGN SECRETARY OWEN AND SECRETARY VANCE WILL PRESENT THE SETTLEMENT PLAN TO SOUTH AFRICAN FOREIGN MINISTER BOTHA ON AUGUST 13 IN LONDON. THE FRONT LINE STATES, THE RHODESIAN NATIONALISTS AND THE SMITH REGIME WILL BE GIVEN THE PLAN THE FOLLOWING WEEK DURING A TRIP TO AFRICA BY OWEN WHERE HE WILL BE JOINED BY AMBASSADOR YOUNG. IT WOULD BE HELPFUL IF SECRETARY VANCE AND OWEN COULD IN THEIR CONVERSATION WITH BOTHA SPEAK WITH THE ASSURANCE THAT OUR CLOSEST ALLIES SUPPORT OUR PROPOSALS. FOR THIS REASON WE ARE APPROACHING THE FRENCH, GERMANS, CANADIANS AND IRANIANS. | WE HOPE THAT WE WILL RECEIVE THE COOPERATION OF THE SOUTH AFRICANS, THAT THE SETTLEMENT EFFORT WILL BE SUCCESSFUL AND THAT FURTHER SANCTION-RELATED ACTIONS WILL BE UNNECESSARY. (I) WE SHALL REPORT BACK TO THE SHAH THE RESULTS OF THE MEETING WITH BOTHA AND THE SUBSEQUENT PRESENTATIONS OF THE SETTLEMENT PROPOSALS TO THE OTHER PRINCIPAL PARTIES. WE DO NOT REQUEST ANY SPECIFIC IRANIAN ACTION OR STATEMENT ON THIS ISSUE AT THIS TIME. | (IN FACT, WE MUST STRESS THE CONFIDENTIALITY OF THE PRESENTATION TO HIM.) HOWEVER, BOTH FOREIGN SECRETARY OWEN AND SECRETARY VANCE WOULD FIND IT HELPFUL IF IN THEIR CONVERSATION WITH BOTHA THEY COULD EXPRESS THE IDEA THAT OUR CLOSEST FRIENDS,INCLUDING IRAN,SUPPORT OUR PROPOSALS. | THE SECRETARY'S AUGUST 12-13 MEETINGS IN LONDON MOVED US SOMEWHAT CLOSER TO FORMAL PRESENTATION OF THE RHODESIAN SETTLEMENT PROPOSALS. IN A SIX HOUR MEETING WITH SOUTH AFRICAN FOREIGN MINISTER BOTHA THE SECRETARY AND DR. OWEN OUTLINED THE PLAN AND URGED THAT SOUTH AFRICA USE ITS INFLUENCE ON SMITH. BOTHA ARGUED THAT THE PLAN SHOULD NOT BE FORMALLY PRESENTED UNTIL AFTER THE AUGUST 31 RHODESIAN ELECTIONS. THE TWO SECRETARIES REJECTED THIS ARGUMENT, THOUGH, IT NOW APPEARS THAT SNAGS IN THE PROPOSED PRESENTATION TIMETABLE MAKES PRESENTATION PRIOR TO AUGUST 31 UNLIKELY. | THE PLAN WILL NOT BE ATTRACTIVE ENOUGH TO THE WHITES, BOTHA LISTENED CAREFULLY AND ASKED NUMEROUS SERIOUS QUESTIONS. DURING THE COURSE OF THE MEETING IT WAS MADE CLEAR TO BOTHA THAT SHOULD SOUTH AFRICA NOT PROVE HELPFUL IN CONVINCING SMITH TO ACCEPT THE PROPOSALS, WE WOULD HAVE TO CONSIDER INCREASING PRESSURES ON THE SMITH REGIME WHICH WOULD INEVITABLY AFFECT THE SOUTH AFRICANS. (IN A PRIOR MEETING OWEN AND VANCE DETERMINED THAT THE POSSIBILITY OF A MANDATORY ARMS EMBARGO AGAINST SOUTH AFRICA BASED ON THE PREVIOUS CHAPTER VII FINDING ON THE RHODESIAN SITUATION AS A THREAT TO WORLD PEACE COULD BE PURSUED. OWEN AND VANCE HAD ALSO DISCUSSED POSSIBLE OIL-RELATED PRESSURES. | BOTHA

label: BSA
summary: BSA | BSA COUNCIL MEETS ON OCTOBER 19 TO ADDRESS QUESTION OF US PARTICIPATION IN JAMBOREE. IF US DECIDES NOT TO PARTICIPATE, PROSPECT IS THAT JAMBOREE WILL NOT TAKE PLACE. BSA IS VERY WORRIED ABOUT IRANIAN INTERNAL CONDITIONS AT THE TIME OF JAMBOREE, AND, TO SOMEWHAT LESSER EXTENT, ABOUT CRITICISM FROM HUMAN RIGHTS GROUPS AND PROBLEM OF AIR CHARTER ARRANGEMENTS (DCM NAAS IS FAMILIAR). BSA MUST MAKE COMMITMENTS FOR TRAVEL ARRANGEMENTS WITHIN A MATTER OF FEW WEEKS AND IF JAMBOREE IS SUBSEQUENTLY CANCELLED, COULD STAND TO LOSE UPWARDS OF DOLLARS 200 THOUSAND. BSA HAS NOT BEEN ABLE TO OBTAIN CANCELLATION INSURANCE FROM ANY INTERNATIONAL FIRM. | AT END OF MEETING, BSA REPS REMAINED CONCERNED AND WE AGREED TO SEEK EMBASSY ASSESSMENT AND POSSIBLE RECOMMENDATIONS AS TO WHETHER BSA SHOULD PROCEED. WE ALSO SUGGESTED THAT EMBASSY MIGHT WISH TO SOUND OUT DR. HOSSEIN BANAI, WHO IS RUNNING JAMBOREE FOR GOI, FOR HIS VIEWS. BSA REPS TOLD US THAT THEY WERE SERIOUSLY CONSIDERING THAT US RECOMMEND TO INTERNATIONAL SCOUT COUNCIL THAT A PRIVATE EMISSARY BE SENT TO GOI TO SUGGEST POSTPONEMENT OF JAMBOREE UNTIL 1983. THIS WOULD ENABLE GOI TO TAKE INITIATIVE TO POSTPONE CONFERENCE AND AVOID A LOSS OF FACE. | UNDER THESE CIRCUMSTANCES, IT MIGHT NOT BE ADVISABLE FOR EMBASSY TO APPROACH BANAI, W;HO MIGHT LATER BELIEVE THAT US WAS BEHIND PRESSURE TO POSTPONE IRANIAN GATHERING. WE PROMISED BSA REPS FURTHER REPLY BY NOON, OCTOBER 18. REGRET LIMITED TIME FOR CONSIDERATION OF THIS QUESTION, BUT WE ARE OBLIGED TO ADVISE BSA BEFORE COUNCIL MEETS ON OCTOBER 19. CHRISTOPHER | STRAIN AND STRESSES ON DECISION MAKERS MIGHT CAUSE A CHANGE IN GOI ATTITUDE HALF WAY THROUGH THE ENTERPRISE. NEVERTHELESS, WE DO NOT BELIEVE EMBASSY OR USG SHOULD BE PUT IN POSITION OF MAKING THIS DECISION FOR BSA AND IRANIAN GOVT. ABOVE SIMPLY REPRESENTS EMBASSY'S BEST READING OF THE SITUATION. | BSA

label: CHASE
summary: CHASE | PERHAPS COINCIDENTALLY, THREE OTHER RESTRAINING ORDER REQUESTS WERE FILED TODAY BY U.S. CLIENTS TO BLOCK ANY SIMILAR ATTEMPTS AT CALLING BONDS (TWO WITH CHASE AND ONE WITH MORGAN). OTHER COMPANIES HAVE RECENTLY TAKEN SIMILAR ACTION IN FEAR OF UNJUSTIFIED CALLS BEING MADE ON THEIR STAND-BY LETTERS OF CREDIT. | IN RESPONSE TO THAT INFORMATION, THE TEHRAN BANK REPLIED THAT IT CONSIDERED THE LOC TO BE IRREVOCABLE, THAT DUE TO SUSPENSION OF THE COUNTER INDEMNITY UNQUOTE IT IS NOW UNDER AN OBLIGATION TO PAY KWPA EVEN IN THE ABSENCE OF A DEMAND FOR PAYMENT BY KWPA, AND, FURTHER, THAT IF CHASE REFUSED TO PAY, BANK ETEBARATE WOULD CONTACT THE FINANCEMINISTRY AND THE CENTRAL BANK OF IRAN ABOUT THIS MATTER. MOREOVER, CHASE CONTENDS THAT THE INJUNCTION MAY NOT BE ENFORCED IN A FOREIGN COURT SHOULD ONE OF CHASE'S FOREIGN BRANCHES BE SUED FOR PAYMENT OF LOC. | VOLKER U.S. BANKS, PARTICULARLY CHASE AND CITIBANK, WERE STILL MAKING IT IMPOSSIBLE FOR IRAN'S COMMERCIAL BANKS TO OPERATE. WHEN ASKED CONCERNING EFFORTS TO FIND SOME MECHANISM FOR MEETING AT LEAST THE GOI'S EXTERNAL DEBT SERVICE, HE SAID HE WAS WORKING ON IT BUT THAT IT WOULD TAKE A MINIMUM OF 7 TO 10 DAYS. | V.P. WITH CHASE IN NY HE COULD BE IGNORANT OF BASIC U.S. BANKING LAWS. WE ARE INCLINED TO BELIEVE THAT A COMBINATION OF THE STRESSES HE IS FACING PLUS SOME CONVENIENT POSTURING (REFLECTING ALSO HIS CHASE/IBI PROBLEMS) EXPLAIN HIS IMPASSIONED QUERY AND PROTEST, PARTICULARLY SINCE A CHASE REP HAD DENIED THE RUMOR TO HIM ON JAN. 29 (REF C). | (B) CRITICISM OF U.S. BANKS BY PIRASTEH REFLECTS IN LARGE PART HIS TENSIONS WITH CHASE DUE TO HIS RELATIONSHIP WITH THE INTERNATIONAL BANK OF IRAN, OF WHICH HE IS STILL PRESIDENT. AS REPORTED IN REF B, PARA 3, HE IS SOMEWHAT COMPROMISED AS MINISTER BY THAT CONTINUING RESPONSIBILITY AS WELL AS LONG-STANDING DIFFERENCES WITH CHASE. CHASE REPS HERE REPORTED HIS ANGER WHEN IBI COULD NOT MAKE GOOD ON MORRISON-KNUDSEN AND GTE WITHDRAWAL REQUESTS TO MEET LOCAL RIAL OBLIGATIONS OWING TO INADEQUATE FUNDS, AGAINST WHICH THESE WITHDRAWALS WOULD BE MADE, IN ITS ACCOUNT WITH CHASE IN NY. | CHASE

label: COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM CDHRF
summary: COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM CDHRF | SUMMARY: CDHRF REPRESENTATIVES CALLED AT EMBASSY TO PRESENT LETTER TO MARK SCHNEIDER FOR TRANSMITTAL. LETTER SETS FORTH CDHRF VIEW OF SEPT 8 DEMONSTRATIONS. CDHRF REPS CONFIRMED ONE ADDITIONAL ARREST AND SUGGEST 20 POLITICAL TYPES AND 100 RELIGIOUS FIGURES HAVE BEEN ARRRESTED IN TEHRAN SINCE IMPOSITION OF MARTIAL LAW SEPT. 8. END SUMMARY. | ABBAS RADNIA AND HADI HARANDI, MEMBERS OF CDHRF, CALLED ON POLOFF STEMPEL MORNING SEPT. 14 TO ASK EMBASSY TO TRANSMIT LETTER TO MARK SCHNEIDER WHICH GIVES COMMITTEE'S VIEW OF SEPT. 8 RIOT (SEE REFTEL FOR EARLIER DESCRIPTION). LETTER, BEING POUCHED TO SCHNEIDER, CLAIMS 60,000 DEMONSTRATORS ASSEMBLED IN JALEH SQUARE MORNING SEPT 8 AND WERE SEATED WHEN ARMY FIRED "WITH NO WARNING." LETTER CLAIMS "SEVERAL THOUSANDS" WERE KILLED, THEN GIVE FIGURE 3,000 DEAD WITH MANY WOUNDED. LETTER THEN NOTES ARREST OF CDHRF'S EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE HEAD, ENG. MEHDI BAZARGAN AND SAYS THERE IS NOW NO POSSIBILITY OF ENFORCING INTERNATIONAL HUMAN RIGHTS CONVENTIONS. | IT CALLS ON SCHNEIDER TO "TAKE IMMEDIATE ACTION" TO PUT AN END TO THIS BRUTALITY AND INJUSTICE, AND REQUESTS THIS BE TRANSMITTED TO ALL HUMAN RIGHTS ASSOCIATIONS IN THE WORLD TO ASSIST CDHRF'S CAUSE. | PAIR ASKED IF EMBASSY WOULD TRANSMIT COPIES OF LETTER WITH SAME TEXT TO AMNESTY INTERNATIONAL, INTERNATIONAL RED CROSS, AND INTERNATIONAL LEAGUE OF HUMAN RIGHTS (OF WHICH CDHRF IS AN AFFILIATE). EMBOFF DECLINED, SAYING IT WOULD NOT BE APPROPRIATE TO DO SO, AND CDHRF REPS SAID THEY WOULD POST OTHER LETTERS FROM ABROAD. | RADNIA AND HARANDI CONFIRMED BAZARGAN'S ARREST AND ADDED NEW NAME TO LIST: ISLAMIC SCHOLAR GHAFFARI, A FREQUENT LECTURER AT LARGE MOSQUES WHO HAS BEEN ARRESTED BY SECURITY FORCES. THEY INDICATED THEIR OWN FIGURES SHOWED 20 "POLITICIANS" HAD BEEN ARRESTED AND ABOUT 100 RELIGIOUS PERSONS--MULLAHS AND OTHERS--IN TEHRAN. ACCORDING TO THEIR SOURCES, OTHER RELIGIOUS FIGURES WHERE BEING ARRESTED IN OTHER MARTIAL LAW CITIES, BUT THEY HAD NO ESTIMATES OF NUMBERS. CDHRF MEMBERS MINATCHI, SANJABI, LAHIDJI AND HAJ SEYED JAVADI REMAIN AT LARGE. | COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM CDHRF

label: CONSTITUTION
summary: CONSTITUTION | IN OUR VIEW, PROTECTION OF THE CONSTITUTION UNDERSCORES THE IMPORTANCE OF ORDERLY, ESTABLISHED PROCEDURES FOR DETERMINING IRAN'S FUTURE. EVERYONE--MILITARY, OPPOSITION AND THE PUBLIC AT LARGE -- SHOULD KNOW IN ADVANCE THE RULES THAT WILL GOVERN LIFE IN IRAN. THE CONSTITUTION SETS FORTH THOSE RULES. WE DO NOT BELIEVE EITHER THE MILITARY OR THE OPPOSITION SHOULD SEEK TO OVERTURN CONSTITUTIONAL PROCEDURES. TO THAT END, WE HAVE STRONGLY COUNSELED THE MILITARY AGAINST TAKING MATTERS INTO THEIR OWN HANDS. WE TAKE THE SAME POSITION IN OUR DISCUSSIONS WITH THE OPPOSITION. IF THE CONSTITUTIONAL FRAMEWORK IS DESTROYED, THE WAY IS OPENED TO THE TUDEH. | AS FOR THE CONSTITUTION, YAZDI CONTINUED, WHAT KHOMEINI HAS SAID REGARDING HIS PLANS TO ANNOUNCE A PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IS NOT AGAINST THE PRESENT CONSITUTION, WHICH PROVIDES THAT AUTHORITY COMES FROM THE NATION; THE NATION IS SOVEREIGN. THE CONSTITUTION IS CLEAR THAT AUTHORITY IS FROM THE PEOPLE; IT IS THROUGH A DELEGATION PROCESS THAT DIFFERENT BRANCHES OF GOVERNMENT, INCLUDING THE MONARCHY, CAN FUNCTION. THE WHOLE NATION HAS EXPRESSED ITS OPINIONS AND ITS VOTES AGAINST THE SHAH AND HAS FORCED HIS DEPARTURE. | IDEALLY, WE WOULD LIKE TO SEE AGREEMENT REACHED THAT FREE ELECTIONS WOULD BE HELD IN THE NEAR FUTURE TO ELECT A NEW MAJLIS AND A NEW SENATE. THIS PARLIAMENT WOULD THEN HAVE TWO TASKS; (A) TO SELECT A GOVERNMENT WHICH EVERYONE COULD AGREE WAS "LEGAL," AND (B) TO MEET TOGETHER JOINTLY AS PROVIDED BY THE CONSTITUTION AS A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY. THIS LATTER BODY WOULD EXAMINE THE CURRENT CONSTITUTION WITH A VIEW TO AMENDING IT, REPLACING IT WITH A NEW ONE, OR PRESERVING IT. THE OUTCOME OF THIS PROCESS WOULD DETERMINE WHETHER IRAN IN FUTURE WOULD BE A MONARCHY OR A REPUBLIC. | GOVERNMENT EFFORTS TO ASSUME AUTHORITY IN THE LAW ENFORCEMENT AREA CONTINUE TO BE STYMIED. CONSTITUTION TO BE PUBLICIZED SOON. ENTEZAM DESCRIBES RELATIONSHIP OF GUARDIANS OF THE REVOLUTION TO THE ARMED FORCES PRESENT COMMAND STRUCTURE. | CONSTITUTION

label: DABIRI
summary: DABIRI | POL-MIL COUNS DISCUSSED SPECIAL SESSION ON DISARMAMENT (SSOD) WITH FOURTH POLITICAL DEPARTMENT HEAD GOODARZNIA AND INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPARTMENT DEPUTY HEAD DABIRI (IN ABSENCE IO DEPARTMENT HEAD EHSASSI) MAY 11 DRAWING ON REFTEL. POL-MIL COUNS STRESSED US INTEREST IN HAVING SERIOUS, CONSTRUCTIVE SSOD THAT MIGHT LEAD TO EXPANDING ARMS CONTROL AREAS OF AGREEMENT, AS OPPOSED TO STERILE, PROPAGANDA EXERCISE FOCUSING ON DISAGREEMENTS, AND HOPED THAT OTHERS WHO SUPPORTED USEFUL SSOD WOULD WORK TO AVOID HAVING IT BECOME PROPAGANDA VEHICLE. | DABIRI SAID GOI SHARES US AIM FOR SSOD, AND PREPARED TO WORK FOR CONSTRUCTIVE RESULTS. DABIRI SAID HE WOULD REPORT DISCUSSION WITH POL-MIL COUNS "TO HIS SUPERIORS". DABIRI ASKED ABOUT POSSIBLE CHANGES IN DISARMAMENT MACHINERY WHICH ARE BEING DISCUSSED. POL-MIL COUNS SAID HE HAD BEEN AWAY FROM ARMS CONTROL FOR SEVERAL YEARS, BUT PERSONALLY FELT IT UNNECESSARY TO CREATE NEW FORUM; IMPORTANT THING WAS TO MAKE CONSTRUCTIVE AND SERIOUS USE OF CCD, AND AMPLE ALL AUTUMN OPPORTUNITY EACH YEAR FOR DISARMAMENT DISCUSSION IN UN, INCLUDING GENERAL ASSEMBLY GENERAL DEBATE AND MORE SPECIFICALLY IN FIRST COMMITTEE. | DABIRI AGREED ENTIRELY, AND WENT ON TO ASK ABOUT CO-CHAIRMAN ARRANGEMENT. POL-MIL COUNS SAID AGAIN HE COULD ONLY GIVE PERSONAL VIEW, TO WIT: THAT IF ONE GIVES UP THE CO-CHAIRMAN ARRANGEMENT ONE SHOULD GET SOMETHING IN EXCHANGE, AND IT SEEMED TO HIM THAT FRENCH (AND IDEALLY PRC) MEMBERSHIP IN THE ARMS CONTROL NEGOTIATING FORUM WOULD BE EXCELLENT RETURN IN EXCHANGE FOR GIVING UP CO-CHAIRMANSHIP. | POL-MIL COUNS CONCLUDED BY STRESSING US INTEREST IN CONSTRUCTIVE, NON-PROPAGANDISTIC SSOD. DABIRI AFFIRMED THAT GOI SHARED THIS AIM AND WOULD WORK TO ACHIEVE IT. | NADIM INFORMED US GOI IS PLANNING TO SEND AN OFFICIAL (DABIRI MFA INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS DEPARTMENT) TO BE PRESENT IN BELGRADE DURING CONFERENCE. ARRANGEMENTS HAVE BEEN MADE CONFIDENTIALLY FOR YOUGOSLAVS TO BRIEF HIM DAILY SO THAT HE CAN REPORT CONFERENCE EVENTS TO TEHRAN. | DABIRI

label: DAVOUDI
summary: DAVOUDI | POL COUNS CHECKED OUT UAE VISITS WITH MFA DEPARTMENT HEAD DAVOUDI NOVEMBER SEVENTEEN. HE NOTED ONE STORY THAT VISIT BY SHEIKH OF RAS AL-KHAIMAH HAD BEEN TO PREPARE ZAYID'S VISIT HERE; DAVOUDI SAID THE TWO VISITS WERE COINCIDENTAL AND HAD NO CONNECTION WITH EACH OTHER. | SITUATION IN THE GULF WAS DISCUSSED GENERALLY, ACCORDING TO DAVOUDI, BUT ALWAYS IN TERMS OF SUPPORT FOR PEACE IN THE GULF, DESIRE TO KEEP STUDYING PROBLEM OF TERRORISM, ETC. IRANIANS COULD DETECT NO CHANGE IN UAEG POSITION REGARDING COLLECTIVE SECURITY OF THE GULF AND, IN FACT, THE MATTER NEVER AROSE IN THOSE TERMS. DAVOUDI KNEW NOTHING ABOUT OREINTATION TOURS BY UAE PERSONNEL TO IRAN AND VICE VERSA (REF A), THOUGH HE DID NOT RULE THIS OUT. HE CHARACTERIZED THE VISIT AS ROUTINE, PERIODIC EXCHANGE WHICH MAINTAINED GENERALLY GOOD RELATIONS BUT DOES NOT REPRESENT ANY SPECIAL NEW POLICY DEPARTURES. | IN REPLY TO QUESTION, DAVOUDI SAID THERE WERE NO CURRENT PLANS FOR ANOTHER MEETING OF GULF STATES TO DISCUSS COLLECTIVE SECURITY. | COMMENT: WHILE DAVOUDI WAS CATEGORIC ABOUT THE MEETINGS HE ATTENDED, THIS DOES NOT RULE OUT BUSINESS BEING CONDUCTED DIRECTLY BETWEEN SHEIKH ZAYID AND THE SHAH OR INDIRECTLY THROUGH OTHERS IN ZAYID'S ENTOURAGE. label: DENMARK
summary: DENMARK | (NOTAL) SUMMARY. DANISH GOVERNMENT HANDLING OF THE IRANIAN DEMONSTRATORS WAS CONSISTENT WITH DANISH TRADITIONAL RESPONSE TO SUCH INCIDENTS. THE DANISH CHARACTER IS NON-CONFRONTATIONAL, AND THE GOVERNMENT IS PERHAPS MORE SENSITIVE THAN OTHERS TO CHARGES OF "ANTI-HUMANITARIANISM." PROTESTS IN TWO RECENT CASES INVOLVING THE DEPORTATION OF FOREIGN NATIONALS ARE STILL REVERBERATING. THE DANES--AND PROBABLY THE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR HERE-- WANTED TO AVOID A SIMILAR SITUATION IN THE CASE OF THE IRANIAN DEMONSTRATORS. WHAT REMAINS UNCERTAIN IS HOW THE DANISH GOVERNMENT WOULD REACT IF FACED WITH REAL VIOLENCE OR TERRORISM. END SUMMARY. | DURING A JANUARY 1 CONVERSATION, MFA POLITICAL DIRECTOR OLE BIERRING REITERATED TO POLCOUNCS DENMARK'S POSITION THAT THE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR HAD CONCURRED IN THE NON-PROSECUTION AND DEPORTATION OF IRANIAN DEMONSTRATORS BUT WAS OVERRULED BY TEHRAN. REPORTEDLY, THE CRIME WITH WHICH HE IS CHARGED IN FRANCE MIGHT RESULT IN THE DEATH PENALTY. THE DANES CONTINUE TO REFUSE EXTRADITION PENDING REQUESTED ASSURANCES FROM THE FRENCH THAT SUCH A PENALTY WOULD NOT BE LEVIED. | DENMARK

DERIAN OPINED THAT MANY OFFICIALS OF THE USG HAD ALREADY COMMENTED FULSOMELY ON THAT SITUATION, AND SHE DID NOT FEEL IT WAS USEFUL FOR HER TO COMMENT. SHE ALSO CITED THE RECENT ICJ VISIT AND POINTED OUT THAT THE USG HAS BEEN VERY CAREFUL ABOUT LISTENING TO ALL SIDES IN ISSUES OF HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATIONS. | ON THE FUTURE OF THE OAS AMERICAN HUMAN RIGHTS CONVENTION, DERIAN EXPLAINED THAT THIS IS A PRIORITY FOR THE CARTER ADMINISTRATION. THERE IS NO EVIDENCE VISIBLE FROM HERE THAT ANY SIGNIFICANT STEP-UP IN THE INSURGENCY WILL TAKE PLACE SOON, EVEN THOUGH HANDFUL OFHARDCORE PFLO CADRES REMAIN AT LARGE IN EASTERN DHOFAR MOUNTAINS. HOWEVER, SULTANATE FORCES SEEM UNABLE TO WEED THESE REBELS OUT. | DODSON SHOWED CHARGE SOLF'S STAFF REPORT ON THE APRIL 22 INCIDENT. AT MID-DAY A PLATOON-SIZE PATROL OF SOLF'S SOUTHERN BRIGADE CROSSED WADI SHUFLOON IN EASTERN DHOFAR (ON NORTHERN SIDE OF ESCARPMENT DUE NORTH OF MIRBAT) AND WAS FIRED UPON BY BAND OF PFLO FROM SURROUNDING HILLS. THIS IS THE GERNERAL AREA WHERE 55 OR SO HARD-CORE PFLO CADRES ARE KNOWN TO BE HANGING ON SINCE DEFEAT OF INSURGENCY IN LATE 1975. | CHARGE ALSO MENTIONED RECENT OMANGOV DECISION TO SWITCH DIRECTION OF PROJECTED EASTERN DHOFAR OIL PIPELINE FROM SOUTHWARD TO NORTHWARD (SEE MUSCAT 0465 NOTAL), NOTING THERE IS WIDESPREAD SPECULATION LOCALLY THAT DECISION RELATES SOMEHOW TO SECURITY. AGAIN, DODSON EXPRESSED PUZZLEMENT AS TO WHAT BAIS OF THIS CONCERN MIGHT BE. HOWEVER, HE DID REFER TO THE SULTANATE'S "FIRQA" TRIBAL LEVIES OPERATING IN THE DHOFAR MOUNTAINS (MAINLY FORMER PFLO REBELS) AS A WEAK LINK IN DHOFAR'S DEFENSES. THEIR FUNDAMENTAL LOYALTY IS UNCERTAIN. | CHARGE POINTED OUT THE RESURRECTED DESIGNATION "PFLOAG" IN THE FBIS ITEM, ASKING IF THERE WERE ANY SIGNIFICANCE IN IT. DODSON KNEW OF NONE, BUT SPECULATED THAT IT COULD SIGNAL A NEW PFLO STRATEGY THT SOLF HAS LONG HALF-EXPECTED, NAMELY A REDUCED EMPHASIS ON ARMED INSURGENCY IN DHOFAR AND A FOCUS ON TERRORISM IN NORTHERN OMAN AND THE COUNTRIES UP THE GULF. THERE WILL PROBABLY BE ANOTHER ONE AROUND JUNE 9, PFLO'S MAIN ANNIVERSARY AND A NATURAL OCCASION FOR PFLO-INITIATED INCIDENTS. THERE IS NO EVIDENCE VISIBLE FROM HERE THAT ANY SIGNIFICANT STEP-UP IN THE INSURGENCY WILL TAKE PLACE SOON, EVEN THOUGH HANDFUL OFHARDCORE PFLO CADRES REMAIN AT LARGE IN EASTERN DHOFAR MOUNTAINS. HOWEVER, SULTANATE FORCES SEEM UNABLE TO WEED THESE REBELS OUT. | DODSON SHOWED CHARGE SOLF'S STAFF REPORT ON THE APRIL 22 INCIDENT. AT MID-DAY A PLATOON-SIZE PATROL OF SOLF'S SOUTHERN BRIGADE CROSSED WADI SHUFLOON IN EASTERN DHOFAR (ON NORTHERN SIDE OF ESCARPMENT DUE NORTH OF MIRBAT) AND WAS FIRED UPON BY BAND OF PFLO FROM SURROUNDING HILLS. THIS IS THE GERNERAL AREA WHERE 55 OR SO HARD-CORE PFLO CADRES ARE KNOWN TO BE HANGING ON SINCE DEFEAT OF INSURGENCY IN LATE 1975. | CHARGE ALSO MENTIONED RECENT OMANGOV DECISION TO SWITCH DIRECTION OF PROJECTED EASTERN DHOFAR OIL PIPELINE FROM SOUTHWARD TO NORTHWARD (SEE MUSCAT 0465 NOTAL), NOTING THERE IS WIDESPREAD SPECULATION LOCALLY THAT DECISION RELATES SOMEHOW TO SECURITY. AGAIN, DODSON EXPRESSED PUZZLEMENT AS TO WHAT BAIS OF THIS CONCERN MIGHT BE. HOWEVER, HE DID REFER TO THE SULTANATE'S "FIRQA" TRIBAL LEVIES OPERATING IN THE DHOFAR MOUNTAINS (MAINLY FORMER PFLO REBELS) AS A WEAK LINK IN DHOFAR'S DEFENSES. THEIR FUNDAMENTAL LOYALTY IS UNCERTAIN. | CHARGE POINTED OUT THE RESURRECTED DESIGNATION "PFLOAG" IN THE FBIS ITEM, ASKING IF THERE WERE ANY SIGNIFICANCE IN IT. DODSON KNEW OF NONE, BUT SPECULATED THAT IT COULD SIGNAL A NEW PFLO STRATEGY THT SOLF HAS LONG HALF-EXPECTED, NAMELY A REDUCED EMPHASIS ON ARMED INSURGENCY IN DHOFAR AND A FOCUS ON TERRORISM IN NORTHERN OMAN AND THE COUNTRIES UP THE GULF. THEME IS THAT PEACE PREVAILS IN DHOFAR MARRED ONLY NW AND THEN BY INCIDENTS LIKE THIS ONE. label: DJAM
summary: DJAM | DJAM FEELS THAT MILITARY LEADERSHIP WAS LACKING AND MILITARY SHOULD HAVE DEALT MORE FIRMLY AT OUTSET WITH DISORDERS. HE WAS CRITICAL OF MANNER IN WHICH TROOPS HANDLED DEMONSTRATIONS, PARTICULARLY THE RESORT TO FIRING INTO AND OVER THE HEAD OF THE MOBS. HE IS ESPECIALLY CONCERNED OVER THE IMPACT WHICH SHAH'S DEPARTURE WILL HAVE ON MORALE OF MILITARY. DJAM EXPLAINED THAT IN HIS OPINION IT WAS A MISTAKE FOR SHAH TO LEAVE AND, IF NECESSARY, HE SHOULD HAVE MOVED TO ANOTHER SECTION OF THE COUNTRY (E.G., KHUZISTAN) WHERE HE COULD HAVE ESTABLISHED A STRONG BASE AND ENSURED THE SECURITY OF THAT VITAL SECTION OF THE NATION. | DJAM EXPLAINED THAT HE HAD NOT ACCEPTED THE POST OF MINISTER OF WAR FOR SEVERAL REASONS, PARTICULARLY THE POOR PROSPECTS FOR THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, THE FACT THAT THE ROLE OF THE MOW IS ESSENTIALLY CONCERNED WITH ADMINISTRATIVE MATTERS AND NOT WITH DEFENSE MATTERS, AND THE EXTENT TO WHICH THE SHAH WOULD DELEGATE AUTHORITY FOR THE CONTROL OF THE MILITARY. ON THIS LATTER POINT, DJAM SAID THAT ALTHOUGH HE HAD ADVISED THE PALACE IN ADVANCE THAT HE CONSIDERED THE QUESTION OF CONTROL A BIG FACTOR, THE SHAH DID NOT RAISE THE SUBJECT WITH HIM. | DJAM WENT ON TO SAY THAT A NUMBER OF THE YOUNGER GENERAL OFFICERS (I.E., BGS) AND COLONELS HAD URGED HIM TO RETURN AND TAKE OVER A LEADERSHIP ROLE IN THE MILITARY. HOWEVER, HE FELT THAT WITHOUT THERE BEING ADEQUATE DELEGATION OF AUTHORITY, THE NECESSARY SUPPORT WOULD BE LACKING. | DEVELOPING TRENDS AND RESTORATION OF STABILITY. DJAM IS EXTREMELY PESSIMISTIC OVER THE PROSPECTS FOR RESTORATION OF STABILITY AND FEELS THAT IF THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT IS DEPOSED AND KHOMEINI'S ISLAMIC REPUBLIC IS INSTALLED, THE COMMUNISTS COULD TAKE OVER OR THE COUNTRY COULD BECOME EMBROILED IN A CIVIL WAR AND IRAN COULD BE "ANOTHER LEBANON." IN COMMENTING ON THE SITUATION, HE REFERRED TO IRAN'S 1907 TREATY WITH RUSSIA AND IS APPREHENSIVE THAT THE SOVIETS WILL USE SAME AS A JUSTIFICATION FOR ANY INTERVENTION. | AS FOR A MILITARY TAKEOVER, DJAM REFERRED TO THE FAILURE OF THE AZHARI GOVERNMENT AND FELT THAT THERE WAS LITTLE TO BE GAINED. AS NOTED ABOVE, HE FELT THAT WITH THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH, THERE IS A VOID IN THE CONTROL OF THE MILITARY. | DJAM

HE SAID THAT IRAN HAD TRADITIONALLY SEEN THE U.S. AS THE MESSENGER OF FREEDOM, BUT THAT U.S. ACTIONS IN VIETNAM AND ELSEWHERE IN RECENT YEARS HAD RAISED IMAGE OF U.S. AS COLONIST AND EXPLOITING POWER. | CHARGE COMMENTED THAT IN MATTER OF IRAN, U.S. OFFICIAL POLICY WAS PROBABLY AHEAD OF PUBLIC OPINION SINCE LATTER GENERALLY HAD INADQUATE KNOWLEDGE OF EVENTS IN IRAN. GHAFFOURI SAID THAT IRAN WAS NOW WORKING TO SHOW THE WORLD A NEW AND GENUINE FACE OF ISLAM--A FACE IN WHICH GOVERNMENT SHOULD BE THE SERVANT OF HUMANITY RATHER THAN ITS MASTER. HE SAID SUCH ISLAM WAS DIFFERENT FROM ISLAM AS IT IS NOW PRACTICED IN AFRICA, AMONG THE U.S. MUSLIMS, AND IN SAUDI ARABIA, WHICH CALLS ITSELF ISLAMIC. | DR. GHAFFOURI SAID THAT IRAN COULD OVERLOOK THE FACT THAT THE U.S. HAD SUPPORTED THE SHAH MILITARILY AND THAT THE TWO PILLARS OF THE SHAH'S STRENGTH WERE A U.S.-TRAINED AND SUPPLIED ARMY AT HOME AND AMERICAN DIPLOMATIC SUPPORT ABROAD. label: DR HEJAZI
summary: DR HEJAZI | HIS ROLE IS TO WIN OVER THE TOP RELIGIOUS LEADERS, ESPECIALLY IN QOM. HE REFUSED TO CREDIT POL COUNSELOR'S SUGGESTION THAT THERE ARE A NUMBER OF OTHER INTERMEDIARIES APPARELLY WORKING ON THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS, SAYING ZAHEDI HAD BEEN TOLD POINT BLANK BY DR. HEJAZI (A TEHRAN LEADER WHO, WE KNOW, IS IN TOUCH WITH KHOMEINI'S GROUP IN PARIS, AS WELL AS WITH THE LOCAL RELIGIOUS LEADERS) THAT THIS INTERMEDIARY WAS THEIR ONLY RECOGNIZED REPRESENTATIVE IN DEALING WITH THE COURT. THE INTERMEDIARY IS CONTINUING THE BUSY ROUND OF CONSULTATIONS WITH VARIOUS LEADERS, REPORTING BACK TO THE EMPRESS FROM TIME TO TIME. | COMMENT: THE LIFE OF A NEW PRIME MINISTER IS NOT AN EASY ONE. ACCORDING TO ANOTHER INTERMEDIARY, BAKHTIAR WAS ON THE TELEPHONE TO DR. HEJAZI MORNING JAN 7, PLEADING FOR SUPPORT FROM THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS IN THE COUNTRY. WE HAVE NOW HAD THREE SEPARATE REPORTS, HOWEVER, DENIGRATING WITH SPECIFICS DIFFERENT INDIVIDUALS CHOSEN BY BAKHTIAR FOR HIS CABINET. EQBAL AND DERAKHSHESH AGREED ON THE MINISTER OF EDUCATION BEING SAVAK. HEJAZI, A SPOKESMAN FOR THE RELIGIOUS MODERATES, AND THE QUEEN. HE TOLD POL COUNSELOR ABOUT A WEEK AGO THAT RELIGIOUS MODERATES HAD LISTED THEIR DEMANDS IN WRITING, WHICH DID NOT INCLUDE THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH, JUST CONSTITUTIONAL RULE. A FEW DAYS AGO HE SAID HE WAS GOING TO BE WORKING CLOSELY WITH ZAHEDI. | SOURCE WITH ACCESS, BUT NOT ESPECIALLY IMPRESSIVE TRACK RECORD, TOLD POL COUNSELOR JAN 17 THAT RELIGIOUS MOVEMENT'S DR. HEJAZI SAW SHARIAT-MADARI IN QOM A DAY OR TWO AGO. SHARIAT-MADARI TOLD HIM A. KHOMEINI WILL RETURN TO IRAN NEXT SATURDAY OR SUNDAY (JAN 20 OR 21). | DR HEJAZI

summary: DR HOSSEIN BANAI | AT END OF MEETING, BSA REPS REMAINED CONCERNED AND WE AGREED TO SEEK EMBASSY ASSESSMENT AND POSSIBLE RECOMMENDATIONS AS TO WHETHER BSA SHOULD PROCEED. label: DR IBRAHIM ZADEH
summary: DR IBRAHIM ZADEH | SUMMARY. THE MEAF IS STILL HIGHLY POLITICIZED WITH LITTLE WORK OCCURRING. UNDER SECRETARY DR. AHMAD KOOROS (ALSO KUROS) WAS SUMMARILY DISMISSED ON APRIL 24 AND REPLACED BY DR. IBRAHIM-ZADEH. THAT AND SEVERAL OTHER SEPARATIONS ADD TO THE SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER OF REFUGEES RETURNING TO THE CENTRAL BANK, WHERE THEY HAVE CAREER PROTECTION. THE MEAF'S REVOLUTIONARY KOMITAY CONTINUES TO EXERCISE SUBSTANTIAL POWER. REVOLUTIONARY SUSPICION OF AUTHORITY EXTENDS EVEN TO THE DIRECTOR GENERAL LEVEL AND ERRODES EFFORTS TO REESTABLISH DISCIPLINE. END SUMMARY. | IN DR. KOOROS, THE EMBASSY HAD A SUBSTANTIAL FRIEND AND FOUND IN HIM CONSIDERABLE EXPERTISE CONCERNING IRAN'S ECONOMY. HE WAS, HOWEVER, FEARFUL OF ANY CONTACT WITH THE EMBASSY SINCE THE REVOLUTION. AS OF APRIL 24 HIS CHAIR IS OCCUPIED BY DR. IBRAHIM-ZADEH, A NEW ADVISOR TO MEAF MINISTER ARDALAN AND EX-PROFESSOR OF ECONOMIC AND MATHEMATICS AT THE UNIVERSITY OF TEHRAN (SEE REFTEL). label: DR MEHR
summary: DR MEHR | AT THE INVITATION OF DR. MEHR, A LONG-TIME ACQUAINTANCE, JOINED HIM FOR LUNCH AT THE MEHRS' COMFORTABLE TEHRAN RESIDENCE. IN DISCUSSING THE ZOROASTRIAN LO, HE MADE THE FOLLOWING POINTS: --THERE ARE ABOUT 15,000 IN THE TEHRAN COMMUNITY. PRACTICALLY ALL ARE ENGAGED IN COMMERCE, BUYING AND SELLING PROPERTY, PRIVATE ENTREPRENEURSHIP. THE ECONOMIC SLOWDOWN HAS, OF COURSE, SEVERELY AFFECTED THESE PEOPLE, MOST OF WHOM ARE SEEKING WAYS TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY. --THE THREE ZONE OASTRIAN TEMPLES IN TEHRAN HAVE NOT BEEN DISTURBED AND SERVICES ARE CONTINUING WITH NORMAL TURNOUTS. THE COMMUNITY OPERATES SIX PRIVATE SCHOOLS IN THE CITY FROM PRIMARY THROUGH SECONDARY. | OF THE APPROXIMATELY 3,000 STUDENT ENROLLMENT, 95 PERCENT ARE NON-ZOROASTRIANS, MAINLY ARMENIAN CHRISTIANS AND SOME MUSLIMS. THREE MONTHS AGO, THE MINISTRY OF EDUCATION THREATENED TO CLOSE THESE SCHOOLS ALONG WITH OTHER PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS. SINCE THAT TIME, NOTHING FURTHER HAS BEEN HEARD AND DR. MEHR BELIEVES OPERATIONS WILL CONTINUE. AT THE PRIMARY LEVEL, BOYS AND GIRLS ATTEND CLASSES TOGETHER, BUT NOT IN SECONDARY SCHOOL. --THE MOST TROUBLING INTRUSIONS IN THE LIFE OF THE COMMUNITY DO NOT COME FROM MUSLIMS, ACCORDING TO DR. MEHR, BUT FROM DISAFFECTED ZOROASTRIAN YOUTH WHO HAVE RETURNED FROM THE U.S. | AND EUROPE FILLED WITH LEFTIST VIEWS AND WHO SEEK TO MODIFY THEIR RELIGION IN SUCH A WAY AS TO MAKE IT CORRESPOND TO SOME FORM OF MARXISM, A VERY NEAT TRICK, GIVEN ITS EHEREALNESS, SAYS DR. MEHR. --COMMUNITY REPRESENTATIVES HAVE BEN RECEIVED BY AYATOLLAHS KHOMEINI AND TALEGHANI. BOTH SESSIONS WERE MARKED BY POLITENESS AND ASSURANCES AGAINST DISCRIMINATION. IT IS MEHR'S BELIEF, HOWEVER, THAT NEITHER AYATOLLAH HAS THE SLIGHTEST UNDERSTANDING OF THE RELIGION, WHICH MAY BE FOR THE BEST. | DR MEHR

label: DR MINATCHI
summary: DR MINATCHI | DR. MINATCHI OF COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF) TELEPHONED EMBOFF LATE SEPT. 20 TO SAY SENIOR MILITARY FIGURE IN MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION IN QOM HAD CALLED AT AYATOLLAH SHARIATMADARI RESIDENCE TO INFORM CDHRF MEN STAYING THERE (REF B) THAT THEY WERE FREE TO GO AND RESUME THEIR ACTIVITIES, AND THAT ALL MEMBERS OF GROUP WHO WERE STILL IN CUSTODY WERE BEING RELEASED. MINATCHI CONFIRMED RELEASE OF BAZARGAN, ENG. MOGHADDAN, ZARENEBAH BROTHERS, AND MSSRS. MORTAZAVI AND MANIAN. MINATCHI SAID CDHRF WAS TOLD IT COULD REOPEN ITS OFFICE IN TEHRAN, WHICH IT PLANS TO DO SAT. SEPT. 23. | SUMMARY: IN COMPANY OF WASHINGTON VISITORS EMOBFFS SPOKE WITH DR. MINATCHI AS WELL AS LIBERATION MOVEMENT OF IRAN (LMI) LEADERS. THEIR REACTIONS TO MILITARY TAKEOVER ARE SUBSTANTIALLY DIFFERENT. MINATCHI BELIEVES STEP MAY WORK IF MILITARY GOVERNMENT IS SUCCEEDED BY NATIONAL COALITION GOVERNMENT WITHIN SHORTEST TIME POSSIBLE. LMITLEADERSHIP MAINTAINS ABSOLUTELY RIGID VERBAL ADHERENCE TO KHOMEINI LINE AND INSISTS SHAH MUST GO. LMI WOULD NOT PARTICIPATE IN COALITION GOVERNMENT UNLESS KHOMEINI APPROVED IT AND CLAIMS "PEOPLE" WILL NEVER ACCEPT MILITARY GOVERNMENT. LMI CLAINS NO ONE WILL PARTICIPATE IN COALITION GOVERNMENT IF KHOMEINI CONTINUES TO OPPOSE IT. END SUMMARY. | DR. MINATCHI, TREASURER OF IRANIAN COMMITTEE FOR DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF) TOLD EMBOFF STEMPEL LATER ON NOV 16, IN CONFIDENCE, THAT SANJABI IS IN TEHRAN'S JAMSHIDABAD MILITARY PRISON "ALONG WITH ALL THE OTHER EX/MINISTERS WHO WERE ARRESTED." HIS WIFE VISITS HIM REGULARLY. MINATCHI DESCRIBED CONDITIONS AS "VERY GOOD." IN FACT, MINATCHI SAID SANJABI HAD BEEN HAVING CONVERSATIONS WITH THE GOVERNMENT AND DESCRIBED SITUATION AS "VERY SATISFACTORY." HE SAID HE WOULD REPORT FURTHER TO EMBOFF ON SATURDAY, NOV 25. | SUMMARY: DR. MINATCHI TOLD EMBOFF PROPOSAL FOR A REGENCY COUNCIL IS BEING PUT TO LEADING KHOMEINI REPRESENTATIVES DEC 4, THEY WILL GO TO PARIS TO CONVINCE KHOMEINI, WITH PRESSURE IF NECESSARY TO ACCEPT THEM. MINATCHI HAD HEARD RUMOR SHAH MIGHT BE READY TO AGREE TO REGENCY COUNCIL. ALI AMINI HAD TOLD MINATCHI"FOREIGN MILITARY ADVISERS" HAD SAID MILITARY COMMANDERS WOULD NOT AGREE TO DEPARTURE OF SHAH AND SAID IF COUNCIL IDEA ADOPTED, SHAH WOULD HAVE TO CHANGE MILITARY COMMANDER. EMBOFF DENIED U.S. ADVISERS WOULD HAVE MADE SUCH STATEMENTS. MINATCHI SAID OPPOSITION WOULD ACCEPT PRESENT ARMED SERVICES HEADS ON REGENCY COUNCIL. | SUMMARY: DR. MINATCHI TOLD EMBOFF RELIGIOUS AND POLITICAL OPPOSITION HAVE DEVELOPED ARRANGEMENT WITH GOI FOR PEACEFUL MARCH DEC 10. OPPOSITION DOESN'T TRUST GOI TO KEEP ARMY FROM PROVOKING DISTURBANCES. VARIOUS OPPOSITION LEADERS HAVE AGREED TO MEET DEC. 12 TO HAMMER OUT LIST FOR REGENCY COUNCIL AND CABINET TO PUT BEFORE KHOMEINI, AND IF HE APPROVES, BEFORE SHAH. COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFENSE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM (CDHRF) WILL GIVE EMBASSY LETTER TO PRESIDENT CARTER DEC. 9 END SUMMARY. | DR MINATCHI

DANES AND DUTCH WERE RELIEVED AND WILL TAKE SAME DECISION TOMORROW RE THEIR DEPENDENTS. HINTON | THE FRENCH FOREIGN MINISTER BELIEVED THAT EVENTS IN IRAN SERVED TO INCREASE THE FEELINGS OF INSECURITY IN ISRAEL AND EGYPT. HEIGHTENED INSECURITY WOULD ALSO RENDER MORE DIFFICULT CONCLSUION OF THE BROADER MID EAST SETTLEMENT ENVISAGED AT CAMP DAVID. FRANCOIS-PONCET SAID THAT THESE CIRCUMSTANCES COMPLICATE DEFINITION OF AN EC POSTURE IF THE ISRAELI-EGYPTIAN AGREEMENT IS CONCLUDED. HE ADDED THAT FOUR MONTHS AGO THE EC COULD SIMPLY HAVE APPLAUDED CONCLUSION OF THEAT AGREEMENT BUT NOW THE APPROPRIATE EC RESPONSE WAS UNCLEAR. | EC

label: EMB
summary: EMB | IN AN ATTEMPT TO KEEP THE RUMORS*UNDER CONTROL THE EMB HAS ISSUED THE FOLLOWING SECURITY ADVISORY TO TEHRAN AND THE CONSULATES: "DURING THE UP-COMING WEEKEND THE AMERICAN COMMUNITY SHOULD OBSERVE NORMAL PRECAUTIONARY PROCEDURES, LIMIT MOVEMENT, AND AVOID CROWDS. "THIS IS A PRECAUTIONARY ANNOUNCEMENT AND WE WISH TO STRESS THAT THERE IS NO, REPEAT NO, EVIDENCE THAT THERE WILL BE DISORDERS. RUMORS APPEAR TO BE JUST THAT--RUMORS." | TEHRAN 10441 SUMMARY: WEEKEND PASSED QUIETLY DESPITE RUMORS OF ACTION AGAINST FOREIGNERS. EMB BELIEVES TERRORIST THREAT REMAINS STABLE. GROWING NUMBERS OF DEMONSTRATORS IN STREET COUPLED WITH ANTI-FOREIGN ATTITUDE HAS HIGHTENED POSSIBILITY FOR INCIDENTS INVOLVING AMERICAN AND OTHER FOREIGNS. | SINCE ARMISH/MAAG WILL HAVE COMMITTED ITS LIMITED GROUND TRANSPORTATION TO THE TRANSPORTING OF EVACUEES FROM THE DOCUMENTATION CENTERS TO THE AIRPORT, THE EMB IS OF THE OPINION THAT IT WOULD BE MOST WISE TO PREPOSITION 20-30 FORTY-PASSENGER BUSSES IN GERMANY FOR QUICK TRANSPORT BY C-5. THERE ARE AREAS AND STREETS IN TEHRAN WHERE BUSSES OF THIS SIZE WOULD HAVE DIFFICULTY MANEUVERING, BUT IN THOSE CASES PRIVATE VEHICLES OR MINI-BUSSES AVAILABLE AT THE EMB WOULD BE USED. | THE USE OF DRIVERS FAMILIAR WITH TEHRAN TRAFFIC AND STREETS IS A MUST AND, IF THE PREPOSITIONING OF BUSSES CONCEPT IS ACCEPTABLE, THE EMB WILL REQUEST ARMISH/MAAG TO IDENTIFY AND TRAIN ENLISTED MEN TO DRIVE THE VEHICLES. --C. THE EMB HAS BEEN ADVISED THAT IT WOULD TAKE TWELVE HOURS FOR THE FIRST MAC AIRCRAFT TO ARRIVE AT TEHRAN. BY THAT TIME THE DOCUMENTATION CENTERS SHOULD BE FULLY OPERATIONAL AND READY TO TRANSPORT THE FIRST EVACUEES TO THE AIRPORT. | IN REALITY, THE EMB BELIEVES IT COULD HAVE THE FIRST EVACUEES READY FOR BOARDING AIRCRAFT WITHIN SIX HOURS AFTER AN EVACUATION ANNOUNCEMENT PROVIDED THE EVACUATION CAN BE MANAGED IN A PHASED AND ORDERLY MANNER, I.E., THAT WE DO NOT GO INTO A IMMEDIATE PHASE III. FROM THE EMBASSY'S POINT OF VIEW A PHASED EVACUATION UNDER CONTROLLED CONDITIONS IS AN ABSOLUTE MUST IF WE ARE TO AVOID TOTAL CONFUSION. MOST CERTAINLY WE CANNOT CONSIDER HAVING EVERYONE GO DIRECTLY TO THE AIRPORT WITHOUT PRIOR PROCESSING. --D. | EMB

summary: ESLAMINIA | AS FOLLOW UP TO EARLIER CONVERSATION WITH ESLAMINIA (SEE SEPTEL), POL COUNSELOR VISITED DEPUTY MINISTER OF COURT PAKRAVAN TO INQUIRE INTO ESLAMINIA'S 1963 ACTIVITIES AND CREDENTIALS. PAKRAVAN, WHO IS FORMER HEAD OF SAVAK AND FORMER AMBASSADOR TO FRANCE AND OTHER PLACES, IS INTERESTINGLY ENOUGH ONE OF THOSE RARE SOURCES WHO WILL USUALLY GIVE US TRUTHFUL ANSWERS TO A QUESTION. HE DID NOT WISH TO GO INTO DETAIL ABOUT WHAT HAPPENED IN 1963, BUT SAID ESLAMINIA WAS AN EXTREMELY CAPABLE MAN AND VERY EFFECTIVE AMONG THE RELIGIOUS EOPLE. label: EXIMBANK
summary: EXIMBANK | IN VIEW OF CURRENT ECONOMIC AND POLITICAL CONDITIONS, EXIMBANK, WITH THE DEPARTMENT OF STATE'S CONCURRENCE, HAS TAKEN THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS WITH REGARD TO ITS PROGRAMS IN IRAN. THESE ACTIONS ARE NOT INTENDED AS DISAPPROVAL OF THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT, BUT RATHER TO MINIMIZE POTENTIAL LOSSES BY EXIMBANK AND U.S. EXPORTERS. NEW REQUESTS FOR ASSISTANCE UNDER BOTH DIRECT CREDIT AND SUPPLIER CREDIT PROGRAMS WILL BE DISCOURAGED AT THIS TIME. IN ADDITION, EXIMBANK WILL BE TAKING THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS WITH REGARD TO EXISTING COMMITMENTS. THEY ARE EXPECTED TO HAVE THEIR GREATEST IMPACT ON SUPPLIER CREDIT PROGRAMS WHICH ARE ALMOST EXCLUSIVELY CONCENTRATED IN IRAN.S PRIVATE SECTOR. | WITH REGARD TO THE SUPPLIER CREDIT PROGRAMS, EXIMBANK HAS WITHDRAWN ALL AUTHORITY PREVIOUSLY DELEGATED TO COMMERCIAL BANKS, U.S. EXPORTERS AND THE FOREIGN CREDIT INSURANCE ASSOCIATION (FCIA) TO COMMIT EXIMBANK COVERAGE ON SHORT- AND MEDIUM-TERM TRANSACTIONS IN IRAN. THIS MEANS THAT ALL TRANSACTIONS MUST BE SUBMITTED TO EXIMBANK YOR ITS CONSIDERATION. AT PRESENT, GUARANTEE AND INSURANCE COMMITMENTS WITH POTENTIAL EXIMBANK EXPOSURE OF $48.7 MILLION ARE AVAILABLE TO COVER NEW SHIPMENTS TO IRAN. EXIMBANK WILL REVIEW EACH INSURANCE POLICY OR GUARANTEE WITH THE U.S. EXPORTER, AND, ON A CASEBY-CASE BASIS, MAY WITHDRAW COVERAGE. | WITH REGARD TO THE DIRECT LENDING PROGRAM, EXIMBANK HAS TAKEN THE FOLLOWING ACTIONS | NO ACTION WILL BE TAKEN ON THE PENDING LOAN APPLICATION FROM IRAN AIR YOR FIVE BOEING 747 AIRCRAFT. IRAN AIR SHOULD APPROACH EXIMBANK WHEN COUNTRY CONDITIONS HAVE IMPROVED. | NO ACTION WILL BE TAKEN ON EXIMBANK CREDIT NO. 6559 WHICH WAS AUTHORIZED ON SEPTEMBER 20, 1978 FOR THE NATIONAL IRANIAN STEEL INDUSTRIES CORPORATION (NISIC). A DRAFT CREDIT AGREEMENT WAS SUBMITTED IN OCTOBER TO NISIC AND THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT FOR REVIEW. COMMENTS HAVE NOT BEEN RECEIVED BY EXIMBANK. | EXIMBANK

label: FEMALE STUDENTS
summary: FEMALE STUDENTS | ON OCTOBER 16, IN MID-MORNING, A GROUP OF APPROXIMATELY 100 MALE STUDENTS FROM THE FACULTIES OF ARTS, SOCIAL SCIENCES, AND SCIENCES BEGAN A DEMONSTRATION DEMANDING A RETURN TO TRADITIONALLY RELIGIOUS VALUES. THEY THREATENED A NUMBER OF FEMALE STUDENTS, TELLING THEM THAT THEY SHOULD NOT GO UNVEILED, SHOULD NOT ASSOCIATE WITH MALE STUDENTS IN CLASSROOMS OR DINING FACILITIES, AND SHOULD NOT BE ATTENDING UNIVERSITY. AT LUNCH TIME, THEY ATTEMPTED TO BLOCK THE ENTRANCE OF FEMALE STUDENTS TO THE SELF-SERVICE CO-ED DINING HALL, BUT WERE PREVENTED FROM DOING SO BY OTHER STUDENTS. THEY THEN INVADED THE BUILDING OF THE FACULTY OF LETTERS, WHERE THEY BEGAN TO BREAK WINDOWS AND DESTROY DOCUMENTS. | FARSI AND FOREIGN LANGUAGE PRESS WEDNESDAY OCT 12 CARRIED STORY OF DEMONSTRATIONS BY SOME 20 MASKED STUDENT EXTREMISTS WHO BROKE WINDOWS, DAMAGED THREE BUSES AND BURNED ANOTHER, AND THREATENED FEMALE STUDENTS WITH BODILY HARM IF THEY TRIED TO EAT AT SELF-SERVICE CAFETERIA IN MEN'S DORMITORY OR TO USE THE MEN'S BUS. LEAFLETS PASSED OUT CALLED UPON FEMALE STUDENTS TO PUT PRESSURE ON UNIVERSITY ADMINISTRATORS TO DEMAND A SEPARATE SELF-SERVIDE RESTAURANT AND A SEPARATE BUS. | FEMALE STUDENTS

label: FERDOWSI UNIVERSITY
summary: FERDOWSI UNIVERSITY | ONE GUARD WAS KILLED AND TWO OTHERS INJURED JUNE 18 WHEN, ACCORDING TO THE PRESS, A GROUP OF 15 MARKED STUDENTS ATTACKED THE SECURITY OFFICE AT FERDOWSI UNIVERSITY IN MASHAD. THE ATTACKERS REPORTEDLY FIRST SET FIRE TO THE UNIVERSITY GENERATOR AND THEN ATTACKED THE GUARD'S OFFICE WITH MOLOTOV COCKTAILS. | HE HAS SERVED AS DEPARTMENT HEAD AT PAHLAVI HOSPITAL AND BECAME HEAD OF STUDENT AFFAIRS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY IN 1968. PROGRESSIVE WING LEADER MOJDEHI WHO WAS CHANCELLOR OF FERDOWSI UNIVERSITY IN MASHAD IS A FAIRLY DYNAMIC INDIVIDUAL WHO HAS BEEN GIVEN A MANDATE BY PRIME MINISTER AMOUZEGAR TO MAKE PROGRESSIVE WING AN ACTIVE AGENT OF PRIME MINISTER'S POLICIES. MOJDEHI WILL WORK CLOSELY WITH AMOUZEGAR AND PROGRESSIVE WING LIKELY TO REPRESENT PRIME MINISTER'S VIEWS. | MEANWHILE STUDENTS ARE CIRCULATING LEAFLETS ATTACKING MARTIAL LAW. summary: FUNCTIONAL COMMITTEES | ACCORDING TO LOCAL JOURNALIST WHO HAS BEEN FOLLOWING ASSEMBLY SESSIONS, DURING LAST 10 DAYS ASSEMBLY HAS MADE SIGNIFICANT CHANGE IN ITS DRAFTING PROCEDURE. ARTICLES ARE NO LONGER WRITTEN BY FUNCTIONAL COMMITTEES, BUT ARE DRAFTED BY A COORDINATING COMMITTEE MADE UP OF SENIOR DELEGATES. label: GENSCHER
summary: GENSCHER | THE AMBASSADOR MADE USE OF AN ALREADY SCHEDULED APPOINTMENT WITH FOREIGN MINISTER GENSCHER ON DECEMBER 18 TO MAKE THE PRESENTATION ALONG THE LINES OF REF. GENSCHER WELCOMED OUR PROPOSAL AND DESIGNATED ASSISTANT SECRETARY ANDREAS MEYER-LANDRUT, DIRECTOR OF THE FOREIGN MINISTRY'S THIRD POLITICAL DIVISION, AS THE FRG CONTACT POINT FOR THESE CONSULTATIONS. GENSCHER FULLY SHARED OUR VIEW OF THE NEED TO KEEP THESE TALKS UNDER CLOSE WRAPS. | REFLECTIVE OF A DEEPLY HELD FRG CONCERN, GENSCHER'S FIRST QUESTION AFTER HEARING THE AMBASSADOR'S PRESENTATION WAS WHETHER THE USG PLANNED TO CONTINUE MOVING ITS PERSONNEL OUT OF IRAN. THE AMBASSADOR REPLIED THAT, SO FAR, SOME DEPENDENTS HAVE LEFT ON A VOLUNTARY BASIS, AND THAT NO LARGE-SCALE MOVE OF USG PERSONNEL IS UNDERWAY. | GENSCHER SEEMED RELIEVED TO HEAR THIS, BECAUSE HE FEARED THAT A MASSIVE EVACUATION WOULD BE SEEN AS A LACK OF WESTERN CONFIDENCE IN THE GOI. HE NOTED THAT THERE ARE MANY GERMANS IN THE COUNTRY, AND THAT THE FRG HAS TAKEN STEPS TO LAUNCH AN EVACUATION ON SHORT NOTICE BUT HAS NOT YET FLOWN ANY PERSONNEL OUT. | GENSCHER NEXT SPOKE OF THE COMMON WESTERN INTEREST IN HELPING IRAN RETURN TO A CONDITION OF INTERNAL STABILITY AND MAINTAIN ITS TRADITIONAL ORIENTATION OVER THE MIDDLE- AND LONG-TERM. HE HAD NO DOUBT THAT THE PRESENT GOVERNMENT WAS DETERMINED TO HOLD TO IRAN'S TRADITIONAL FOREIGN POLICY ORIENTATION, AND HE SAW NO REASON FOR UNEASE ON THAT SCORE. THE QUESTION WAS WHETHER THE REGIME WOULD PERCEIVE THE SHAH AS AN ASSET OR A BURDEN IN REACHING ITS GOALS. GENSCHER THOUGHT THAT CURRENT GOI POWER HOLDERS HAD NOT YET MADE UP THEIR MINDS ON THAT POINT. | IN REPLY TO THE AMBASSADOR'S COMMENT ON THE SHAH'S EFFORT TO BRING OPPOSITION POLITICANS INTO A COALITION GOVERNMENT, GENSCHER NOTED THAT THE PRESENT MILITARY REGIME DOES NOT DERIVE ITS AUTHORITY DE FACTO FROM THE SHAH, BUT RATHER FROM THE UNITY OF THE ARMY WHICH HAS HELD UP WELL. HE SAW THE DANGER OF DEMORALIZATION IN THE RANKS, HOWEVER, AND HE THOUGHT THAT IN THIS CONNECTION MUCH WOULD BE DECIDED IN THE NEXT FEW DAYS. | GENSCHER

THE TWO WEEK PERIOD WHICH SADIQI HAS BEEN GRANTED TO ATTEMPT THE FORMATION OF A GOVERNMENT MAY, THEREFORE, BE SPENT IN A FRUITLESS SEARCH FOR COLLABORATORS. INDEED, IF HE LIFTS MARTIAL LAW AND PROCLAIMS FREEDOM OF THE PRESS, HE IS LIKELY TO GET THE SORT OF TREATMENT WHICH THE OPPOSITION METED OUT TO SHARIFEMAMI. FIRST, IT MAY GIVE THE AUTHORITIES SOME TIME TO MAKE MORE EFFECTIVE PROGRESS TOWARDS THE RESTORATION OF PRODUCTION AND ORDERLY FUNCTIONING OF GOVERNMENT. SECOND, IT WILL GIVE THE OPPOSITION SOME RALLYING POINT ALTERNATIVE TO KHOMEINI AND ENCOURAGE THOSE WHO ARE DISMAYED BY THE DANGERS KHOMEINI REPRESENTS. THIS PROCESS WILL BE IMPORTANT TO GETTING SOME MORE POSITIVE AND CONCRETE THINKING ABOUT POLITICAL SOLUTIONS WHICH ARE NOT TRAASFIXED WITH THE IDEA OF THE SHAH'S ABDICATION AS THE SOLE SOLUTION. | GHOLAM HOSEIN SADIQI
