label: GONBAD KAVOUS
summary: GONBAD KAVOUS | ETHNIC UNREST IN THE GONBAD KAVOUS AREA OF GORGAN PROVINCE (ALSO KNOWN AS TURKOMAN SAHRAH), WHICH HAS BEEN EVIDENT FOR SOME TIME NOW, RESULTED IN SEVERAL ARMED CLASHES BETWEEN THE LOCAL TURKOMAN POPULATION AND IRANIAN GOVERNMENT FORCES IN THE PAST SEVERAL DAYS. IT APPEARS THAT THE INITIAL INCIDENT OCCURRED MARCH 25 WHEN A 17 YEAR-OLD TURKOMAN YOUTH WAS KILLED AND SHOPS AND SCHOOLS IN GORBAD KAVOUS WERE CLOSED. A MEETING HELD MARCH 26 TO RESOLVE TURKOMAN GRIEVANCES DEGENERATED INTO FURTHER VIOLENCE. ON MARCH 27 THE TURKOMAN, REPORTEDLY AIDED BY MEMBERS OF THE MARXIST FEDAYIN-EKHALQ, CAPTURED AN UNDETERMINED NUMBER OF POLICE AND GENDARMERIE STATIONS IN THE VICINITY OF GONBAD KAVOUS. | EARLY MARCH 28, HOWEVER, THE GOVERNMENT-CONTROLLED VOICE OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION OF IRAN KTHE ISLAMIC HAS BEEN ADDED WITHIN THE LAST SEVERAL DAYS) CLAIMED THAT THERE WERE NO POLICE OR GENDARMERIE FACILITIES IN THE GONBAD KAVOUS AREA THAT WERE NOT UNDER GOVERNMENT CONTROL (THE CONTORTED SYNTAX OF THE STATEMENT SUGGESTED THAT THE FACILITIES IN QUESTION HAD NOT BEEN UNDER GOVERNMENT CONTROL AT SOME POINT). THE EXACT DEGREE OF SEVERITY OF THE FIGHTING IS NOT YET CLEAR (THE NUMBER OF DEATHS HAS BEEN REPORTED VARIOUSLY AS BETWEEN 7 AND 50). | THE REACTION OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT HAS BEEN TO RECALL THE GOVERNOR GENERAL FROM GORGAN AND TO DISPATCH A THREE-MEMBER DELEGATION FROM THE MINISTRY OF INTERIOR TO GONBAD KAVOUS TO MEDIATE WITH THE TURKOMAN. IN ADDITION, AYATOLLAH TALAGHANI HAS ISSUED A STATEMENT LAYING RESPONSIBILITY FOR ETHNIC FRICTIONS IN IRAN ON THE PREVIOUS REGIME "WITH THE SUPPORT OF ITS COLONIALIST MASTERS", AND PROMISING THE TURKOMAN NO LESS THAN HAD BEEN GRANTED TO THE KURDS EARLIER. | THE FEDAYIN HAVE DENIED ANY ROLE IN THE FIGHTING IN THE GONBAD KAVOUS AREA, BUT REPORTS THAT THEY SIDED WITH THE TURKOMAN THERE PROBABLY SHOULD NOT BE DISMISSED OUT OF HAND, PARTICULARLY IN LIGHT OF SIMILAR REPORTS FROM SANANDAJ LAST WEEK. RECOGNIZING THAT THEY ARE NOT YET STRONG ENOUGH TO ATTACK THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT FRONTALLY, THROWING THEIR SUPPORT TO THE ETHNIC MINORITIES IS A CONVENIENT MEANS OF KEEPING THE GOVERNMENT OFF BALANCE WHILE THE FEDAYIN CONTINUE TO BUILD THEIR STRENGTH. | PRESS REPORTS SAY THAT AYATOLLAH TALEGHANI IS NOW IN GONBAD KAVOUS IN NORTHEAST IRAN. TALEGHANI IS SAID TO HAVE DEPARTED ON A PEACE-MAKING EXPEDITION TO THE TROUBLED TURKOMAN AREA ON 28 MARCH. NEWSPAPER AND RADIO ACCOUNTS OF THE TURKOMAN FIGHTING DIFFER, AND A NUMBER OF CONFLICTING STORIES HAVE EMERGED. RADIO REPORTS CLAIM THAT A CEASEFIRE WAS DECLARED IN GONBAD KAVOUS EARLY ON 28 MARCH. PRESS ACCOUNTS SAY THAT THE FIGHTING CONTINUES. | GONBAD KAVOUS

NAHAVANDI WHO HAS AS MANY--IF NOT MORE-GOVERNMENT RESPONSIBILITIES AS EITHER ANSARY OR MAJIDI IS PRESIDENT OF THE GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS, A GROUP WCICH IS STUDYING THE IDEA OF TRANSFORMING ITSELF INTO A THIRD WING. | MEANWHILE THE RELATIONSHIP BETWEEN THE GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS, A NAISSANT THIRD WING, AND THE PARTY REMAINS MURKY.HUSHANG NAHAVANDI, PRESIDENT OF THE GROUP, SAID ON JUNE 24 THAT THE GROUP WOULD RETAIN HITS INDEPENDENT IDENTITY WHILE ACTING AS A PARTY WING. AS REPORTED EARLIER (REFTELS) THE PARTY NOW HAS THREE NEW WING COORDINATORS, TWO OF WHOM, DESPITE EARLIER RUMORS, CURRENTLY HOLD HIGH LEVEL GOVERNMENT POSTS. IN ADDITION ANSARY HAS RETAINED A WING POST AS CHAIRMAN OF THE CONSTRUCTIVE WING'S COORDINATING COUNCIL. BRIEF BIOGRAPHIC SKETCHES OF THE NEW COORDINATORS FOLLOW. | ON JUNE 21 ESTABLISHMENT OF A THIRD WING WITH HUSHANG NAHAVANDI AS WING COORDINATOR WAS ANNOUNCED. NAHAVANDI, PRESIDENT OF THE GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS, WHICH WILL ESSENTIALLY FORM THE NEW WING, IS CONCURRENTLY DIRECTOR OF EMPRESS FARAH'S SPECIAL BUREAU. NAHAVANDI, 48 ORIGINALLY A PROTEGE OF HASSAN ALI MANSUR AND A MEMBER OF THE IRAN NOVIN PARTY, HAS BEEN THE SUBJECT OF EARLIER BIOGRAPHIC SKETCHES AVAIALABLE IN THE DEPARTMENT. | THE "GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS" SUDDENLTY GAINED PROMINENCE THIS SPRING AND, HEADED BY HUSHANG NAHAVANDI, FORMERLY CHANCELLOR OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY AND PRESENTLY HEAD OF THE QUEEN'S BUREAU, HAS BEEN ACCEPTED AS A THIRD WING OF THE RASTIKHIZ. AS OF THIS WRITING MANY OF THE GROUP DISPUTE MEMBERSHIP IN RASTIKHIZ, AND PREFER TO ISSUE THEIR FINDINGS IN THE NAME OF THE "GROUP" ONLY. | GROUP FOR THE STUDY OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS group for the study of iranian problems

ENTEZAM WAS COMPLETELY IGNORANT OF THE FACT THAT THEY HAD EVEN BEEN ARRESTED, BUT PROMISED TO LOOK INTO THE MATTER AND LET US KNOW THE RESULTS OF HIS INQUIRY. | WE HAVE NOT BEEN ABLE TO PIN DOWN PRECISELY THE INFORMATION REQUESTED IN REFTEL, BUT IT DOES APPEAR THAT THE REVOLUTIONARY PROSECUTOR SOME TIME LAST WEEK DID REQUEST ALL THOSE WHO HAVE COMPLAINTS AGAINST A NUMBER OF INDIVIDUALS, AMONG WHOM WERE HAI AND DANIELPOUR, TO COME FORWARD WITH THEIR CHARGES. THIS IS A STANDARD PROCEDURE IN THE IRANIAN REVOLUTIONARY JUDICIAL PROCESS. | WHILE THE POSSIBILITY OF TRIAL ISCERTAINLY SOMETHING TO BE WATCHED CAREFULLY IN THIS INSTANCE, WE DO NOT THINK THERE IS REASON FOR UNDUE CONCERN ABOUT THE WELFARE OF HAI AND DANIELPOUR AT THIS PARTICULAR JUNCTURE. IN THIS REGARD, WE WOULD NOTE THAT SENTENCES HANDED DOWN IN RECENT DAYS HAVE TENDED TO BE LESS HARSH THAN WAS EARLIER THE CASE. FURTHER, AT LEAST ONE OF OUR JEWISH CONTACTS WAS CONFIDENT THAT IF HAI AND DANIELPOUR ARE BROUGHT TO TRIAL, THEY WILL AT MOST RECEIVE RELATIVELY LIGHT SENTENCES AND MAY EVEN BE ACQUITTED. | DURING JULY 30 CALL, JUSTICE MINISTER JAVADI CONFIRMED TO CHARGE THAT HAI HAD BEEN FREED BUT WAS NOT SURE ABOUT DANIELPOUR. WE WILL CONTINUE ATTEMPT TO CONFIRM DANIELPOUR'S CURRENT STATUS. | HAI hai

summary: HAJI LATIFI | ZARRABI SAID TWO REPRESENTATIVES SENT BY HIS GROUP TO PARIS WERE ON THEIR WAY BACK AT THAT MOMENT. label: HAJ MOHAMMAD NEZAM OLEISLAM
summary: HAJ MOHAMMAD NEZAM OLEISLAM | SHARIF-EMAMI WAS BORN ABOUT 1910 INTO OLD ECCLESIASTICAL FAMILY. HIS FATHER, HAJ MOHAMMAD NEZAM-OLESLAM, WAS A LEADING ISLAMIC CLERGYMAN IN TEHRAN, AND HIS GREAT GRANDFATHER, MIRZA ABUTALEB ESFAHANI, WAS PRIMINENT RELIGIOUS LEADER IN QAJAR PERIOD. ANOTHER GREAT GRANDFATHER, MIRZA ABDOLQASEM HOSSEINI, WAS AN ISFAHAN CLERGYMAN. HIS OWN EDUCATION WAS DEVOTED TO ENGINEERING--THE IRAN-GERMAN SECONDARY SCHOOL IN TEHRAN, GERMAN CENTRALRAILWAY SCHOOL, AND BORAS TECHNICAL SCHOOL IN SWEDEN. HE BEGAN A CAREER WITH IRANIAN STATE RAILWAY IN 1931, AND IN 1942, BECAME ITS DEPUTY CHIEF. FOLLOWING ALLED INTERVENTION, HE SPENT TWO YEARS INTERNMENT IN ARAK FOR PRO-GERMAN STANCE. IN POST WAR PERIOD HE WORKED IN PRIVATE CONTRACTING AS HEAD OF IRRIGATION AGENCY. | HAJ MOHAMMAD NEZAM OLEISLAM

label: HASSAN PAKRAVAN
summary: HASSAN PAKRAVAN | DCM MET WITH GEN HASSAN PAKRAVAN, FORMER HEAD OF SAVAK AND CURRENTLY ADVISOR TO THE COURT, EVENING JAN 17. THE GENERAL EMPHASIZED THAT HE REMAINS LOYAL TO THE SHAH AND SPENT THE FIRST 20 MINUTES BERATING THE SHAH AND U.S. POLICY OVER THE LAST TEN YEARS. HE REMARKED THAT REPRESSION, FAVORITISM AND CORRUPTION OF THE REGIME HAD BEEN BUILDING TO A BOIL FOR A LONG TIME. HE ALSO SAID THAT AMERICAN RAPACITY, PARTICULARLY IN THE SALE OF ARMS AND SERVICES, HAS MADE MANY IRANIANS STRONGLY ANTI-AMERICAN. HAVING GONE THROUGH THIS ALMOST OBLIGATORY CONDEMNATION IN THE CURRENT CIRCUMSTANCES, PAKRAVAN TURNED TO THE FUTURE. | THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT: FOR THE IMMEDIATE FUTURE GEN. PAKRAVAN STATED THAT IT WAS ABSOLUTELY ESSENTIAL FOR THE U.S. TO GIVE FULLEST SUPPORT BOTH DIRECTLY AND, ESPECIALLY, INDIRECTLY TO THE BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT. HE NOTED THAT, WHEN HE HAD BEEN CHIEF OF SAVAK, HE HAD ARRESTED BAKHTIAR AND HAD LONG CONVERSATIONS WITH HIM AT THAT TIME AND HAD CONTINUED TO FOLLOW BAKHTIAR'S CAREER. HE SAID THAT BAKHTIAR, ALTHOUGH NOT AS POPULAR AS OTHER POLITICIANS AT THAT TIME, WAS A CUT WAY ABOVE THE REST OF THE LOT--A MAN OF QUALITY. | OTHER PERSONALITIES: PAKRAVAN DISMISSED SANJABI QUICKLY AS AN OPPORTUNIST AND SENILE. FOROUHAR WAS CHARACTERIZED AS "THE VILLAGE IDIOT" SINCE HIS YOUTH. MEHDIBARZAGAN IS SINCERE, DEDICATED, ABLE BUT NOT BRILLIANT NOR A GREAT INTELLECT. | TUDEH: THE GENERAL SAID THAT IT WAS PERFECTLY CLEAR TO HIM THAT THE TUDEH PARTY HAD NOW REASSERTED ITSELF AND IS IN FACT AT THE CENTER OF THE ORGANIZATION OF MUCH OF THE TROUBLE IN THE COUNTRY. HOWEVER, WHEN HE HAD DISCUSSED THE TUDEH RECENTLY WITH GENERAL MOGHADAM, THE CURRENT HEAD OF SAVAK, THE LATTER HAD ADMITTED THAT HIS ORGANIZATION KNEW LITTLE ABOUT THE TUDEH OR ITS MEMBERSHIP. PAKRAVAN SADLY NOTED THAT HE WAS DISTRESSED AND ASTONISHED THAT SAVAK HAD COME TO THAT LOW STATE OF AFFAIRS. | THE PRESS ALSO REPORTED THAT THE "PRELIMINARY PROSECUTION" OF FORMER PM HOVEYDA BEGAN MARCH 13 BY THE "REVOLUTIONARY A LAWYER AND MEMBER OF THE COMMITTEE FOR THE DEFESE OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND FREEDOM, VISITED QASR PRISON ON MARCH 14. HE INTERVIEWED HOVEYDA AND SEVERAL OTHER PRISONERS, INCLUDING BUSINESSMAN RAHIM ALI KHORRAM, FORMER MINISTER OF HEALTH SHOJAEDDIN SHEIKHOLESLAMZADEH, AND HASSAN PAKRAVAN, ONETIME HEAD OF SAVAK AND MORE RECENTLY DEPUTY MINISTER OF COURT. ACCORDING TO KAYHAN INTERNATIONAL, LAHIJI REPORTED THAT ALL THE PRISONERS SAID THAT THEY HAD NOT BEEN MISTREATED. | HASSAN PAKRAVAN

label: HEDAYAT MATIN DAFTARI
summary: HEDAYAT MATIN DAFTARI | MATIN-DAFTARI RECEIVED EMBOFF JAN 5 FOR DISCUSSION OF IRANIAN POLITICAL SITUATION. MATIN-DAFTARI FEELS THAT, BY AGREEING TO FORM A GOVERNMENT WHICH WOULD BE ASSOCIATED WITH THE SHAH, BAKHTIAR HAS SEVERELY DAMAGED HIS CREDIBILITY AND HIS POPULARITY HAS PLUMMETED IN THE FACE OF THE ASSUMPTION THAT HE HAS SOLD OUT. IN ACCORDING A BAKHTIAR GOVERNMENT ABOUT A 20 PERCENT CHANCE OF SUCCESS, MATINDAFTARI FEELS HE IS BEING OPTIMISTIC. | THE PROBLEM, MATIN-DAFTARI WAS QUICK TO POINT OUT, IS NOT SO MUCH WITH BAKHTIAR AS IT IS WITH THE SHAH. HIS YEARS OF REPRESSION, CORRUPTION, LIES, AND SHAM DEVELOPMENT HAVE PUSHED THE PEOPLE BEYOND THE LIMITS OF MORTAL ENDURANCE AND THE MONARCH MUST QUIT IRAN SOON, OR THE SAVAGERY WHICH HAS BEEN VISITED UPON MASHAD AND QAZVIN WILL RECUR IN OTHER CITIES. THE SHAH HAS BEEN TRANSMOGRIFIED INTO MORE THAN JUST A HATED RULER; HE HAS BECOME A SYMBOL FOR THE DISUNITY AND STRIFE THAT PLAGUES IRAN. THE ONLY SYMBOL OF NATIONAL UNITY AT PRESENT IS IMAM (SIC) KHOMEINI. | MANY PEOPLE (PROBABLY INCLUDING MATINDAFTARI) REGARD THE SALE TO IRAN OF MASSIVE AMOUNTS OF UNNEEDEDMILITARY EQUIPMENT AT INFLATED PRICES AND THE PRESENCE IN IRAN OF THOUSANDS OF PAMPERED, HIGHLY PAID FOREIGN TECHNICIANS TO HANDLE THIS EQUIPMENT AS A REESTABLISHMENT IN ALTERED FORM OF THE CONCESSIONS AND CAPITULATIONS WHICH CHARACTERIZED THE LAST THREE-FOUR DECADES OF THE QAJAR DYNASTY AND CONTRIBUTED SIGNIFICANTLY TO THE CONSTITUTIONAL REVOLUTION. THE PRESENT IRANIAN REVOLUTION WILL RESULT IN THE CANCELLATION OF ANY CONTRACT WITH AMERICAN OR OTHER FOREIGN FIRMS WHICH APPEARS TO BE UNEQUAL OR EXPLOITATIVE AND MANY CONTRACTS WHICH WERE REACHED ON A BASIS OF EQUALITY WILL BE ENDANGERED IF THEY INVOLVE U.S. COMPANIES. | COMMENT: MATIN-DAFTARI'S COMMENTS CONTAINED LITTLE THAT WAS NEW OR DIFFERENT FROM WHAT EMBOFF HAS HEARD FROM ANY NUMBER OF IRANIANS. HOWEVER, AS THE SON OF A FORMER PRIME MINISTER AND THE NEPHEW OF THE LATE MOHAMMAD MOSSADEGH, MATIN-DAFTARI OCCUPIES A RESPECTED POSITION AMONG THE RANKS OF THE OPPOSITION EVEN THOUGH HE IS NOT TERRIBLY ACTIVE POLITICALLY. PEOPLE FROM ALL ELEMENTS OF IRANIAN SOCIETY ARE FREQUENT CALLERS AT HIS OLD QAJAR MANSION TO REQUEST ASSISTANCE, ADVICE, OR JUST TO TALK. | CONSEQUENTLY, MATIN-DAFTARI'S VIEWS CONSTITUTE A DISTILLATION OF A VERY BROAD SPECTRUM IN IRAN AND MAY BE CONSIDERED MORE NEARLY REPRESENTATIVE THAN THOSE OF MANY OTHER IRANIAN OPPOSITIONISTS WHO LACK HIS TRADITIONAL BASE. END COMMENT SULLIVAN | HEDAYAT MATIN DAFTARI

label: HELMAND
summary: HELMAND | FIRST, A FEW FACTS CONCERNING THE PHYSICAL SITUATIONIN SISTAN, THE AREA IN IRAN WATERY THE HELMAND: --THE REGION IS DRYING UP. RECENT ARCHEOLOGICAL EXCAVATIONS IN SISTAN INDICATE THAT THE WATER TABLE HAS FALLEN ABOUT 20 METERS IN THE LAST 5,000 YEARS. --ALMOST NONE OF THE WATER WHICH FLOW INTO THE HAMUN (THE SYSTEM OF SHALLOW LAKES WHICH STRADDLES THE IRAN-AFGHAN BORDER THERE) RISES ON THE IRANIAN SIDE. | ON THE AVERAGE, SISTAN GETS ABOUT 30 MILLILITERS OF PRECIPITATION ANNUALLY, AND EVEN WITH IRRIGATION THE AVERAGE YIELD OF WHEAT PER HECTARE IS ONLY 1.5 TONS, SOMEWHAT BELOW THE IRANIAN NATIONAL AVERAGE FOR IRRIGATED WHEAT WHICH ITSELF IS NOT PARTICULARLY HIGH. --THE HELMAND IS SISTAN DIVIDES INTO SEVERAL DISTRIBUTARIES, SOME NATURAL AND OTHERS MAN-MADE. | ONE OF THE LATTER, WHICH LEAVES THE MAIN CHANNEL ABOUT TWO KILOMETERS ABOVE KOHAK AND FLOWS IN A NORTHWESTERLY DIRECTION, FORMS PART OF THE BORDER BETWEEN AFGHANISTAN AND IRAN. --THE DAM AT KOHAK (AND ANOTHER AT ZAHAK ABOUT 15 KILOMETERS DOWNSTREAM) IS IN ACTUALITY A BARRAGE WHICH DIVERTS WATER FROM THE HELMAND'S MAIN DISTRIBUTARY IN IRAN INTO AN IRRIGATION CHANNEL. AS THE BARRAGES HAVE NO STORAGE CAPACITY BEHIND THEM, THEIR VALUE FOR FLOOD CONTROL IS NEGLIGBLE. --THE IRRIGATION CHANNEL CARRYING WATER DIVERTED BY THE BARRAGE AT KOHAK PARALLELS THE DISTRIBUTARY MENTIONED ABOVE WHICH FORMS PART OF THE IRAN-AFGHAN BORDER AND ULTIMATELY DEBOUCHES INTO THE HAMUN. | THE IRANIANS CURRENTLY HAVE 74 LARGE PUMPS IN OPERATION ON THE HELMAND, MOST OF WHICH ARE DRAWING WATER OUT OF THE SAME DISTRIBUTARY WHICH FORMS PART OF THE IRAN-AFGHAN BORDER. SOURCES ON THE IRANIAN SIDE STATED THE AFGHANS HAVE NONE. | POLITICALLY, THE HELMAND'S WATERS HAVE IMPORTANT DOMESTIC AS WELL AS INTERNATIONAL IMPLICATIONS. (AS FAR AS THE LATTER ARE CONCERNED, I FOUND UNIVERSAL CONVICTION AT THE LOCAL LEVEL THAT THE SOVIETS HAVE PUT AFGHANISTAN UP TO CONSTRUCTION OF THE KAMAL KHAN DAM AS A MEANS OF ATTACKING IRAN ON AN EXPOSED FLANK.) OF NECESSITY, TEHRAN MUST BE CONCERNED ABOUT THE ECONOMIC WELL-BEING OF CITIZENS IN ONE OF THE REMOTEST AND POOREST REGIONS OF THE COUNTRY. | HELMAND

label: HERAT
summary: HERAT | AT THE SAME DINNER SAVAK CHIEF GENERAL NASSIRI SAID HIS INFORMATION INDICATED ISOLATED CENTERS OF MILITARY RESISTANCE TO THE COUP GROUP CONTINUED, PARTICULARLY IN HERAT; IN KANDAHAR, WHERE AIR FORCE ELEMENTS INCLUDING SEVERAL MIG-EQUIPPED UNITS WERE STILL HOLDING OUT; AND IN BAGRAM AIR FORCE BASE, ABOUT TWENTY MILES NORTH OF KABUL. HE SAID A FORCE OF PARATROOPS FROM KANDAHAR HAD, ACCORDING TO REPORTS, TAKEN POSITIONS IN THE PRESIDENTIAL PALACE BUT ALL WERE KILLED. | POLCOUNS ALSO ASKED IF THERE WAS ANY RECENT INFORMATION ABOUT LARGE NUMBERS OF SOVIET ARMED SECRUTIY TROOPS (GIVING PAKISTAN AS PLACE OF ACQUISITION THIS REPORT BUT CITING NO SOURCES). SHIVA SAID THERE HAD BEEN A RECENT CABLE THAT 1,000 SOVIET ECONOMIC EXPERTS HAVE ARRIVED AND ARE WORKING ON PROJECTS MAINLY IN KABUL AND HERAT AREAS. DESPITE SEVERAL QUESTIONS, HE COULD NOT CONFIRM ANYTHING ABOUT SOVIET SECURITY TROOPS, UNLESS THEY HAPPEN TO BE DISGUISED AS ECONOMIC EXPERTS. | SHIVA ALSO PASSED ON RUMORS AND FOLLOWING BITS AND PIECES OF INFORMATION: (A) SOVIET MILITARY ADVISORS IN HERAT AND KABUL HAVE BEGUN TO APPEAR IN THEIR MILITARY UNIFORMS, WHICH WAS NOT THE CASE IN THE PAST, (B) SOME 2-300 RUSSIANS FROM THE THREE REPUBLICS NEIGHBORING AFGHANISTAN ARE IN THE PROCESS OF OCCUPYING POSTS IN VARIOUS MINISTRIES IN KABUL WHICH HAVE BEEN MADE VACANT BY RECENT DISMISSALS OF THEIR INCUMBENTS, (C) MANY SOVIET PLANES ARE ARRIVING LATE AT NIGHT IN KABUL-ONE WONDERS WHAT THEY ARE CARRYING, (D) GIVEN LARGE NUMBER OF ECONOMIC AGREEMENTS SIGNED BETWEEN AFGHANISTAN AND USSR SINCE THE COUP, ONE WONDERS HOW MUCH TIME WAS SPENT IN NEGOTIATING THEM. | HE IS A GRADUATE OF TEHRAN UNIVERISITY (LAW; 1945) AND HAS A DOCTORATE IN ECONOMICS FROM THE UNIVERSITY OF COLOGNE (1953). PREVIOUS POSTS INCLUDED STUTTGART, PARIS, HERAT (AFGHANISTAN), KUWAIT, TEL AVIV AND BERN. HE WAS AMBASSADOR IN BUCHAREST FROM 1970 TO 1973 AND AMBASSADOR IN BAGHDAD FROM 1976 UNTIL HIS RECENT APPOINTMENT. | THERE ARE NOW ABOUT 2,000 SOVIET ECONOMIC ADVISORS AND 600-1,000 MILITARY ADVISORS IN THE COUNTRY; SOME OF THE LATTER ACCOMPANY AFGHAN PATROLS OPERATING AGAINST THE MOUNTAIN TRIBES. label: HOJJAT AL ISLAM DR ALI GOLZADEH GHAFFOURI
summary: HOJJAT AL ISLAM DR ALI GOLZADEH GHAFFOURI | CHARGE AND EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER CALLED ON TEHRAN DELEGATE TO COUNCIL OF EXPERTS, HOJJAT AL-ISLAM DR. ALI GOLZADEH GHAFFOURI ON OCTOBER 14 AT COUNCIL BLDG. CALL HAD ORIGINALLY BEEN SUGGESTED BY MINISTER OF INTERIOR AND WAS PROCEEDED BY POLITICAL OFFICER'S VISIT ONE WEEK EARLIER. GHAFFOURI IS A CLERGYMAN, A TEACHER, A LEGAL SCHOLAR AND A MEMBER OF THE COORDINATING COMMITTEE OF THE COUNCIL OF EXPERTS. DR. GHAFFOURI'S SON, A GERMANTRAINED ENGINEER, ALSO ATTENDED THE MEETING. MEETING HAD BEEN ARRANGED FOR "A PERSONAL EXCHANGE OF VIEWS." | AS NOTED REF B, COUNCIL OF EXPERTS HAS DEVIATED FROM TEXT OO ORIGINAL DRAFT CONSTITUTION AND IN FACT HAS DRAFTED ALMOST ENTIRELY NEW DOCUMENT. ASKED ABOUT THE REASONS FOR THIS STEP, COUNCIL DELEGATE HOJJAT AL-ISLAM DR. ALI GOLZADEH GHAFFOURI TOLD EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER THAT ORIGINAL DRAFT WAS SIMPLY ONE SUGGESTION AND THAT COUNCIL HAD RECEIVED OVER 4,000 SUGGESTIONS FOR CHANGES IN THAT DOCUMENT. HE SAID, "SINCE WE WANTED TO ENSURE THE PEOPLE'S PARTICIPATION IN WRITING THE CONSTITUTION, EACH COMMITTEE OF THE COUNCIL HAD TO CAREFULLY EXAMINE THE SUGGESTIONS MADE AND TRY TO MODIFY THE DRAFT ACCORDING TO THE WISHES OF THE MAJORITY." | HOJJAT AL ISLAM DR ALI GOLZADEH GHAFFOURI

label: IMPERIAL COMMISSION
summary: IMPERIAL COMMISSION | THE SECOND LETTER, WHICH CALLED FOR INCREASED INTELLECTUAL FREEDOM AND THE REESTABLISHMENT OF THE WRITERS GUILD, WAS ADDRESSED TO THE PRIME MINISTER BY FORTY INTELLECTUALS. IN ADDITION, THREE GOVERNMENT BODIES HAVE BEEN RESURRECTED TO EXAMINE GOVERNMENTAL OPERATIONS -THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION, THE IMPERIAL INSPECTORATE ORGANIZATION, AND THE STUDY GROUP OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS. EACH GROUP HAS BEEN GIVEN A WIDE MANDATE, SOMETIMES OVERLAPPING THAT OF THE OTHER. | THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION IS TO FOCUS ON OVERSEEING ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT, ERADICATING WASTE AND ELIMINATING CORRUPTION; THE IMPERIAL INSPECTORATE ORGANIZATION IS TO MONITOR THE PROGRESS OF THE ADMINISTRATIVE REVOLUTION AND TO CONTINUE UNANNOUNCED SPOT INSPECTIONS OF GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES AND OFFICES; AND, THE STUDY GROUP IS TO DEBATE AND EVALUATE GOVERNMENTAL PROBLEMS AND POLICIES AND TO FORWARD THEIR CRITICISM AND REPORTS TO THE SHAH. THE MEETINGS OF THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION, IN WHICH ATTACKS AGAINST VARIOUS DEFICIENCIES OF THE GOVERNMENT ARE ARTICULATED, ARE REGULARLY TELEVISED. IRAN IS A ONE PARTY STATE. | ELEVENTH SESSION OF THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION HELD ON MAY 20 AT SAADABAD PALACE HEARD SPEECHES FROM GOVERNMENT LEADERS AND REVIEWED REPORTS OF ITS VARIOUS INSPECTORATE COMMITTEES. NOSRATOLLAH MOINIAN, CHIEF OF THE SHAH'S SPECIAL BUREAU AND COORDINATOR OF THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION, WARNED THAT LACK OF RESPONSIBILITY AND COORDINATION, WHICH TEND TO DELAY NATIONAL DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS, WILL NOT BE TOLERATED. REVIEWING COMMISSION INSPECTORATE REPORTS FOR THE PAST YEAR, MOINIAN SAID INVESTIGATIONS INDICATED THAT OFFICIALS WERE RESPONSIBLE FOR SHORTCOMINGS IN A NUMBER OF PROJECTS. THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION INSPECTED ALMOST 15,000 PROJECTS AND MOINIAN CITED TWO AREAS OF SERIOUR MISMANAGEMENT. | SMALL ITEM IN PRESS OCT 8 ANNOUNCED THAT THE IMPERIAL COMMISSION WILL CEASE TO EXIST. THE COMMISSION, WHOSE HEARING HAD BEEN TELEVISED DURING STATE'S INVESTIGATION OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT ACTIVITIES, WILL BE REPLACED BY A PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION COMMITTEE ANSWERABLE TO THE CABINET (THIS APPEARS TO BE IN LINE WITH THE SHARIF-EMAMI'S GOVERNMENT'S DECISION TO PLAY SOWN THE INVOLVEMENT OF THE ROYAL FAMILY IN POLITICS.). | IMPERIAL COMMISSION

label: IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN
summary: IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN | WE SUGGEST THAT THE IRANIAN RESPONSE US NOTE, WITH ADDITION OF OPENING AND CLOSING PARAGRAPHS, AS FOLLOWS: BEGIN TEXT. I HAVE THE HONOR TO REFER TO YOUR NOTE DATED TODAY REGARDING THE PROPOSED AGREEMENT FOR COOPERATION BETWEEN THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA AND THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN CONCERNING PEACEFUL USES OF NUCLEAR ENERGY, WHICH READS AS FOLLOWS: (TEXT OF US NOTE). | I HAVE THE HONOR TO CONFIRM THAT THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN SHARES THE ABOVE UNDERSTANDINGS AND THAT THIS EXCHANGE OF NOTES SHALL CONSTITUTE THE FORMAL RECORD OF THESE MUTUAL UNDERSTANDINGS AND SHALL BE AN INTEGRAL PART OF THE AGREEMENT. . | PROPOSED NOTE TO GOI FOLLOWS: BEGIN - THE AMBASSADOR OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA PRESENTS HIS COMPLIMENTS TO THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN AND IS PLEASED TO REFER TO THE PROPOSED AGREEMENT FOR PEACEFUL NUCLEAR COOPERATION BETWEEN THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES AND THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN AS INITIALED BY REPRESENTATIVES OF THE TWO GOVERNMENTS ON JULY 11, 1978. IN THIS REGARD, THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES WISHES SPECIFICALLY TO REFER TO THOSE PROVISIONS OF THE PROPOSED AGREEMENT DESIGNED TO ENSURE THAT IT WOULD BE IMPLEMENTED IN A MANNER THAT WOULD NOT DISCRIMINATE AGAINST IRAN'S NUCLEAR ENERGY DEVELOPMENT PROGRAM. | THIS WOULD INCLUDE CASES SUCH AS THOSE ASSOCIATED WITH THE TOKAIMURA REPROCESSING FACILITY AND RETRANSFERS OF SPENT FUEL FOR REPROCESSING UNDER CONTRACTS CONCLUDED BEFORE 1977. BASED ON THIS AND THE DISCUSSIONS DURING NEGOTIATION OF THE REFERENCED PROVISIONS, THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES UNDERSTANDS THAT UNITED STATES APPROVAL OF REPROCESSING REQUESTS UNDER SUCH CIRCUMSTANCES -- THAT IS, INVOLVING COMMITMENTS BY OTHER GOVERNMENTS WHICH WERE ENTERED INTO PRIOR TO APRIL 1977 AND WHICH, THEREFORE, ARE NOT COMPARABLE TO FUTURE ARRANGEMENTS-- WOULD NOT CONSTITUTE A PRECEDENT FOR APPROVAL BY THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF FUTURE REQUESTS BY THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN FOR REPROCESSING. | THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES WISHES TO ASSURE THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN THAT THIS UNDERSTANDING IS WITHOUT PREJUDICE TO CONSIDERATION BY THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES OF ANY SUCH REQUEST BY THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN ON ITS MERITS. THE GOVERNMENT OF THE UNITED STATES WOULD APPRECIATE CONFIRMATION BY THE IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN THAT IT SHARES THE UNDERSTANDING SET FORTH IN THIS NOTE. | IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT OF IRAN

label: INTERNATIONAL COURT OF JUSTICE
summary: INTERNATIONAL COURT OF JUSTICE | IN THIS SPIRIT, THE UNITED STATES HAS TURNED TO THE SECURITY COUNCIL AND THE SECRETARYGENERAL IN THE SEARCH FOR A PEACEFUL SOLUTION. IN THIS SPIRIT, THE UNITED STATESHASBEGUNPROCEEDINGS IN THE INTERNATIONAL COURT OF JUSTICE. THERE IS IN THE UNITED STATES A UNITY OF PURPOSE, A DISCIPLINED SENSITIVITY TO THE NEEDS OF PEACE, A DETERMINATION TO SEARCH OUT ALL PEACEFULMEANS TO BRING THIS DISPUTE TO A JUST CONCLUSION,LSO A DETERMINATION TO DO WHAT MUST BE DONETO PROTECT OUR FELLOW CITIZENS AND THE RULE OF LAW. | THE UNITED STATES WISHES TO PLACE ON THE RECORD THAT THE ADOPTION OF THIS RESOLUTION BY THE SECURITY COUNCIL CLEARLY IS NOT INTENDED TO DISPLACE PEACEFUL EFFORTS IN OTHER ORGANS OF THE UNITED NATIONS. NEITHER THE UNITED STATES NOR I BELIEVE ANY OTHER MEMBER INTENDS THAT THE ADOPTION OF THIS RESOLUTION SHOULD HAVE ANY PREJUDICIAL IMPACT WHATEVER ON THE REQUEST OF THE UNITED STATES FOR THE INDICATION OF PROVISIONAL MEASURES OF PROTECTION BY THE INTERNATIONAL COURT OF JUSTICE. | WHEREAS SINCE NOVEMBER 4, UNITED STATES PERSONNEL HAVE BEEN HELD HOSTAGE IN IRAN, IN VIOLATION OF FUNDAMENTAL PRINCIPLES OF HUMAN RIGHTS AND INTERNATIONAL LAW; AND WHEREAS NUMEROUS NATIONAL GOVERNMENTS, INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS AND INSTITUTIONS, INCLUDING THE UNITED NATIONS SECURITY COUNCIL, HAVE CALLED FOR THE IMMEDIATE RELEASE OF THOSE BEING HELD HOSTAGE; AND WHEREAS THE INTERNATIONAL COURT OF JUSTICE, IN A UNANIMOUS OPINION, ORDERED THE IMMEDIATE RELEASE OF THE HOSTAGES, CITING THE HISTORIC INVIOLABILITY OF DIPLOMATIC ENVOYS AND EMBASSIES; AND WHEREAS THE CONGRESS AND PEOPLE OF THE UNITED STATES REMAIN FIRM, RESOLUTE, AND UNITED IN THEIR DETERMINATION TO OBTAIN THE IMMEDIATE, SAFE, AND UNCONDITIONAL RELEASE OF THE UNITED STATES PERSONNEL BEING HELD ILLEGALLY IN IRAN; AND WHEREAS IN THE FACE OF EXTRADORINARY PROVOCATIONS, THE UNITED STATES HAS CONSISTENTLY DEMONSTRATED ITS DESIRE TO RESOLVE THIS ISSUE BY PEACEFUL MEANS; AND WHEREAS THE LEADERS OF IRAN CONTINUE TO ACT IN CONTRAVENTION OF THE BASIC PRINCIPLES OF CIVILIZED SOCIETY AND IN DEFIANCE OF INTERNATIONAL LAW AND OF THE ACTIONS OF DULY CONSTITUTED INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS: NOW, THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED, THAT THE SENATE EXPRESSES ITS FULL SUPPORT FOR THE PRESIDENT'S EFFORTS AND FOR THE COOPERATIVE EFFORTS WITH OTHER NATIONS AND INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS, TO WIN THE FREEDOM OF AMERICANS BEING HELD CAPTIVE IN IRAN; THAT THE SENATE CALLS ON ALL NATIONS TO JOIN WITH THE UNITED STATES IN COOPERATIVE EFFORTS TO SEVERELY RESTRICT ECONOMIC, DIPLOMATIC, AND COMMERCIAL RELATIONS WITH IRAN; THAT ANY TRIAL OR PUBLIC EXPLOITATION OF THE AMERICAN HOSTAGES WOULD BE REVIEWED BY THIS NATION AS ADDED PROVOCATION OF THE GRAVEST CHARACTER; THAT THE HOLDING OF THE HOSTAGES IN IRAN REMAINS THE CENTRAL AND PRIMARY ISSUE AND THAT THE AMERICAN PEOPLE WILL NOT BE DIVERTED FROM THEIR DETERMINATION TO OBTAIN THEIR IMMEDIATE RELEASE AND SAFE RETURN TO THE UNITED STATES; AND THAT THE SENATE WILL CONVENE AT THE CALL OF THE SENATE LEADERSHIP, AND IS PREPARED EXPEDITIOUSLY TO CONSIDER ANY RECOMMENDATION OF THE PRESIDENT AND ANY LAW OR MEASURE TO AID IN THE TASK OF GAINING THE FREEDOM OF THE HOSTAGES. | THE PRESIDENT OF THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY HAS TWICE URGED IRAN TO RELEASE THE HOSTAGES. THE INTERNATIONAL COURT OF JUSTICE HAS SPOKEN CLEARLY AND UNANIMOUSLY. GOVERNMENTS AND WORLD LEADERS, OF VARYING POLITICAL AND RELIGIOUS FAITHS, HAVE APPEALED FOR THE RELEASE OF OUR PEOPLE. | INTERNATIONAL COURT OF JUSTICE

summary: IPAC | THE BULK (APPROXIMATELY 80 PERCENT) OF THE CRUDE SUPPLIED BY IRAN TO ISRAEL IS PRODUCED BY THE JOINT VENTURE IPAC (50 PERCENT NIOC AND 50 PERCENT AMOCO) AND LAPCO (50 PERCENT NIOC WITH THE REMAINING SHARE DIVIDED EQUALLY BETWEEN ARCO, MURPHY, SUN AND UNION, ALL U.S. FIRMS). AS WE HAVE REPORTED, IPAC PRODUCTION HAS BEEN COMPLETELY SHUT-DOWN FOR ALMOST TWO WEEKS, AND LAPCO PRODUCTION WAS SHUT IN, FOR THE SECOND TIME, ON NOVEMBER 4. | ALMOST ALL OF THE CRUDE PRODUCED BY IPAC AND LAPCO WHICH NORMALLY FLOWS TO ISRAEL IS SOLD FOR THE ACCOUNT OF NIOC (I.E., ISRAEL'S PRINCIPAL SUPPLIER IS NIOC RATHER THAN THE SECOND PARTIES IN IPAC AND LAPCO). SINCE IPAC AND LAPCO ARE COMPLETELY SHUT-DOWN THE OBVIOUS OPTION IS ONE OF STOCK MANAGEMENT RATHER THAN PRORATIONING OF REDUCED LIFTINGS. HOWEVER, IPAC HAS PRACTICALLY NO CRUDE LEFT IN STORAGE ON KHARG ISLAND (AND PROBABLY LITTLE IF ANY ON THE OFF SHORE BARGE THROUGH WHICH CYRUS FIELD CRUDE IS EXPORTED). | THE IMPORTANT QUESTION IS WHETHER AND HOW NIOC COULD OBTAIN INCREMENTAL QUANTITIES OF KHUZESTAN FIELDS CRUDE TO REPLACE THAT LOST FROM THE SHUT DOWN OF IPAC AND LAPCO. WE DO NOT KNOW EXACTLY HOW THE CONSORTIUM AND NIOC ARE DIVIDING THE CRUDE THAT IS AVAILABLE FOR EXPORT (BETWEEN 700,000 AND 1,232,000 BARRELS DURING THE PAST WEEK), BUT WE UNDERSTAND THAT THE TANKERS AWAITING CARGOS AT KHARG ARE LOADED ON THE BASIS OF THEIR PLACE ON THE LOADING SCHEDULE WHICH HAD, PRIOR TO THE CUT-BACK, BEEN FINALIZED BY THE CONSORTIUM OFFICE IN LONDON ON THE BASIS OF BOTH NIOC AND CONSORTIUM MEMBER COMPANY NOMINATIONS. | ALL PRODUCERS EXCEPT OSCO (E.G. IPAC, LAPCO, SIRIP, IMINOCO, SOFIRAN, AND NIOC WITH A COMBINED CAPACITY OF ABOUT 750,000 B/D) ARE, FOR THE PRESENT AT LEAST, PRODUCING AT OR VERY NEAR CAPACITY RATES. FOR THE PAST TWO DAYS OSCO HAS PRODUCED SLIGHTLY IN EXCESS OF 5 MILLION B/D AND DELIVERIES OF CRUDE TO DOMESTIC REFINERIES ARE RUNNING AT 800-850,000 B/D. | THE STRIKES AGAINST OSCO AND THE FOUR JOINT VENTURES) HAVE NOT BEEN RESOLVED. IPAC WAS SHUT DOWN AGAIN DECEMBER 2 BY A STRIKE (REFTEL), AND THE STRIKE AGAINST OSCO HAS STILL NOT BEEN COMPLETELY RESOLVED. HOWEVER, BARRING SERIOUS REVERSALS IT IS ACCURAGE TO SAY THAT THE SITUATION (EXCLUDING IPAC) HAS IMPROVED TO SUCH A DEGREE THAT THE MAJOR PROBLEMS ARE TECHNICAL; AND THE RETURN TO WORK OF THE REMAINING OSCO STRIKERS OR THE USE OF GREATER NUMBERS OF EXPATRIATE WORKERS WOULD NOT MATERIALLY IMPROVE PRODUCTION RATES. | IPAC

label: ISLAMIC COURTS
summary: ISLAMIC COURTS | SUMMARY AND INTRODUCTION: REGULATIONS PROMULGATED APRIL 5 PROVIDE FOR THE REPLACEMENT OF THE PREVIOUS IRANIAN SYSTEM OF JURISPRUDENCE WITH ONE BASED ON ISLAMIC AND "REVOLUTIONARY" CONCEPTS OF JUSTICE. THE REGULATIONS DELINIATE PROCEDURES FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF ISLAMIC COURTS RESPONSIBLE FOR THE CONDUCT OF TRIALS AND THE ORGANIZATION OF THE OFFICE OF THE PRSECUTOR GENERAL RESPONSIBLE FOR ARRESTS, INVESTIGATIONS, PROSECUTIONS AND CARRYING OUT OF SENTENCES HANDED DOWN BY THE COURTS. THE CREGULATIONS RAISE A NUMBER OF QUESTIONS WHICH WE WILL SEEK ANSWERS TO AS QUICKLY AS POSSIBLE. | THE GOVERNMENT HAS TRIED TO PUT THE BEST FACE POSSIBLE ON THE RESUMPTION OF THE TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS, BUT ITS CHIEF SPOKESMAN, DEPUTY PM ENTEZAM, ADMITTED APRIL 8 THAT THE ISLAMIC COURTS ARE INDEPENDENT OF GOVERNMENT CONTROL. THE REFUND OF SALARIES ORDER COVERS ALL THOSE WHO HAVE SERVED AS DEPUTIES OR SENATORS SINCE 1963. A TIME LIMIT OF JULY 31 HAS BEEN SET BY WHEN THE MONEY MUST BE RETURNED. RUBBING SALT INTO STILL OPEN FAMILY WOUNDS, THE ORDER ALSO INCLUDES THE SALARIES OF EIGHT DEPUTIES WHO HAVE ALREADY BEEN EXECUTED BY ISLAMIC COURTS. NEEDLESS TO SAY, THE REFUND WILL BE A NEAR IMPOSSIBILITY FOR MANY OF THE DEPUTIES. | ISLAMIC COURTS

THESE RELEASES PUT A POTENT FORCE OF POTENTIAL TROUBLE-MAKERS BACK ON THE STREETS AND JA'AFARI FELT THAT GIVEN THEIR TIES WITH UNIV STUDENTS THERE WAS A PREGNANT POSSIBILITY THAT WHEN THE FALL SCHOOL TERM OPENED SEPT 24 SERIOUS TROUBLE COULD FOLLOW. | INDEED, HE FELT THAT THE UNIV SCENE AND STUDENT ACTIVITY MAY WELL PROVE TO BE THE FIRST MAJOR TEST OF THE AMOUZEGA CABINET HE WAS NOT SANGUINE ABOUT THE OUTCOME BECAUSE HE FELT THAT THE MINISTER OF EDUCATION GANJI WAS NOT WELL QUALIFIED TO DEAL WITH THIS KIND OF TROUBLE. IN JA'AFARI'S OPINION GANJI HELD NEITHER THE KIND OF RESPECT OR THE TRUST OF THE ACADEMIC COMMUNITY OR THE STUDENTS WHICH WAS ESSENTIAL TO NIPPING POTENTIAL DISTRUBANCES IN THE CAMPUS IN THE BUD. | JA'AFARI SAID THAT HE HAD A WELL TRAINED FORCE WHICH AMOUNTED TO ABOUT 2 DIVISIONS PREPARED FOR POSSIBLE TROUBLE. BY AND LARGE THE UNIV SCENE DURING THE LAST SCHOOL YEAR WAS RELATIVELY QUIESCENT AND LOCAL AUTHORITIES HAVE GROWN MORE SOPHISTICATED IN DEALING WITH THOSE DISTURBANCES THAT HAVE OCCURRED. NOW THAT IT WAS A COMMUNIST STATE BORDERING ON SOVIET UNION, BREZHNEV DOCTRINE PRESUMABLY CAME INTO PLAY AND IT APPEARED VERY UNLIKELY THAT AFGHANISTAN WOULD BE ABLE TO BREAK AWAY IN FUTURE FROM ITS NEW ALIGNMENT. | MEHTA RESPONDED BY SAYING THAT HE AGREED WITH MY CHARACTERIZATION OF NEW AFGHAN LEADERSHIP AS HARDLINE COMMUNIST AND THAT CHANGE OF GOVERNMENT WAS INDEED A MOMENTOUR DEVELOPMENT NOT ONLY BECAUSE IT PLACED AFGHANISTAN UNDER SOVIET CONTROL BUT ALSO BECAUSE OF IMPLICATIONS FOR THE AREA. HE SAID THAT INDIA HAD DECIDED TO RECOGNIZE NEW GOVERNMENT EARLY ON LARGELY BECAUSE OF TRADITIONAL FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN TWO COUNTRIES. AS SOON AS HE HEARD THAT INDIAN AMBASSADOR SINGH HAD BEEN SUMMONED TO MEETING MAY 1 WITH TARAKKI, HE HAD INSTRUCTED SINGH TO INDICATE THAT GOI WAS PREPARED TO RECOGNIZE NEW REGIME. | SINGH HAD REPORTED THAT MEETING HAD BEEN CORDIAL WITH TARAKKI GOING OUT OF HIS WAY TO BE FRIENDLY. MEHTA ADDED THAT IT WAS MUCH TOO EARLY TO COME TO ANY CONCLUSIONS ABOUT HOW AFGHAN-INDIAN RELATIONS MIGHT DEVELOP BUT CONCEIVABLY INDIA COULD PLAY A MODERATING ROLE OR AT LEAST PRESENT NON-COMMUNIST VIEWS INTO AFGHAN DILIBERATIONS. MEHTA WAS CLEARLY UNDER NO ILLUSIONS ABOUT HOW INFLUENTIAL INDIA MIGHT BE IN THE FUTURE AND MERELY POINTED OUT THAT TRADITIONAL INDIAN-AFGHAN FRIENDSHIP MIGHT COME IN USEFUL SOMEDAY. | TURNING TO MY EARLIER COMMENT ABOUT IMPLICATIONS FOR SOUTH ASIA OF AFGHAN COUP, MEHTA LAUNCHED INTO GENERAL COMMENTARY ABOUT RECENT DEVELOPMENTS IN INDIAN FOREIGN POLICY. LOOKING BACK OVER THE LAST TWO YEARS HE FELT THERE WAS SOME GROUND FOR SATISFACTION AND ENCOURAGEMENT IN THAT GOI HAD IMPROVED ITS RELATIONS WITH US WITHOUT LOSING CONFIDENCE OF SOVIETS, WHICH HE NOTED WAS NO MEAN TRICK. FURTHER, FOR A COUNTRY BESET WITH INTERNAL DIFFICULTIES, DOMESTIC ATTITUDES ON FOREIGN POLICY HAD STABILIZED AND BECOME MORE MATURE AND CURRENTLY INDIA'S FOREIGN POLICY CONTRIBUTED TO WHATEVER SENSE OF SELFCONFIDENCE NATION POSSESSED. THIS SALUTORY TREND WAS ALSO EVIDENT IN RELATIONS BETWEEN INDIA AND PAKISTAN. | JAGAT MEHTA

label: JALAL TALEBANI
summary: JALAL TALEBANI | FIGHTING IN KURDISH CITY OF PAVEH BETWEEN KURDISH REBELS AND GOVERNMENT TROOPS WHICH HAS BEEN GOING ON FOR THREE DAYS INTENSIFIED FRIDAY NIGHT. ACCORDING TO THE TEHRAN TIMES AUGUST 18, THREE GROUPS OF KURDISH REBELS UNDER LEADERSHIP OF THE DEMOCRATIC PARTY OF KORDESTAN AND HEADED BY JALAL TALEBANI, SALAR JAF AND PALIZBAN(SIC) SEIZED PARTS OF THE TOWN AND THE HOSPITAL, KILLING AT LEAST 40 REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS AND OTHERS AND BEHEADING SOME OF THE PEOPLE IN THE HOSPITAL. IN THE FIGHTING A F-4 PHANTOM AND A HELICOPTER CARRYING WOUNDED TROOPS HAVE REPORTEDLY CRASHED. | IN AN INTERESTING COMMENT TO THE PRESS, SEPT 19, REVOLUTIONARY JUDGE KHALKHALI STATED THAT HIS INVESTIGATIONS IN KURDESTAN REVEALED THAT NEITHER THE SOVIET UNION NOR JALAL TALEBANI WERE INVOLVED IN THE KURDISH SITUATION. INSTEAD HE BLAMED MEMBERS OF THE KDP WHO WERE AFFILIATED WITH EITHER THE FADAYEEN KHALQ OR WITH THOSE CONNECTED WITH IMPERIALISM/ZIONISM WHO HAD DIRECT LINKS TO GENEVA AND TEL AVIV. | IN AN INTERESTING INTERVIEW IN KAYHAN SEPTEMBER 30, REVOLUTIONARY JUDGE KHALKHALI DENIED THAT IRAQI KURDISH LEADER JALAL TALEBANI HAD ANYTHING TO DO WITH THE REVOLT SAYING THAT WHILE SOME KDP PRISONERS CLAIMED TO BE TALEBANI MEN, "THERE ARE MANY SUCH CONSPIRACIES WITH KDP OR FADAYAN MEMBERS OR ZIONIST AGENTS CLAIMING TO BE TALEBANI'S MEN IN ORDER TO SPOIL RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND TALEBANI."IN THE SAME INTERVIEW, KHALKHALI ALSO DENIED RUMORS THAT EITHER ARDESHIR ZAHEDI OR AZZIZOLLAH PALIZBAN WERE IN KURDESTAN. | ACCORDING TO PRESS REPORTS (LATER DENIED BY INTERIOR MINISTER SABAGHIAN) MINISTER OF STATE FOROUHAR WAS PLANNING ON OCTOBER 14 TO GO TO THE KURDISH AREA TO NEGOTIATE WITH LEADERS OF THE OUTLAWED KURDISH DEMOCRATIC PARTY. THE MEETINGS WERE REPORTEDLY ARRANGED THROUGH JALAL TALEBANI WHEN FOROUHAR VISITED KURDESTAN LAST WEEK. THE PRESS ALSO REPORTS THAT FOROUHAR MAY ALREADY HAVE MET SHEIKH EZZADIN HOUSSEINI ONCE DURING HIS KURDESTAN VISIT LAST WEEK. | IN AN ASIDE, GEORGIS SAID THAT JALAL TALEBANI IS NOT VERY STRONG ONLY HAS ABOUT 700 MEN AT HIS DISPOSAL. THAHE DID NOT FEEL THAT MINISTER OF STATE FOROUHAR (HIMSELF A KURD) HAD ACTUALLY BEEN IN TOUCH WITH KDP LEADERS TO NEGOTIATE A CEASEFIRE IN KURDESTAN. | JALAL TALEBANI

label: JALEH SQUARE
summary: JALEH SQUARE | EARLY REPORTS INDICATE THAT A LARGE CROWD GATHERED IN JALEH SQUARE (NEAR MAJLES) IN SOUTH TEHRAN AND REFUSED APPEAL OF AYATOLLAH NOURI TO DISPERSE. CROED, ACCORING TO RADIO PRESS TICKERS, VANCED ON SECURITY FORCES ATTEMPTING TO DISARM THEM. | THERE ARE NO NEW REPORTS OF DEATHS, INJURY OR PROPERTY DAMAGE. ALTHOUGH SEPT. 11 IS A TRADITIONAL DAY OF MOURNING (THREE DAYS AFTER DEATHS SEPT. 8 IN JALEH SQUARE) CROWDS HAVE NOT ASSEMBLED IN DEFIANCE OF MARTIAL LAW. GUNFIRE WAS HEARD THROUGHOUT NIGHT SEPT. 10-11, ESPECIALLY IN SOUTH TEHRAN, BUT THIS PROBABLY ATTRIBUTABLE TO SECURITY FORCES POLICY OF FIRING INTO THE AIR TO HALT OR DETER VIOLATORS. | CDHRF STORY IS THAT REGISTRATION OF BODIES AT ONLY TEHRAN CEMETARY EXCEEDED NORMAL 750-800 PER DAY BODY COUNT BY 2000 ON SEPT 9 AND BY 1000 ON SEPT 19. MINATCHI CLAIMED THESE EXTRAS COULD BE CONSIDERED RIOT VICTIMS, BASED ON EVIDENCE OF WITNESSES WHO HAD BEEN NEAR JALEH SQUARE. EMBOFF RECOMMENDED HE TELL STORY TO NEWSMEN WHO MIGHT BE IN BETTER POSITION TO CHECK CLAIMS. | NEWSMAN WHO HAS HAD SOME THREE YEARS' EXPERIENCE ESTIMATED TEHRAN CROWDS AND WITNESSED EVENTS SAID THERECOULD NOT HAVE BEEN MORE THAN 2,000-3,000 PEOPLE IN JALEH SQUARE WHEN FIRING STARTED SEPT 8; DISIDENT CLAIM THAT THERE WERE 6,000-7,000 THERE IS "RIDICULOUS". LETTER, BEING POUCHED TO SCHNEIDER, CLAIMS 60,000 DEMONSTRATORS ASSEMBLED IN JALEH SQUARE MORNING SEPT 8 AND WERE SEATED WHEN ARMY FIRED "WITH NO WARNING." LETTER CLAIMS "SEVERAL THOUSANDS" WERE KILLED, THEN GIVE FIGURE 3,000 DEAD WITH MANY WOUNDED. LETTER THEN NOTES ARREST OF CDHRF'S EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE HEAD, ENG. | JALEH SQUARE

summary: JAMSHID HORMOZ | JAMSHID HORMOZ IS AUSTRIAN-EDUCATED ARCHITECT WHO WAS PRESIDENT OF ANTI-SHAH IRANIAN STUDENTS FEDERATION DURING HIS STUDENT DAYS IN VIENNA. HE WAS IDENTIFIED BY SAVAK WHILE ATTENDING A MEETING OF THE WORLD FEDERATION OF UNIVERSITY STUDENTS IN EAST GERMANY AND WAS ARRESTED UPON HIS RETURN TO IRAN IN 1971 ALTHOUGH HORMOZ CLAIMS THAT MEMBERSHIP IN THE FEDERATION WAS NOT AT THAT TIME ILLEGAL. | CLAIMING THAT HIS VIEWS ARE SIMILAR TO THOSE OF A MAJORITY OF IRANIAN STUDENTS AND THE UNIVERSITY COMMUNITY, HORMOZ STATED THAT THE IDEAL OUTCOME OF THE PRESENT POLITICAL STRIFE WOULD BE NOT ONLY THE ABDICATION OF THE SHAH BUT THE FORMATION OF A PEOPLE'S COURT TO TRY HIM FOR HIS CRIMES. THE COURT SHOULD BE HELD IN STRICT ACCORDANCE WITH IRANIAN LAW AND SHOULD PERMIT THE SHAH THE BEST LEGAL COUNSEL IN IRAN OR FROM ANY OTHER COUNTRY WHICH WOULD BE WILLING TO DEFEND HIM. | HORMOZ WAS CONFIDENT THAT THE RESULT OF ANY FAIR LEGAL PROCESS AGAINST THE SHAH WOULD BE TO "NAIL THAT SUCKER TO THE WALL" (LIBERAL TRANSLATION WHICH CONVEYS THE FEELING ACCURATELY). HOWEVER, HORMOZ FEELS THAT THE EVENTUAL OUTCOME OF THE POLITICAL STRUGGLE IN IRAN AND THE FORM OF ANY FUTURE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT SHOULD BE DECIDED BY VOTE OF THE PEOPLE. HIS ONLY CONDITION WOULD BE THAT ANY IRANIAN GOVERNMENT SHOULD PERMIT FREE EXPRESSION OF POLITICAL VIEWS. | ALTHOUGH HE CLAIMS NOT TO BE ANTI-AMERICAN AND INSISTS THAT THE IRANIAN PEOPLE HAVE NO QUARREL WITH THE U.S. PEOPLE, HORMOZ IS ADAMANTLY OPPOSED TO U.S. POLICY IN IRAN. summary: JOURNAL DE TEHERAN | COMMENT: PRESS REPORTS CARRIED LOCALLY CONTINUE TO EMPHASIZE THREATENING CHARACTER OF NEW REGIME TO BASIC IRANIAN INTERESTS. summary: JUDGES | EMBASSY UNDERSTANDS THAT FIFTY-FOUR JUDGES SIGNED LETTER TO STATE SUPREME COURT PRESIDENT YEGANEH WHICH SAYS COURTS HAVE BEEN DOWNGRADED IN IMPORTANCE. JUDGES CALLED FOR REASSERTION OF JUDICIAL SYSTEM'S JURISDICTION AND ABOLITION OF SPECIAL PROSECUTION AUTHORITIES UNQUOTE AND RETURN OF PROMOTIONS AND ASSIGNMENTS OF JUDGES TO STATE SUPREME COURT. DOCUMENT ALSO CALLS FOR LESS EXECUTIVE INTERFERENCE IN JUDICIAL SYSTEM. WE UNDERSTAND VERY UNOFFICIALLY THAT YEGANEH CALLED JUDGES TOGETHER AND TOLD THEM THAT IRAN'S DEVELOPMENT REQUIRED COURTS TO TAKE A MORE SUBORDINATE ROLE, BUT THIS WOULD EVENTUALLY CHANGE. HE ASKED THE FIFTY-FOUR SIGNERS TO REAFFIRM THEIR LOYALTY TO THE NATION. | THE JUDGES' LETTER O THE TOP JUDGE IN THE COUNTRY (TEHRAN A-176) WAS MET HEAD ON BY THE GOI WITH A REQUEST THAT THE JUDGES RESCIND THEIR MOST POINTED CRITICISMS AND CONTINUE O FUNCTION WITHIN THE CURRENT SYSTEM WHICH THE GOI CONSIDERED BEST FOR IRN'S PRESENT STAGE OF DEVELOPMENT. A DOZEN JUDGES WHO REFUSED TO GO ALONG HAVE BEEN SUSPENDED FROM THEIR DUTIES, BUT WE ARE NOT AWARE OF ANY FURTHER MEASURES TAKEN AGAINST THEM. summary: KAYHAN | AS PART OF LONG KAYHAN INTERVIEW PRINTED SEPTEMBER 13TH, SHAH HAD FOLLOWING REMARKS ON U.S.-- IRAN RELATIONS IN REPLY TO QUESTION ABOUT HIS FORTHCOMING VISIT TO WASHINGTON: "RELATIONS BETWEEN IRAN AND THE UNITED STATES ARE GOOD AND I DON'T THINK THEY COULD BE OTHERWISE. HE SAID THAT CONTRARY TO A KAYHAN CARTOONIST'S RECENT CREATION SHOWING A PERSON WITH A PEN WAITING FOR THE GREEN LIGHT, IRANIANS CAN AND DO WRITE WHATEVER THEY LIKE. WHILE MUCH OF WHAT IS WRITTEN IS "IRRESPONSIBLE CHATTER" ABOUT SUBJECTS ON WHICH WRITERS ARE SOMEWHAT IGNORANT, IRAN WELCOMES THIS CHANGE IN TACTICS BY IRAN'S OPPONENTS SINCE THEY CAN ONLY PUT FORWARD A WEAK CASE, WHILE IRAN PROVIDES THE STRONGEST ARGUMENTS AND, FORTUNATELY, THE TRUTH WILL OUT. | SHAH BEGAN INTERVIEW WITH KAYHAN EDITOR AMIR TAHERI (WHICH APPEARED SEPT 13, ALTHOUGH GRANTED WEEK BEFORE) WITH REFERENCE TO HIS SIMILAR INTERVIEW 11 MONTHS AGO (REFTELS). NOTING THAT HE HAD RECENTLY ISSUED EDICTS TO THE GOVERNMENT ON THE SUBJECT OF HOUSING, HE TOLD HIS KAYHAN INTERVIEWER THAT THE GOVERNMENT SHOULD NOT ENTER THE MARKET WITH ITS OWN EXTENSIVE LAND HOLDINGS AND SELL THESE TO BREAK ARTIFICIALLY HIGH PRICES. HE FOUND THE RUN-UP IN LAND PRICES TO BE "NOT NATURAL." HE FOUND THE PHENOMENON OF A WORKER RECEIVING 2,000 RIALS A NIGHT AND MASTER-BUILDERS 5,000 A NIGHT FOR WORKING OUTSIDE TEHRAN CITY LIMITS ON ILLEGAL HOME CONSTRUCTION TO BE "COMPLETELY ASTONISHING." | KAYHAN

label: LADJEVARDI
summary: LADJEVARDI | THEY REPORTED THAT BUSINESSMENARE PLAGUED BY SEVERE SHORTAGES OF BOTH IRANIAN MONEY AND FOREIGN EXCHANGE. LADJEVARDI, WHO HAS NO SHORTANGE OF LIQUID ASSETS, FEARS THAT HE WILL NOT BE ABLE TO FIND ENOUGH CASH TO MEET HIS NEXT PAYROLL. AMERICAN CITIZEN EMPLOYEES, IF PAID IN RIALS, ARE NOT ABLE TO CONVERT THEIR PAY INTO DOLLARS. | LADJEVARDI SAID THE ECONOMY HAD SUFFERED A FURTHER SERIOUS DETERIORATION SINCE THE EARLY DECEMBER MEETING. THIS WAS TRUE BOTH IN A DOMESTIC SENSE AND IN THE FOREIGN PERCEPTION OF IRAN'S ECONOMY. | LADJEVARDI SAID THE CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY IS THE WORST AFFECTED SO FAR BY THE CRISIS. MANY PROJECTS HAVE BEEN STOPPED AND FACE POSSIBLE COLLAPSE. LARGE NUMBERS OF WORKERS HAVE BEEN LAID OFF AS A RESULT. THE DISTRESS OF THE CONSTRUCTION INDUSTRY HAS AFFECTED THE BEHSHAHR GROUP DIRECTLY. DEMAND FOR ITS STEEL FABRICATION PRODUCTS HAS DROPPED OFF SIGNIFICANTLY AND HAS RESULTED IN LAYOFFS OF INDUSTRIAL WORKERS. LADJEVARDI SAID MOST OTHER INDUSTRIES HAVE NOT YET BEEN SO SEVERELY CRIPPLED; THE DANGER IS NOT SO MUCH BANKRUPTCY AS A WIDESPREAD SUSPENSION OF INDUSTRIAL PRODUCTION WITH CONSEQUENT LAYOFFS. | LADJEVARDI SAID THAT THE DEMAND FOR FOOD PRODUCTS AND OTHER ESSENTIALS IS EXTRAORDINARILY HIGH. SINCE IPAC AND LAPCO ARE COMPLETELY SHUT-DOWN THE OBVIOUS OPTION IS ONE OF STOCK MANAGEMENT RATHER THAN PRORATIONING OF REDUCED LIFTINGS. HOWEVER, IPAC HAS PRACTICALLY NO CRUDE LEFT IN STORAGE ON KHARG ISLAND (AND PROBABLY LITTLE IF ANY ON THE OFF SHORE BARGE THROUGH WHICH CYRUS FIELD CRUDE IS EXPORTED). | WE DO NOT HAVE ANY SPECIFIC INFORMATION ON HOW MUCH CRUDE IS LEFT IN LAPCO'S APPROXIMATELY 3 MILLION BARRELS OF TANKAGE ON LAVAN ISLAND BUT IT IS UNLIKELY THAT THERE IS MUCH. | THE IMPORTANT QUESTION IS WHETHER AND HOW NIOC COULD OBTAIN INCREMENTAL QUANTITIES OF KHUZESTAN FIELDS CRUDE TO REPLACE THAT LOST FROM THE SHUT DOWN OF IPAC AND LAPCO. label: MARIVAN
summary: MARIVAN | KURDISTAN'S GOVERNOR . HE REPORTED THAT TWO-THIRDS OF THE POPULATION HAD LEFT THE CITY, OFFICES WERE CLOSED AND TELEPHONE COMMUNICATIONS HAD BEEN CUT. REVOLUTIONARY GUARDSMEN APPARENTLY CONTROL HIGHWAY ACCESS TO THE CITY, AND REPORTS CLAIM THEY ARE STOPPING FOOD SUPPLY TRUCKS FROM TRYING TO REACH THE RESIDENTS WHO ARE CAMPED OUTSIDE THE CITY. | ON JULY 25, SANANDAJ SAW A DEMONSTRATION BY "THOUSANDS" TO PROTEST THE MARIVAN INCIDENTS, THE "INVASION OF MARIVAN" BY REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS, AND THE "RADIO AND TELEVISION PROPAGANDA AIMED AGAINST THE KURDS." IN THE MEANTIME, A GROUP CLAIMED TO BE IN THE THOUSANDS CONSISTING OF RESIDENTS OF SANANDAJ, MAHABAD, SAQQEZ AND BANEH, IS MARCHING ON FOOT TO MARIVAN TO SHOW SUPPORT FOR THE RESIDENTS OF THAT CITY. OTHER PRESS REPORTS CLAIM THAT ARMY TANK REINFORCEMENTS BEING SENT FROM QAHRAMANSHAR (FORMERLY KERMANSHAH) TOWARDS SANANDAJ HAD BEEN STOPPED BY THE KURDISH RESIDENTS OF KAMYARAN, WHO SURROUNDED THE TANKS AND FORCED THEM TO HALT. | SUMMARY: KHUZESTAN PROVINCE QUIET, BUT MARIVAN CONTINUES TO SIMMER. LOCAL KURDS THAT THE PGOI HAS RENEGED ON AN AGREEMENT TO LET THEM HANDLE SECURITY THEMSELVES, AND THE ARMY HAS MOVED IN. | TALKS CONTINUED DURING THE WEEK IN AN ATTEMPT TO DEFUSE THE MARIVAN CRISIS, AND DR. MUSTAFA CHAMRAN FREQUENTLY REFERRED TO IN RECENT PRESS REPORTS AS DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER AND BRIGADIER GEN. IZADI VISITED THE AREA TO PARTICIPATE IN THE DISCUSSIONS. AN ACCORD WAS FINALLY SIGNED ON 1 AUGUST. ACCORDING TO THE AGREEMENT, THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS SENT TO THE CITY WERE TO GRADUALLY RETURN TO THEIR OWN HEADQUARTERS, AND A LOCAL COUNCIL WOULD BE RESPONSIBLE FOR PEACE AND ORDER IN THE CITY. DESPITE THE SIGNING, HOWEVER, CLASHES NEAR MARIVAN BETWEEN REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS AND LOCAL INHABITANTS WERE REPORTED ON 3 AUGUST. | MARIVAN

label: MASHALLAH
summary: MASHALLAH | MASHALLAH, A PROFESSIONAL BUTCHER BY TRADE, CLAIMS TO HAVE BEEN "IN PRISON" WITH KHOMEINI FIFTEEN YEARS AGO. UPON QUESTIONING, IT TURNS OUT THAT HE WAS A GUARD AT THE PRISON WHERE KHOMEINI WAS HELD. WHEN IT BECAME KNOWN TO THE PRISON AUTHORITIES THAT MASHALLAH WAS CONSORTING WITH THE AYATOLLAH, HE WAS TRANSFERRED TO ANOTHER PRISON. IRONICALLY, KHOMEINI HIMSELF WAS LATER MOVED TO THIS SAME PRISON. MASHALLAH CLAMS TO HAVE A CONTINUING CLOSE RELATIONSHIP WITH THE AYATOLLAH AND HAS ON SEVERAL OCCASIONS OFFERED TO TAKE EMBASSY OFFICERS TO MEET HIM. | MASHALLAH'S GROUP QUICKLY EARNED ITSELF A REPUTATION FOR CRUDE, ROUGH BEHAVIOR. MOST OF THE TWELVE OR SO MOJAHEDDIN HE SURROUNDS HIMSELF WITH ARE POORLY EDUCATED BAZAARIS WHO PREFER ACTION TO WORDS. | IN THE FIRST FEW DAYS AFTER THE ATTACK, A NUMBER OF AUTOMOBILES DISAPPEARED FROM THE COMPOUND, LOCKED ROOM CONTAINING AMERICAN EMPLOYEES' AIR FREIGHT WAS BROKEN INTO AND LOOTED, AND MANY OF THE ARTICLES CONFISCATED FROM DEPARTING EVACUEES (FIREARMS, LIQUOR, ETC.) WERE SPIRITED FROM THE COMPOUND. THE "GOVERNMENT'S MOJAHEDDIN" STATIONED AT THE AMBASSADOR'S RESIDENCE ARE CONVINCED THAT MASHALLAH IS THE MASTERMIND OF A BOOMING RIP-OFF RING. | THIS EFFORT BY THE HEADQUARTERS GROUP TO BLOW THE WHISTLE ON MASHALLAH WAS COUNTERED A FEW DAYS LATER BY MASHALLAH'S OWN VERSION OF A END-AROUND. CAPITALIZING ON AN OBVIOUS FRUSTRATION BY THE EMBASSY IN TRYING TO DEAL WITH THE VARIOUS GROUPS ASSIGNED TO PROTECT US, MASHALLAH CALLED A SECRET MEETING TO PROPOSE TO THE RELEVANT OFFICERS THAT THE EMBASSY BRING BACK ITS UNARMED FORCE OF GATE GUARDS, RELEASE THE HOMAFARS AND PUT A MUCH SMALLER MOJAHEDDIN FORCE UNDER THE DIRECTION OF HIMSELF. summary: MASHHAD | FINALLY, THERE IS THE OBJECTIVE OF SELF-EDUCATION. THIS IS A NEW PART OF THE WORLD TO ME. I AM SPENDING A LOT OF TIME READING ITS HISTORY, LEARNING ITS CULTURE, EXPLORING ITS GEOGRAPHY AND DEMOGRAPHY. I HAVE ALREADY VISITED TABRIZ, MASHED, ISFAHAN, SHIRAZ, QASVIN, AND THE CASPIAN COAST. LATER IN THE YEAR, I WILL VISIT ABADAN, KHORRAMSHAHR, BANDAR ABBAS, BANDAR SHAHPUR, KHARG ISLAND AND OTHER POINTS IN THE PERSIAN GULF. I MAY ALSO ASK DEPT CONCURRENCE IN VISITS TO NEIGHBORING COUNTRIES. I EXPECT TO START LEARING FARSI IN OCTOBER. THIS INCIDENT WAS CITED TO THE CHARGE AT A GATHERING RECENTLY WITH THE IMPLICATION IT WAS EVIDENCE OF "AGENTS PROVOCATEURS" ACTING ON BEHALF OF THE GOVERNMENT. HE HAS SERVED AS DEPARTMENT HEAD AT PAHLAVI HOSPITAL AND BECAME HEAD OF STUDENT AFFAIRS AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY IN 1968. summary: MBEKI | WHEN AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN PROBED AS TO HOW THIS MIGHT BE DONE AND WHETHER REBELS ARE REPRESENTED IN ZAIRE'S CENTRAL GOVERNMENT, MBEKA SAID THERE WERE SOME MINISTERS IN KINSHASA GOVERNEMENT BUT THEY WERE REGARDED AS TRAITORS BY THEIR FELLOW TRIBESMEN ONCE THEY WERE APPOINTED. label: MENDELEVICH
summary: MENDELEVICH | COMMENT: I HAVE NO IDEA WHY I WAS PURPOSELY SOUGHT OUT TO CONVEY THE FOREGOING. MENDELEVICH'S VISIT HERE, HOWEVER, MAY BE IN RESPONSE TO A PERCEPTION THAT IRAN LIKES TO BE KEPT CLOSELY INFORMED ABOUT DISCUSSIONS IN WHICH IT HAS A LIVELY INTEREST. HE WILL DOUBTLESS TELL THE GOI THAT THE NEXT SESSION OF OUR TALKS IS SCHEDULED FOR BERN DECEMBER 1. AN ARRANGEMENT OF WHICH I WAS UNAWARE UNTIL MENDELEVICH TOLD ME. | EVENING OF NOVEMBER 14 I HAD AN OPPORTUNITY TO ASK SOVIET AMBASSADOR VINOGRADOV HOW AMBASSADOR MENDELEVICH'S TALKS WITH THE IRANIANS WENT ON THE INDIAN OCEAN. VINOGRADOV TOLD ME THAT MENDELEVICH HAD GIVEN THE IRANIANS A STATUS REPORT ON THE US-USSR TALKS WHICH AS HE DESCRIBED IT WAS VERY MUCH ALONG THE LINES OF THE SAME REPORT WE HAD GIVEN THE GOI ON THE BASIS OF STATE 238371 AND 241701. VINOGRADOV SAID THAT INITIALLY HE HAD SENSED THAT THE IRANIANS WERE WORRIED THAT THE U.S. | ACCORDING TO VINOGRADOV THE IRANIANS SEEMED MUCH MORE RELAXED AT THE CONCLUSION OF THE SOVIET EXPLANATION AND PLEASED THAT THE SOVIETS HAD TAKEN THE TROUBLE TO SEND THE HEAD OF THEIR DELEGATION TO TEHRAN TO FILL THEM IN ON OUR TALKS. HE SAID THAT MENDELEVICH HAD "DIPLOMATICALLY" MADE THE POINT THAT THE INDIAN OCEAN WAS NOT THE EXCLUSIVE PRESERVE OF THE LITTORAL STATES AND THAT MARITIME POWERS SUCH AS THE U.S. | MENDELEVICH ASSURED THE IRANIANS THAT THE US-USSR TALKS IN NO WAY IMPINGED ON IRANIAN INTEREST WHICH HE ACKNOWLEDGED WERE LEGITIMATE--IRAN BEING ONE OF THE INDIAN OCEAN'S LITTORAL STATES--AND SAID THAT THERE WAS NO INTENTION OF A DEAL BEING MADE BEHIND IRAN'S BACK. IN SUM, VINOGRADOV THOUGHT THAT THE TALKS HAD GONE VERY WELL AND THAT THEY HAD BEEN PARTICULARLY USEFUL AND TIMELY IN VIEW OF THE SHAH'S IMMINENT MEETING WITH PRESIDENT CARTER, WHERE THE SUBJECT OF THE INDIAN OCEAN MIGHT COME UP. | EARLIER IN THE DAY I HAD ASKED ACTING FOREIGN MINISTER ZELLI HOW THE MENDELEVICH TALKS HAD GONE. ZELLI EVIDENCED SURPRISE THAT I WAS AWARE OF MENDELEVICH'S VISIT AND SAID THAT HE HAD NOT MENTIONED IT TO ME BECAUSE "YOU HAVE NOT CHOSEN TO TELL US ABOUT THE US-USSR TALKS." HE ADDED THAT HE COULD NOT SAY ANYTHING FURTHER ON THE SUBJECT. I REMONSTRATED THAT HIS WAS NOT TRUE AND THAT WE HAD IN FACT PROVIDED THE SHAH AND THE FOREIGN MINISTER WITH TWO STATUS REPORTS. | MENDELEVICH

summary: MINISTER EVENSEN | I WOULD APPRECIATE YOUR HAVING THE FOLLOWING MESSAGE DELIVERED TO AMBASSADOR KAZEMI. AS YOU WILL NOTE, I HOPE KAZEMI WILL BE ABLE TO GO TO GENEVA FOR THE SMALL PRIVATE MEETING MINISTER EVENSEN IS CONVENING ON NOVEMBER 14. I THINK HE IS A PRAGMATIST AND WOULD HAVE A GOOD DEAL TO CONTRIBUTE TO OUR DELIBERATIONS. | BEGIN TEXT DEAR MR. AMBASSADOR: I UNDERSTAND THAT YOU LIKE MYSELF RECEIVED AN INVITATION FROM MINISTER EVENSEN TO ATTEND A SMALL PRIVATE MEETING OF HEADS OF DELEGATION IN GENEVA ON NOVEMBER 14. IN ADVANCE OF THAT MEETING I WOULD LIKE TO SHARE WITH YOU SOME OF OUR THINKING. | IN CONJUNCTION WITH OUR POLICY REVIEW I HAVE BEEN CONSULTING INFORMALLY WITH A NUMBER OF OUR CONFERENCE COLLEAGUES TO ASCERTAIN THEIR VIEWS ON WAYS IN WHICH THE NEGOTIATIONS MIGHT BE RELAUNCHED ON A FAIR AND REASONABLE BASIS. MY GOVERNMENT ATTACHES GREAT IMPORTANCE TO THE PROPOSITION THAT THE STARTING POINT FOR FURTHER NEGOTIATIONS SHOULD BE NO LESS REASONABLE THAN THE TEXTS WHICH MINISTER EVENSEN SUBMITTED TO CHAIRMAN ENGO. I HAVE THEREFORE BEEN INTERESTED TO FIND OUT TO WHAT EXTENT THIS CONCERN IS SHARED BY OTHER CONFERENCE PARTICIPANTS. | DO YOU THINK THIS WAY OF PROCEEDING WOULD COMMAND GENERAL SUPPORT? I NOTED ABOVE THAT MY GOVERNMENT BELIEVES THAT THE STARTING POINT FOR FURTHER NEGOTIATIONS SHOULD BE NO LESS REASONABLE THAN THE TEXTS WHICH MINISTER EVENSEN SUBMITTED TO CHAIRMAN ENGO. THE UNITED STATES DID NOT, AS I HAVE MADE CLEAR, REGARD THOSE TEXTS AS SUBSTANTIVELY SATISFACTORY; NOT, I UNDERSTAND, DID THE GROUP OF 77. | MINISTER EVENSEN

label: MINISTER SAHABI
summary: MINISTER SAHABI | SUMMARY: CHARGE DISCUSSED WITH MINISTER SAHABI U.S.IRAN RELATIONS. MINISTER EXPRESSED HOPE CURRENT MISUNDERSTANDINGS WOULD NOT IMPEDE GOOD TIES WHICH PGOI WANTS. | AFTER CHARGE EXPRESSED U.S. INTEREST IN GOOD TIES WITH NEW PGOI AND ASSURED MINISTER THAT USG WAS NOT RPT NOT INTERFERING IN IRAN AND WOULD NOT DO SO, SAHABI IMMEDIATELY AND IN AN UNDERSTANDING MANNER EXPRESSED REGRETS FOR MEDIA ATTACKS ON USG IN WAKE OF PUBLICITY GIVEN JAVITS RESOLUTION ON IRAN. SAHABI SAID IRAN IS IN REVOLUTIONARY PERIOD AND AFFIRMED TWICE THAT BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT WANTS GOOD RELATIONS WITH U.S. HE NOTED, HOWEVER, THAT THERE ARE MANY QUESTIONS WHICH MUST BE RESOLVED BETWEEN IRAN AND U.S. AND REGRETTED VERY MUCH THAT MISUNDERSTANDINGS UNQUOTE WERE MARRING PUBLIC SCENE. | CHARGE ASKED ABOUT NEW GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE. SAHABI REPLIED THAT DRAFT CONSTITUTION WOULD BE RELEASED WITHIN TWO WEEKS. CONSTITUTIONAL ASSEMBLY WOULD BE CALLED WITHIN 30 TO 60 DAYS. PGOI EXPECTED ASSEMBLY TO LAST A MAXIMUM OF FOUR MONTHS, WITH ELECTIONS FOR PRESIDENT AND THE PARLIAMENT TO FOLLOW TOWARD THE END OF THIS YEAR. WITH RESPECT TO RELATIONSHIP OF REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS TO NEW GOVERNMENTAL STRUCTURE, SAHABI SAID THIS CONFUSES EVEN MEMBERS OF GOVERNMENT. FOR NOW, DR. MUSTAFA CHAMRAN IS THE HEAD OF THE GUARDS, BUT HE IS NOT RPT NOT A DEPUTY PRIME MINISTER. DEPUTY PM BANI-ASSADI HAS NO RPT NO CONNECTION WITH THE REVOLUTIONARY GUARDS. | MINISTER SAHABI

label: MINISTRY OF COMMERCE
summary: MINISTRY OF COMMERCE | GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEES OF THE MINISTRIES OF FINANCE, COMMERCE, JUSTICE, THE PLAN AND BUDGET ORGANIZATION AND AT LEAST A SEGMENT OF THE EMPLOYEES OF SEVERAL OTHER MINISTRIES CONTINUE THEIR STRIKE. NEWSPAPER ACCOUNTS AN EMPLOYEE OF THE MINISTRY OF COMMERCE AS SAYING THAT GOVERNMENT WORKERS WOULD CONTINUE THEIR ACTION UNTIL MANAGEMENT AGREED TO RAISE SALARIES BY 100 PERCENT. THE EMPLOYEE CONTINED THAT GOVERNMENT WORKERS WERE ALSO DEMANDING THE RIGHT TO ESTABLISH A GOVERNMENT EMPLOYEE'S UNION, WHICH WOULD COORDINATE THE ACTIVITIES OF WORKERS IN ALL MINISTRIES AND RELATED AGENCIES. | INSTALLATION OF MARTIAL LAW FORCED THEIR POSTPONEMENT, BUT THEY WILL EVENTUALLY TAKE PLACE. MEANWHILE, AN HONEST, RESPECTED CIVIL SERVANT IN MINISTRY OF COMMERCE HAS BEEN ACTING AS "SUPERVISOR" ADMINISTERING THE GUILD'S AFFAIRS WITH THE HELP OF FIVE GUILD MEMBERS. SENATOR (WHO IS PROMINENT OLD-TIMER IN TEHRAN POLITICS) SAID THERE IS NO PROBLEM WITH THEM; THEY WILL WORK WITH THE GOI. | THE LABOR SITUATION IN TEHRAN AFTER THE LONG ASHURA HOLIDAY (DECEMBER 8-12) IS ABOUT THE SAME AS BEFORE. MOST GOVERNMENT MINISTRIES ARE OFFICIALLY OPEN, BUT FUNCTION ONLY PARTIALLY. THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE (MEAF), ONE OF THE WORST AFFECTED BY STRIKE ACTIVITY, WAS VIRTUALLY CLOSED ON DECEMBER 12, BUT IMPROVED SOMEWHAT ON DECEMBER 13 AS THE TREASURY DEPARTMENT (RESPONSIBLE FOR DISBURSEMENT OF FUNDS) BEGAN TO FUNCTION ONCE AGAIN. THE CUSTOMS AND TAX UNITS IN THE MEAF REMAINED ON STRIKE. OTHER ECONOMIC MINISTRIES, INCLUDING AGRICULTURE AND COMMERCE, APPEARED TO BE FUNCTIONING AT THE TOP LEVEL ONLY. | THE MINISTRY OF FINANCE REMAINED CLOSED. THE MINISTRY OF COMMERCE AND THE MINISTRY OF INDUSTRY AND MINES REPORTED THAT EMPLOYEES WERE PRESENT BUT FUNCTIONING AT A VERY LOW LEVEL OF ACTIVITY. THE SAME WAS TRUE OF NIOC. | (C) CAREER HIGHLIGHTS: 1958-59 CHARGE D'AFFAIRES, MOSCOW 1965-66 DIRECTOR OF FOREIGN TRADE, MINISTRY OF COMMERCE. 1966-68 JOINT SECRETARY, MINISTRY OF COMMERCE 1968-72 CONSUL GENERAL, NEW YORK; CONCURRENTLY ACCREDITED AS AMBASSADOR TO COSTA RICA 1972-75 AMBASSADOR TO ROMANIA 1975-76 ADDITIONAL SECRETARY FOR WEST ASIA, MINISTRY OF EXTERNAL AFFAIRS (MEA) 1976-78 SECRETARY FOR ECONOMIC RELATIONS, MEA 1978-79 AMBASSADOR TO IRAN | MINISTRY OF COMMERCE

label: MINISTRY OF LABOR
summary: MINISTRY OF LABOR | STRIKE BEGAN WITH ABOUT 50 TO 60 PERCENT OF DRE'S PARTICIPATING AND REACHED 100 PERCENT LEVEL BY FOLLOWING DAY, ACCORDING TO COMPANY'S TEHRAN REP. REPRESENTATIVES OF MINISTRY OF LABOR, SYNDICATES, DRE'S, OSCO AND NIOC CONVENED SPECIAL MEETING SEPTEMBER 26 TO DISCUSS SITUATION. DRE SPOKESMEN PRESENTED COMPANY WITH LIST OF 48 UNOFFICIAL DEMANDS, TOPPED BY REQUEST FOR 50 PERCENT WAGE INCREASE. | THERE HAVE BEEN SEVERAL NEGOTIATING MEETINS BUT THERE HAS BEEN NO EVIDENCE OF PROGRESS. THE MINISTRY OF LABOR AND NIOC HAVE REPORTEDLY TAKEN THE LINE THAT EVERYTHING IS NEGOTIABLE BUT ONLY AFTER THE ILLEGAL STRIKE IS TERMINATED. WE UNDERSTAND THAT GOI NEGOTIATORS MADE A VAGUE THREAT YESTERDAY AGAINST DRE'S WHO DID NOT REPORT FOR ESSENTIAL JOBS (INCLUDING ALL JOBS ON KHARG) BY 2:00 P.M. | PRESENT STRIKE LEADERS MAINTAIN THAT THEIR NOMINAL REPRESENTATIVES ARE TOO COMPLIANT AND DO NOT REPRESENT THE WILL OF THE OVERWHELMING MAJORITY OF OSCO WORKERS. NIOC AND MINISTRY OF LABOR OFFICIALS INITIALLY RESPONDED BY RECOMMENDING THAT ESTABLISHED ELECTION PROCEDURES BE USED BY THE DRE'S TO SELECT NEW REPRESENTATIVES WHO WOULD HAVE A LEGAL RIGHT TO NEGOTIATE ON GENERAL TERMMS OF EMPLOYMENT. APPARENTLY THE DRE'S ARE MORE ANXIOUS TO PRESS THEIR IMMEDIATE GRIEVANCES THAN TO SELECT NEW SYNDICATE REPRESENTATIVES. | IT IS IN ANY CASE SOMEWHAT OF A MOOT POINT SINCE NIOC AND MINISTRY OF LABOR OFFICIALS HAVE BEEN NEGOTIATING WITH THE STRIKE LEADERS AND HAVE, THEREBY, GIVEN DE FACTO RECOGNITION OF THE DRE'S RIGHT TO CHOOSE THEIR OWN INFORMAL SPOKESMEN. | THE LACK OF STRIKE FUNDS, AN OBVIOUS BY-PRODUCT OF THE LACK OF ORGANIZED LABOR, MUST ALSO BE CONSIDERED IN THE PAY QUESTION. LASTLY, IN AT LEAST ONE SPECIFIC CASE IN WHICH A PRIVATE COMPANY REFUSED TO CONCEDE TO EMPLOYEES' DEMANDS AND SAID IT WOULD CLOSE UNTIL DEMANDS MODERATED, THE MINISTRY OF LABOR TOLD THE FIRM IT WAS VIOLATING MARTIAL LAW. IT WAS "LOCKING" ITS EMPLOYEES OUT OF THE BUILDING AND THUS CREATING AN ASSEMBLY ON THE STREETS. | MINISTRY OF LABOR

label: MOBASHERI
summary: MOBASHERI | IN TALK WITH MINISTER OF JUSTICE MOBASHERI, AYATOOOAH KHOMEINI SAID EUROPEAN-STYLE SYSTEM OF COURTS MUST GO, AND ISLAMIC CANONS MUST RULE. HE PARTICULARLY CRITICIZED MULTIPLE HEARING PROCEDURES, NOTING THAT "EVERY HEARING MUST END IN A FINAL, ABSOLUTE DECISION IN A SINGLE PHASE." GOI HAS ALSO ANNOUNCED THAT FAMILY PROTECTION ACT HAS BEEN ABOLISHED ON KHOMEINI'S ORDERS. | MIN OF JUSTIC MOBASHERI ANNOUNCED YESTERDAY THAT THE HOVEYDA TRIAL MIGHT CONTINUE IN EITHER THE SENATE OR THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE ITSELF, AS SOON AS NEW PROCEDURES FOR THE REVOLUTIONARY TRIALS AND IMPLEMENTATION OF VERDICTS ARE WORKED OUT PER KHOMEINI'S ORDER OF 16 MARCH HALTING ALL THE SUMMARY TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS. NEW REGULATIONS GOVERNING SUCH TRIALS ARE TO BE FORMULATED BY THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT AND THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. | SINCE THE ABOVE PARAGRAPHS WERE DRAFTED MINISTER OF JUSTICE MOBASHERI HAS SAID THAT THE VERSION OF THE NEW REGULATIONS ANNOUNCED OVER THE GOVERNMENT-CONTROLLED VOICE OF THE IRANIAN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC AND PUBLISHED IN THE PRESS APRIL 5 DIFFERS FROM THE TEXT OF THE REGULATIONS APPROVED BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. HE DID NOT SAY, HOWEVER, WHAT THE DIFFERENCES ARE. WE WILL BE ATTEMPTING TO FIND OUT. MOBASHERI JUSTIFIED THE SYSTEM OF ISLAMIC COURTS ON THE GROUNDS THAT THE PRESENT SITUATION IN IRAN, LIKE WAR, REQUIRES FAST ACTION. | INSTEAD OF DISAPPEARING, THE COMMITTEES HAVE CONTINUED TO INTERVENE IN GOVERNMENTAL AND ADMINISTRATIVE LIFE WITH SIGNIFICANT NEGATIVE IMPACT ON THE PGOI'S ABILITY TO GET ITS ACT TOGETHER. FOREIGN MINISTER SANJABI'S RESIGNATION, AND THE HINTED RESIGNATIONS OF JUSTICE MINISTER MOBASHERI AND EVEN OF BAZARGAN HIMSELF ARE MANIFESTATIONS OF THIS, AND UNEVEN PERFORMANCES BYVARIOUS COMMITTEES HAVE BROUGHT SEVERAL UNDER PUBLIC CRITICISM. | ON QUESTION OF REVOLUTIONARY COURTS, MINATCHI ACKNOWLEDGED THAT IRAN HAD TAKEN A BEATING IN EYES OF WORLD, BUT STRONGLY DEFENDED NECESSITY OF VIGOROUS ACTION. MINATCHI SAID KHOMEINI HAD TOLD MINJUSTICE MOBASHERI AND HIMSELF THAT "THE PEOPLE" WERE READY TO KILL EVERYONE IN QASR PRISON, AND FAST ACTION WAS REQUIRED. POLOFF MERELY COMMENTED THAT IT WAS UNCLEAR WHETHER LEADERS LED PEOPLE OR PEOPLE LED LEADERS IN THIS CASE. | MOBASHERI

label: MOGHARABI
summary: MOGHARABI | THAT PAPER'S BRIEF STORY DID NOT PROVIDE AS COMPLETE A REPORT AS AP ITEM FILED FROM TEHRAN TODAY. FYI: AP ITEM INFLATES MOGHARABI'S RESPONSIBILITIES BY IDENTIFYING HIM AS "SECOND IN COMMAND AT IMPERIAL MILITARY HEADQUARTERS." AS NOTED ABOVE, THIS WAS NOT THE CASE. | MOGHARABI, 56-YEAR OLD FATHER OF 5 REPORTEDLY ADMITTED DURING TRIAL CLANDESTINE CONTACTS WITH FOREIGN AGENTS (INCLUDING 3 VISITS TO A "FOREGIN EMBASSY"), USE OF INVISIBLE INK AND POSSESSION OF SOPHISTICATED EQUIPMENT. HE CLAIMED, HOWEVER, THAT HE HAD STARTED SPYING ONLY AFTER BEING BLACKMAILED IN CONNECTION WITH CONTACTS WITH A MAJ NIEV IN 1944, AND THAT HE HAD HANDED OVER ONLY "GENERAL INFORMATION" AVAILABLE IN ARMS BROCHURES, VEHICLE MAINTENANCE MANUALS AND OTHER UNCLASSIFIED MATERIAL. MOGHARABI WAS FURTHER REPORTED AS SAYING THAT HE HAD NEVER REVEALED NAMES OF GOI OFFICERS IN SENSITIVE POSITIONS OR OF GOI DECODING AND DECRYPTING SYSTEMS, AND THAT HE NEVER RECEIVED MONEY FOR HIS SERVICES. | PROSECUTION RESPONDED TO ABOVE CLAIMS BY REFERRING TO GOI LEGAL DEFINITION OF "ESPIONAGE" WHICH APPLIES EQUALLY DURING WAR OR PEACETIME AND UNDER WHICH, ACCORDING TO GOI INTELLIGENCE EXPERTS, MATERIAL PROVIDED BY MOGHARABI IS INCLUDED. PROSECUTOR ALSO STATED THAT MOGHARABI'S MODE OF OPERATION, ACCORDING TO EXPERTS, EXHIBITIED EVERY SIGN OF PERSONAL INTEREST RATHER THAN COOPERATION OUT OF RELUCTANT DURESS. | PUBLICLY THERE HAS BEEN NO IDENTIFICATION OF THE "FOREIGN AGENTS" BUT IT IS COMMON KNOWLEDGE THAT THEY ARE SOVIET AGENTS. IN FACT, WE HAVE BEEN TOLD THAT THE SOVIETS WERE MENTIONED AT THE TRIAL OF MOGHARABI BUT THE PRESS WAS ASKED NOT TO REPORT THIS. | MOGHARABI WAS CONVICTED ON CHARGES OF SPYING FOR A FOREIGN POWER AND A MILITARY COURT OF APPEALS UPHELD THE DEATH SENTENCE ON DECEMBER 18. (REFTELS) | MOGHARABI

label: MOHAMMED BEHESHTI
summary: MOHAMMED BEHESHTI | AS A FIRST SUBJECT TO RAISE WITH YAZDI, ZIMMERMAN SHOULD TELL HIM THE FOLLOWING: AS YAZDI PROBABLY KNOWS, AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN HAS BEEN TRYING TO ARRANGE A MEETING BETWEEN IRANIAN MILITARY LEADERS AND MOHAMMED BEHESHTI, ONE OF KHOMEINI'S PRINCIPAL REPRESENTATIVES IN TEHRAN. BOTH SIDES SEEM TO WANT THIS MEETING BUT THEY HAVE HAD DIFFICULTY IN AGREEING WHERE IT SHOULD TAKE PLACE. | C- ENTIRE TEXT. | ON MARCH 19, POL COUNSELOR LAMBRAKIS, WITH POLOFFS TOMSETH AND METRINKO, VISITED DR. MOHAMMED BEHESHTI AT HIS HOME IN TEHRAN. THE MEETING WAS ARRANGED BY MEHDI ROWGHANI, WHO ACCOMPANIED. | AT LAMBRAKIS' INVITATION BEHESHTI BEGAN WITH AN EXPLANATION OF HOW HE SAW THE REVOLUTION AND WHERE IT WAS GOING. HE SAID THE CENTRAL EFFORT HAS BEEN TO REACH IRANIANS THAT THEIR PAST MISFORTUNES WERE NOT TO BE BLAMED ON FOREIGN INFLUENCES BUT DERIVE FROM THE IRANIANS THEMELVES. THE OBJECTIVE HAS BEEN AND CONTINUES TO BE CREATION OF A NEW IRANIAN WHO IS PREPARED TO FIGHT TO DEFEND HIMSELF BUT ONLY AFTER HIS LEADERSHIP HAS IDENTIFIED THE ENEMY. IRANIANS OF THIS GENERATION ARE SURPRISINGLY DISCIPLINED, BEHESHTI CONTINUED, AS THE SUCCESS OF THE REVOLUTION INDICATES. | THEY ARE ALSO BEING TAUGHT TO BE PATIENT AND TRY TO UNDERSTAND THOSE WHOM PAST HISTORY HAS TAUGHT THEM TO MISTRUST. BEHESHTI MADE THIS STATEMENT IN THE CONTEXT OF A QUERY REGARDING US-IRANIAN RELATIONS. HE TOOK ISSUE WITH LAMBRAKIS' SUGGESTION THAT THE PEOPLE OF IRAN DO NOT DISLIKE THE AMERICAN PEOPLE BUT ONLY CERTAIN AMERICAN POLICIES. BEHESHTI SAID THE IRANIAN PEOPLE MAY NOT BE ABLE TO READ MUCH, BUT THEY HAVE HEARD MUCH AND UNDER STAND THE FACT THAT IT WAS AMERICAN WHICH KEPT THE SHAH IN POWER SO MANY YEARS. AMERICAN POLICIES CAUSED THE ISLAMIC OPPOSITION MUCH UNNECESSARY TROUBLE (FOR EXAMPLE, AT THE CLOSING STAGES OF THE REVOLUTION). | MOHAMMED BEHESHTI

summary: MOHAMMED SOURI | IN THE COURSE OF THE APRIL 23 CALL BY THE CHARGE ON MINISTER OF COMMERCE DR. summary: MOHARRAM | THE SHAH HAS TOLD THE AMBASSADOR THAT HE HAS AGREED IN PRINCIPLE (ONCE THE CANDIDATES ARE FOUND) TO FORMATION OF A CONSULTATIVE COUNCIL OF CIVILIAN POLITICAL LEADERS TO MEDIATE WITH THE OPPOSITION AND PRESUMABLY PREPARE THE WAY FOR A NEW CIVILIAN GOVT. TAVAKOLI AND AT LEAST ONE MULLAH HAD ARRIVED WITH A CONTINGENT OF MOJAHEDDIN FROM THE COMMITTEE. YAZDI WAS STANDING ON A CAR SPEAKING THROUGH A BULLHORN WHEN AMBASSADOR SULLIVAN ARRIVE. THE MOTOR POOL AREA WAS FULL OF ARMED GUERILLAS. THEY WERE STANDING ON ALL THE WALLS IN THE AREA AND SNIPERS WITH THEIR RIFLES COULD BE SEEN SILHOUETTED AGAINST THE SKY FROM ATOP THE BUILDINGS ACROSS TAKHT-E-JAMSHID. EXEMPLARY OF SELF-CENSORSHIP IN THE MEDIA IN THE INTERESTS OF ISLAM, ON THE EVENING OF MARCH 6 NIRT BROADCAST IN FULL THE REMARKS OF AYATOLLAH TALAGHANI AND A MOJAHEDIN SPOKESMAN AT AHMADABAB THE PREVIOUS DAY BUT NOT THOSE OF HEDAYATOLLAH MATIN-DAFTARI WHO USED THE OCCASION TO ANNOUNCE THE FORMATION OF A NEW, SECULARIST POLITICAL GROUPING. | KHOMEINI'S REMARKS ON THE WEARING OF THE VEIL CONTINUE TO STIR CONTROVERSY. THE MOJAHEDIN HAVE ISSUED A STATEMENT SAYING THAT THERE ARE MORE IMPORTANT THINGS TO WORRY ABOUT AT THE MOMENT, AND THAT ISSUE WILL ONLY SERVE THE INTERESTS OF COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARIES WHO WILL USE IT TO CREATE CHAOS. DIRECTOR OF NIRT, SADEGH GHOTBZADEH, HAS SAID MUCH THE SAME THING, CLAIMING THAT HKOMEINI'S REMARKS WERE MISINTERPRETED. | MOJAHEDIN

label: MONTAZERI
summary: MONTAZERI | TURNING TO OTHER MATTERS, ROWGHANI SIAD THE TOP COMMANDD UNDER KHOMEINI CONSISTS OF THREE AYATOLLASHS: MONTAZERI, MOTAHARI AND RABANI-SHIRAZI. KHOMEINI SERIOUSLY DESIRES TO WITHDRAW FROM GOVERNMENT AND MOVE TO QOM, PRECISELY SO THAT PEOPLE WOULD COME LESS TO HIM FOR DECISIONS AND MORE TO THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT. HE HOPED TO SPEND HIS TIME SPREADING HIS TEACHING AS WIDELY AS POSSIBLE BEFORE HE DIES, AND IN PARTICULAR, IN PREPARING A SUCCESSOR TO ACT AS CHIEF OF THE SHI'A ISLAMIC WORLD. THIS SUCCESSOR FOR THE MOMENT APPEARS TO BE MONTAZERI. ONE HEARS LITTLE ABOUT HIM BECAUSE HE IS LYING LOW, BUT HE IS A VERY INTELLIGENT, ABLE AYATOLLAH. | BEHESHTI WAS TRYING RATHER VAINLY TO IMPOSE SOME ORDER, INSISTING THAT MEMBERS SPEAK ONLY WHEN RECOGNIZED BY THE CHAIR. AT ONE POINT MONTAZERI BROKE IN AND COMMENCED TO DELIVER WHAT PROMISED TO BE A LENGTHY LECTURE. BEGESHTI TRIED TO SILENCE HIM, POINTING OUT THAT HE HAD NOT SOUGHT RECOGNITION FROM THE CHAIR. "SHUT UP," MONTAZERI TOLD HIM, "I AM TALKING." THEREUPON, THE OTHER MEMBERS PROCEEDED TO DENOUNCE BEHESHTI FOR ALLOWING MONTAZERI TO SPEAK OUT OF TURN. | IT WILL BE INTERESTING TO SEE WHETHER MONTAZERI, WHO IS CLOSELY IDENTIFIED WITH KHOMEINI, WILL ATTRACT THE SAME FOLLOWING AS TALEGHANI FOR HIS FRIDAY PRAYERS, AND WHETHER THE FRIDAY'S PRAYERS, WILL CONTINUE TO BE HELD AT TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. | IT APPEARS, HOWEVER, THAT THE INTENTION OF THIS ARTICLE IS TO FORMALIZE A MERGING OF STATE AND RELIGION AND TO ENSURE THAT THE NEW CHIEF OF STATE, WHATEVER HIS FORMAL TITLE, WILL BE DRAWN FROM AMONG THE LEADERS OF THE SHIA CLERGY. summary: MOUSSAVI | UPON ARRIVAL, WE DISCOVERED BAZARGAN AND A MULLAH NAMED MOUSSAVI, WHO WAS INTRODUCED AS SUBSTITUTE FOR BEHESHTI AND A CLOSE MEMBER OF KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE. summary: MRS CARTER | BEGIN TEXT: YOUR IMPERIAL MAJESTY: MRS. CARTER JOINS ME IN SENDING OUR WARMEST PERSONAL GREETINGS AND VERY BEST WISHES ON THE OCCASION OF YOUR BIRTHDAY. ON BEHALF OF THE AMERICAN PEOPLE, WE WISH PROGRESS AND PROSPERITY TO THE IRANIAN PEOPLE UNDER YOUR WISE AND ABLE LEADERSHIP. THE CLOSE BONDS BETWEEN OUR TWO COUNTRIES HAVE BEEN FORGED IN OVER THIRTY YEARS OF INTIMATE COOPERATION AND ARE BASED UPON MUTUALITY OF MANY NATIONAL INTERESTS AND OUR SHARED COMMITMENT TO PEACE AND STABILITY IN THE WORLD. | MRS. CARTER WAS WARMLY AND ENTHUSIASTICALLY GREETED BY A MODERATE-SIZE CROWD IN THE OLD TOWN SQUARE. THIS NUMBER INCLUDED A GROUP, WHICH ENCIRCLED MRS. CARTER'S PARTY AND WALKED WITH IT THROUGH THE SQUARE. DESPITE THE EXTREMELY UNFAVORABLE WEATHER CONDITIONS THE CROWD COULD HAVE BEEN SUBSTANTIALLY GREATER. HOWEVER, POLISH SECURITY COMPLETED SEALED OFF THE OLD TOWN AREA APPROXIMATELY 30 MINUTES BEFORE MRS. CARTER'S ARRIVAL AND APPARENTLY ADMITTED ONLY PERSONS LIVING IN THE AREA OR WHO WERE PREVIOUSLY PART OF THEIR PLAN FOR ADMITTANCE. | IN SPITE OF THESE EFFORTS, THE MAJORITY OF THE ONLOOKERS GAVE MRS. CARTER A GENUINELY WARM RECEPTION. THERE WERE NUMEROUS ATTEMPTS BY INDIVIDUAL POLES TO BREAK THROUGH THE SECURITY RING SURROUNDING MRS. CARTER AND TO GREET HER PERSONALLY. SUCH EFFORTS WERE FORCEFULLY DEFLECTED. IN ONE INSTANCE A TEENAGE GIRL TRISA TO GET A CLOSE-UP LOOK AT THE FIRST LADY. POLISH SECURITY PUSHED HER ASIDE WITH SUCH VIGOR THAT IF IT WERE NOT FOR THE DENSITY OF THE CROWD SHE WOULD HAVE FALLEDN TO THE PAVEMENT. | INSTEAD, THE GIRL BOUNCED BACK AND BEGAN HITTING THE SECURITY OFFICER ON THE SHOULDERS WITH HER FISTS WHILE TELLING HIM OF HER DISSATISFACTION IN NO UNCERTAIN TERMS. SHE THEN KEPT HER DISTANCE FOR A FEW MINUTES BUT LATER REJOINED THE CLOSE CIRCLE AROUND RS. CARTER, STILL TRYING FOR A PERSONAL GLIMPSE OF THE FIRST LADY. FINALLY, THE GIRL GAVE UP AND TOOK A POSITION ON THE CURB NEAR WHERE THE MOTORCADE FORMED FOR DEPARTURE. AT THIS POINT, MRS. CARTER BROKE OUT FROM HER SECURITY CIRCLE AND STARTED TO GREET THE CROWD LINING THE SIDEWALK. MUCH TO THE YOUNG GIRL'S SURPRISE AND DELIGHT, MRS. | MRS CARTER

summary: MUSLIMS | SUMMARY; AN ATTACK ON BAHAIS BY MUSLIM NEIGHBORS IN SHIRAZ DEC 13 DEGENERATED INTO A SHOOT-OUT THAT LEFT A SUBSTANTIAL NUMBER DEAD. FOR THE NEXT TWO DAYS THE MUSLIMS ENGAGED IN LOOTING AND BURNING BAHAI PROPERTIES. BY DEC 16 A DEGREE OF CALM HAD RETURNED, AND MANY MUSLIMS WERE FEELING REMORSEFUL FOR THEIR BEHAVIOR. BUT DESPITE APPARENTLY SINCERE EFFORTS BY MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES TO RESTORE ORDER FOLLOWING THE INITIAL SHOOTING INCIDENT WEDNESDAY NIGHT, THE EVENT IN THE MINDS OF MOST IRANIANS IS LIKELY TO BE REMEMBERED AS ONE MORE EXAMPLE OF GOVERNMENT INTRIGUE. | ON WEDNESDAY EVENING, DEC 13 A GROUP OF MUSLIMS BEGAN TO BURN THE HOUSES AND SHOPS OF BAHAIS LIVING IN THE VICINITY OF THE POET SAADIS TOMB IN NORTHEAST SHIRAZ. WHAT EXACTLY PROMPTED THIS IS NOT COMPLETELY CLEAR, BUT IT APPEARS THAT MOST OF THE MUSLIMS INVOLVED HAD JUST ATTENDED A GATHERING AT A LOCAL MOSQUE WHERE SPEECHES ATTACKING THE BAHAI COMMUNITY WERE MADE. THE LATTER WERE ACCUSED, INTER ALIA, OF HAVING TURNED MUSLIMS WHO HAD PREVIOUSLY PARTICIPATED IN ANTI-GOVERNMENT ACTIVITIES IN TO MARTIAL LAW AUTHORITIES. | PROS AND ANTIS HAVE ALSO STEPPED UP THEIR SPRAY PAINT CAMPAIGN, COVERING CITY WITH SLOGANS. TENSION IS HEIGHTENED BY BASICALLY UNRELATED INCIDENT LAST NIGHT BETWEEN MUSLIMS AND BAHAIS. MUSLIMS APPARENTLY BURNED HOUSE OF A BAHAI NEAR TOMB OF SAIDI. RELATIVE OF VICTIM WHO HAPPENED TO BE A SOLDIER AND HENCE ARMED WITH SUBMACHINE GUN, ARRIVED AND AVENGED HIS FAMILY. | WE HAVE REPORT OF MORE ANTI-BAHAI ACTIVITY. MUSLIMS OCCUPIED BAHAI-OWNED SUGAR FACTORY IN SHIRVAN (IN NE CORNER OF IRAN) AND FORCIBLY EVICTED BAHAI EMPLOYEES. label: NAHAVANDI
summary: NAHAVANDI | HE CONFIRMED QUEEN'S INCREASED PUBLIC ACTIVITY IN PAST ------------------033100 010630Z /15 FM AMEMBASSY TEHRAN TO SECSTATE WASHDC 8637 INFO USINT BAGHDAD AMEMBASSY LONDON USCINCER VAIHINGEN GE SECTION 2 OF 2 TEHRAN 05177 TWO-THREE WEEKS INVOLVING VISITS TO CITIES AND NOTED QUEEN'S SPECIAL BUREAU DIRECTOR NAHAVANDI HAD PUT BUREAU STAFF TO WORK GENERATING IDEAS BOTH WITHIN AND OUTSIDE GOI TO DEAL WITH PROBLEMS CAUSED BY "INSTANT URBANIZATION." SOURCE SAID COURT WAS COMING TO CONCLUDE THAT ORIGINAL DECISION NOT RPT NOT TO PROVIDE CITY SERVICES TO NEW SHANTYTOWNS WHICH HAD GROWN UP (FOR FEAR OF MAKING THEM EVEN MORE ATTRACTIVE TO RURAL DWELLERS) WAS "PROBABLY A MISTAKE." SHANTYTOWNS AND URBAN SLUMS EXPANDED RAPIDLY AT TIME OF LAND REFORM (BEGINNING 1963) WHEN MANY RURAL DWELLERS, UNCERTAIN WITH THEIR NEWFOUND FREEDOM, HAD FLOCKED TO CITIES AND OVERSUBSCRIBED PROFFERED INDUSTRIAL JOBS. | REPORTEDLY THE GROUP IS NOT UNANIMOUSLY IN FAVOR OF "POLITICIZING" ITSELF, FEARING THAT IT MIGHT BE DRAWN AWAY FROM ITS CURRENT RESEARCH ENDEAVORS AND REDUCED TO ISSUING RESTATEMENTS OF PRINCIPLE AS THE PRESENT WINGS. AHMAD QOREISHI, CHANCELLOR OF NATIONAL UNIVERSITY AND PRESIDENT OF THE EXECUTIVE COMMITTEE OF THE PARTY, TOLD AMBASSADOR JUNE 10 THAT MOST LIKELY THERE WILL BE THREE WINGS AND NAHAVANDI, WHOM QOREISHI CONSIDERS COMPETENT AND AMBITIOUS, WILL BECOME THE THIRD COORDINATOR. PURPOSE OF THIRD WING WOULD BE TO APPEAL TO INTELLECTUALS AND GALVANIZE THEIR SUPPORT IN A WAY PARTY HAD NOT BEEN ABLE YET TO DO. | NAHAVANDI IS KNOWN FOR HIS CRITICAL VIEWS OF THE PARTY'S PERFORMANCE, URGING A MORE RIGOROUS ATTACK ON CORRUPT OFFICIALS AND A REVIVED PARTY PROGRAM. NAHAVANDI, WHO IS EXCEEDINGLY AMBITIOUS, MAY WELL BE ON A COLLISION COURSE WITH THE PRIME MINISTER, WHO IS ALSO SECRETARY-GENERAL OF THE PARTY AND WHO WE KNOW ALREADY CONSIDERS NAHAVANDI A COMPETITOR AS ADVISOR TO THE SHAH ON THESE MATTERS. | AMOUZEGAR'S ANNOUNCEMENT CAME AS SOMEWHAT OF A SURPRISE SINCE WE HAD HEARD THAT NAHAVANDI'S GROUP WAS RESISTING INCORPORATION INTO THE RESURGENCE PARTY AND HAD ANNOUNCED THEY ONLY WANTED TO ACT AS "AN INDEPENDENT NUCLEUS" WITHIN THE PARTY AND WOULD SOON REVEAL THEIR OWN PLANS FOR REORGANIZATION AND REORIENTATION OF THE PARTY. IT IS NOT CLEAR IF NAHAVANDI ACTUALLY REQUESTED THIRD WING STATUS FOR HIS GROUP AND, IF HE DID, IF MEMBERS OF HIS GROUP WERE IN AGREEMENT. THUS THE ISSUE REMAINS SOMEWHAT IN DOUBT. | BY PLACING THE GOUP FOR CONSIDERATION OF IRANIAN PROBLEMS UNDER HIS JURISDICTION, AMOUZEGAR HAS EFFECTIVELY NIPPED NAHAVANDI'S BUDDING ASPIRATIONS TO LEADERSHIP OF A MORE INDEPENDENT POLITICAL ORGANIZATION AND BROUGH GROUP'S EXPERTISE INTO RESURGENCE PARTY. WE SHALL CONTINUE TO FOLLOW AND REPORT THESE MANEUVERINGS. | NAHAVANDI

label: NASSER KHAN QASHGAI
summary: NASSER KHAN QASHGAI | EMBOFF MET DEC 23 WITH HUSHANG SHAHBAZI,.RELATIVE OF QASHGAI CHIEFLY FAMILY, TO HEAR RISCOURSE ON ADVANTAGE TO SHAH OF RETURN TO IRAN OF QASHGAI IL-KHAN, NASSER KHAN QASHGAI. SHABAZI READILY ADMITTED THAT NATURE OF TRIBE HAS CHANGED AS IT BECAME MORE SEDENTARIZED. | SHAHBAZI DESCRIBED NASSER KHAN AS AN INTELLIGENT AND CLEVER KHAN, BUT ONE WITH WEAKNESSES, INCLUDING A LOVE OF MONEY AND A DESIRE TO RETURN TO A POSITION OF HONOR, RESPECT AND POWER APPROXIMATING THAT WHICH HE ENJOYED IN THE TRIBAL LANDS PRIOR TO HIS EXILE. NASSER KHAN ORIGINALLY FAVORED THE NATIONAL FRONT BECAUSE, IN THE 50'S, THE SHAH POSED THE GREATEST THREAT TO THE ENJOYMENT BY TRIBAL CHIEFS AND LARGE LANDOWNERS OF THEIR TRADITIONAL PREROGATIVES. AT PRESENT, SHAHBAZI BELIEVES, NASSER KHAN WOULD PERCEIVE RETENTION OF THE SHAH AS CONSISTENT WITH A TRADITIONAL VIEW OF IRANIAN AUTHORITY STRUCTURE AND THEREFORE A DESIRABLE OBJECTIVE. | IN FARS, AND PARTICULARLY IN CITIES SUCH AS SHIRAZ AND JAHROM, NASSER KHAN'S INFLUENCE COULD HELP MAINTAIN ORDER, ESPECIALLY AS THE BOYER-AHMADI AND THE KHAMSEH CONFEDERATION WOULD BE LIKELY TO FOLLOW THE LEAD OF THE QASHGAI. | CLAIMING THAT HE HAS NOT YET APPROACHED NASSER KHAN OR HIS FAMILY ON THIS SUBJECT, SHAHBAZI ASKED IF EMBOFF WOULD BE INTERESTED IN MEETING NASSER KHAN'S BROTHERS FOR FURTHER TALKS. EMBOFF REPLIED THAT HE IS IN NO POSITION TO ASSESS EITHER IMPACT OF NASSER KHAN'S RETURN NOR GOI WILLINGNESS TO HAVE HIM BACK IN IRAN. HOWEVER, AS GOI HAD EXILED HIM IN THE FIRST PLACE, ANY DISCUSSIONS OR AGREEMENTS REGARDING HIS RETURN OUGHT PROPERLY TO FOCUS ON GOI. U.S. | COMMENT: AS SHAH, OVER THE YEARS, HAS CONSCIOUSLY REDUCED THE POWER OF TRADITIONAL LEADERS OF IRANIAN SOCIETY WITH NO CONCOMITANT GAIN AMONG OTHER SOCIAL SEGMENTS, HE PRESENTLY FINDS HIMSELF RELYING ALMOST ENTIRELY ON THE MILITARY FOR HIS INTERNAL SUPPORT. UNDER THESE CONDITIONS APPEARANCE OF POWERFUL TRADITIONALLYBASED SUPPORTERS MIGHT PROVE ATTRACTIVE. HOWEVER, GOI WOULD HAVE TO WEIGH CAREFULLY POTENTIAL GAINS OF NASSER KHAN'S PRESENCE AGAINST POSSIBLE IMPACT OF HIS RETURN ON STILL FRAGILE DOMINANCE OF MODERATE OPPOSITION LEADERSHIP WHICH APPEARS TO BE MOVING CLOSE TO DISCUSSIONS WITH SHAH ON COALITION/TRANSITIONAL GOVERNMENT. | NASSER KHAN QASHGAI

label: NAZARI
summary: NAZARI | NAZARI SAID THAT THERE APPEARS TO BE LITTLE ORDER IN THE WAY THE INDIVIDUAL ARTICLES OF THE CONSTITUTION ARE TAKEN UP FOR CONSIDERATION. THE MEMBERSHIP HAS BEEN DIVIDED INTO A NUMBER OF COMMITTEES WHICH ARE SUPPOSED TO MAKE RECOMMENDATIONS. DURING ONE OF THE SESSIONS NAZARI ATTENDED MORE THAN 20 SEPARATE RECOMMENDATIONS, SOME PUT FORWARD BY THE COMMITTEES AND SOME BY INDIVIDUAL MEMBERS, WERE MADE REGARDING A SINGLE ARTICLE. THESE WERE ALL VOTED UPON, WITH NO RECOMMENDATION RECEIVING MORE THAN 30 VOTES AND SOME AS FEW AS THREE OR FOUR. | NAZARI THOUGHT IT EXTREMELY UNLIKELY THAT THE ASSEMBLY WOULD BE ABLE TO STICK TO ITS THIRTY-DAY SCHEDULE FOR COMPLETION OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL REVIEW. HE ESTIMATED THAT IT WOULD BE THE END OF THE YEAR BEFORE THE CONSTITUTION COULD BE PROMULGATED AND ELECTIONS HELD. DESPITE THE ASSEMBLY MEMBERSHIP'S LACK OF EXPERIENCE WITH PARLIAMENTARY PROCEDURE AND THE CONSEQUENT PROSPECT FOR DELAYED COMPLETION OF THE CONSTITUTIONAL REVIEW PROCESS, NAZARI BELIEVED THERE IS ONE POSITIVE ASPECT OF THE ASSEMBLY'S SESSIONS: HE ANTICIPATED THAT MANY MEMBERS WILL ALSO BE ELECTED TO THE MAJLES, AND HENCE THE LEGISLATIVE EXPERIENCE THEY ARE NOW GAINING WILL STAND THEM IN GOOD STEAD LATER. | NAZARI

THUS THE ALTERNATIVE PROCEDURE OF DECLARING A REVOLUTION AND PROCEEDING TO REFERENDUM, CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY, AND PARLIAMENTORY ELECTIONS UNDER A PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT IS PERFECTLY PROPER UNDER INTERNATIONAL PRECEDENTS. label: NAZIH
summary: NAZIH | PRESS MORNING OF FEB 28 HEADLINED NIOC HEAD NAZIH'S CLAIMS IN SPEECH TO OIL WORKERS AT AHWAZ THAT EXPORTS WILL RESUME ON 5 MARCH, THE 12TH ANNIVERSARY OF DR. MOSSADEQ'S DEATH. NAZIH CLAIMED THE PRICE OF THE OIL,TO BE AUCTIONED DIRECTLY USING A SYSTEM OF SPOT SELLING, COULD BE SOLD AT AN AVERAGE OF $18 TO $20 A BARREL. NAZIH REAFFIRMED THAT EXISTING CONSORTIUM AGREEMENTS WERE UNDER REVIEW, AND CLAIMED THAT THE EXISTING DISCOUNT SYSTEM WOULD NO LONGER APPLY. THE NIOC HEAD SAID THAT NO RPT NO OIL WOULD BE BARTERED FOR WEAPONS PURCHASES, AND THAT EXCEPT FOR AGRICULTURE BARTER, OIL SALES WILL BE ON A CASH BASIS. | NIOC CHAIRMAN NAZIH TERMED STATEMENTS BY IRANIAN EMBASSY WASHINGTON D.C. SPOKESMAN ROUHANI TO THE EFFECT THAT OIL PRODUCTION WOULD RISE TO BETWEEN 3 AND 4 MBPD AS PREMATURE. ANNOUNCED PRODUCTION LEVELS AS OF MARCH 8 WEERE 2 MBPD AND THEY ARE EXPECTED TO PEAK AT 3 MBPD. AS YET, NO FINAL DECISION HAS BEEN REACHED AS TO OPTIMAL LEVELS, BUT NIOC IS BEGINNING NEGOTIATIONS FOR LONG TERM CONTRACT WITH OIL IMPORTERS. NAZIH CONDEMNED THE USE OF OIL EXPORTS FOR BARTER SAYING THAT THIS PROCEDURE WILL STOP. HE SAID IRAN WILL REMAIN A MILITANT UNQUOTE MEMBER OF OPEC. | ON THE ORGANIZATIONAL FRONT, NIOC CHAIRMAN NAZIH ANNOUNCED THAT ALL AFFILIATED COMPANIES I.E., THE NATIONAL PETROCHEMICAL COMPANY (NPC), THE OIL SERVICES COMPANY (OSCO) AND THE NATIONAL IRANIAN GAS COMPANY (NIGC) WOULD HENCEFORTH BE DIRECTLY CONTROLLED BY THE NIOC CHAIRMAN AND MANAGING DIRECTOR. A CO-ORDINATING COMMITTEE HAS BEEN SET UP TO MANAGE THE DETAILS. | IF ANY REDUCTION IS EFFECTED IT IS WITH THEIR OWN CONSENT. IT IS NEVER AN IMPOSITION'. "REFERRING TO THE WISCONSIN'S REPRESENTATIVE NAZIH ADDED, 'IT IS SAID THAT WE TAKE ADVANTAGE OF THE SITUATION AND SELL OUR CRUDE AT A HIGHER PRICE. THIS IS INCORRECT BECAUSE OUR PRICES ARE BASED ON THE OPEC AGREEMENT PLUS A SURCHARGE WHICH ALSO IN MOST CASES IS APPROVED BY THE OPEC'." NAAS | KHOMEINI, THE PGOI, AND THE PROTO-OPPOSITION FIGURES (SHARIAT-MADARI, TALEGHANI, NAZIH, MATINE-DAFTARY, ETC.) HAVE YET TO SHOW A WILLINGNESS TO STAND ON PRINCIPLE. WHETHER KHOMEINI EVER MEANT HIS STATEMENT THAT HE DID NOT INTEND TO RULE IS QUESTIONABLE; CERTAINLY HE IS EXERCISING ALL THE POWER HE CAN GET, WHILE COMPROMISING ON ANY PRINCIPLE WHICH ROUSES OPPOSITION (VEILS FOR WOMEN, FROZEN MEAT, EXECUTIONS, CONSTITUTION ELECTIONS) IN SPEECHES IF NOT IN FACT. | NAZIH

label: NYERERE
summary: NYERERE | (NYERERE WAS GENERALLY MIFFED AT THE BRITISH FOR A VARIETY OF REASONS.)
