label: OSMANOV
summary: OSMANOV | OSMANOV SAID USSR VERY CONCERNED AND LAST THING IT WANTED WAS AN UNSTABLE NEIGHBOR ON ITS SOUTHERN BORDER. HE EMPHASIZED THE VALUE THE SOVIET UNION PLACED ON GOOD RELATIONS IT HAD DEVELOPED OVER THE YEARS WITH IRAN, PARTICULARLY WITH THE SHAH. HE LEFT STRONG IMPRESSION THAT, AT LEAST IN HIS VIEW, THE U.S. WAS NOT DOING ENOUGH TO HELP THE SHAH. HE SPECIFICALLY SAID THAT HE WOULD HAVE EXPECTED THE U.S. TO SHOW ITS SUPPORT IN CONCRETE TERMS, SUCH AS PROVIDING ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE OR BUYING MORE IRANIAN OIL. WHEN DEPTOFF POINTED OUT THAT PRESENT DIFFICULTIES WERE LARGELY INTERNAL MATTERS, OSMANOV STUCK TO HIS GUNS AND REITERATED POINT ABOUT SHAH'S NEED | AFTER AN INITIAL DISCUSSION OF CURRENT EFFORTS BY SADEQI AND BAKHTIAR TO FORM A CIVILIAN GOVERNMENT, AND CURRENT ECONOMIC CRUNCH, OSMANOV STATED THAT ALL THE USSR WANTED WAS TO HAVE CALM AND STABILITY IN IRAN. DEPTOFF REPLIED THAT RECENT SOVIET PRESS STORIES SEEMED TO BELIE THIS AND TOLD OSMANOV IN STRONG TERMS THAT THESE STORIES AND THEIR ATTACKS ON THE US ROLE IN IRAN WERE, AS THE SOVIETS WELL KNEW, MOST UNHELPFUL IN THIS DIFFICULT SITUATION. | OSMANOV MAINTAINED THAT SOVIET PRESS ACCOUNTS WERE PURELY FACTUAL ABOUT EVENTS IN IRAN AND ADDED THAT ONLY PRAVDA SHOULD BE TAKEN SERIOUSLY, OTHER MEDIA BEING MORE "FREE." DEPTOFF SUGGESTED SOVIET EMBASSY SUFFERED FROM LACK OF INFORMATION ABOUT WHAT HAD APPEARED IN SOVIET PRESS AND TASS STORIES AND OFFERED TO PROVIDE COPIES. DEPTOFF REJOINED THAT USSR SHOULD NOT DRAW ITS CONCLUSIONS FROM US PRESS SOURCES, WHICH WERE NONGOVERNMENTAL, BUT RATHER SEEK ITS INFORMATION FROM OFFICIAL SOURCES. DEPTOFF THEN PROCEEDED TO OUTLINE TO OSMANOV THE HISTORY AND COMPOSITION OF MIDEASTFOR AND TO DESCRIBE THE MIDLINK EXERCISE, NOTING THE FACT THAT SOME OF THE SHIPS THAT PARTICIPATED IN THAT EXERCISE HAD TEMPORARILY REMAINED IN THE ARABIAN SEA AREA, BUT OUTSIDE THE PERSIAN GULF. label: PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY
summary: PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY | FIRST IS THE VERY BROAD INTERFACE WHICH US AND IRAN HAVE IN THE EDUCATIONAL AND INTELLECTUAL FIELDS. THIS MEANS A HEAVY FLOW OF IRANIAN STUDENTS TO US FOR NEXT TWENTY YEARS WHILE IRANIAN EDUCATIONAL SYSTEM GETS BUILT UP. IT WILL ALSO PROBABLY MEAN IRANIAN DEMAND FOR ESTABLISHMENT OF MORE USTYPE, US-STAFFED UNIVERSITIES IN IRAN, ALONG LINES OF PAHLAVI AND DAMAVAND. ONE SENIOR PROFESSOR TOLD PRINCIPAL OFFICER THAT THIS WAS FIRST TIME SHIARAZ DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE BEEN LINKED DIRECTLY TO THOSE IN TEHRAN. SOURCE OPINED PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY MIGHT IN THE END LOSE A WHOLE TERM IF IT HAD TO CLOSE. | CONSULATE SHIRAZ REPORTS PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY STUDENTS STAGED DEMONSTRATION NOVEMBER TWENTY-SEVEN IN SUPPORT OF TEHRAN UNIVERSITY STUDENTS WHO WERE ARRESTED. CRITICISM OF SHAH FOR AGREEING TO OIL PRICE FREEZE WAS VOICED. POLICE BROKE UP AFFAIR AND BASHED A FEW HEADS IN PROCESS. STUDENTS HAVE BEEN THNSE AT PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY FOR ABOUT A WEEK, AND THIS IS EXPECTED TO CONTINUE THROUGH DECEMBER NINE OF TEN. UNIVERSITY ADMINISTRATORS BELIEVE THAT DEMONSTRATIONS HAVE BEEN LED BY OUTSIDE AGITATORS. | FOLLOWING ARE BASED ON CONVERSATIONS WEEK OF DECEMBER 4-7 BETWEEN TEHRAN EMBOFF STEMPEL, CONSULATE PRINCIPAL OFFICERS TOMSETH AND MCGAFFEY, AND SENIOR FACULTY MEMBERS AT THE UNIVERSITIES OF ISFAHAN AND PAHLAVI UNIVERSITY INCLUDING CHANCELLOR AND VICE-CHANCELLOR RESPECTIVELY. summary: PARSA KIA | ON WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 10, IN COURSE OF ALREADY SCHEDULED MEETING WITH ACTING HEAD OF THE MFA 4TH DIVISION PARSA KIA, ACTING POL COUNCELLOR SHOWED PARSA KIA A COPY OF THE JUMHURI-E-ISLAMI ARTICLE AND EXPRESSED EMBASSY'S CONCERN OVER TONE OF THE REPORTS OF US ALLEGED INVOLVEMENT IN KURDESTAN. EMBOFF POINTED OUT THAT SUCH UNFOUNDED REPORTING MAY HAVE ENCOURAGED SMALL DEMONSTRATION AGAINST EMBASY OCTOBER 9. EMBOFF CONTINUED THAT JUMHURI-E-ISLAMI WAS AFTERALL PAPER OF AYATOLLAH BEHESHTI'S ISLAMIC REPUBLICAN PARTY. PARSA KIA ASSURED EMBOFF THAT PGOI WAS NOT INVOLVED IN SUCH STORIES OAD THAT NO PGOI OFFICIALS HAD EVER ACCUSED USG OF INVOLVEMENT IN KURDESTAN. | HE RECOGNIZED THAT SOME PRESS REPORTS HAD MENTIONED US, BUT STATED THAT ONLY ACCUSATIONS BY PGOI OFFICIALS OF INVOLVEMENT OF OUTSIDE POWERS HE HAD SEEN WERE DIRECTED AGAINST ISRAEL AND IRAQ. PARSA KIA STATED PGOI DID NOT CONTROL "FREE" PRESS SUCH AS JUMHURI-EISLAMI BUT THAT HE UNDERSTOOD OUR CONCERN OVER THESE STORIES. HE SAID HE WOULD CONVEY OUR CONCERN TO FOREIGN MINISTER YAZDI WO HAS JUST RETURNED TO IRAN. PARSA KIA REMARKED THAT YAZDI WOULD BE GIVING A PRESS CONFERENCE THAT AFTERNOON TO DISCUSS HIS TRIP. IN COURSE OF CONVERSATION, EMBOFF REPEATED ASSURANCE (STATE 247846) OF USG RESPECT FOR PGOI TERRITORIAL INTEGRITY. | ACTING POL COUNSELLOR DISCUSSED PANAMA CANAL TREATY PROTOCOL (REFTEL) WITH FOREIGN MINISTRY, FOURTH POLITICAL DIVISION ACTING CHIEF PARSA KIA OCTOBER 10. EMBOFF URGED PROMPT PGOI ACCESSION TO PROTOCOL. PARSA KIA SAID PGOI WOULD STUDY QUESTION AND LET EMBASSY KNOW PGOI DECISION. | WHEN QUERIED MORNING OCTOBER 11, ON CONFUSED PRESS ACCOUNTS, MFA 4TH POLITICAL DIVISION ACTING CHIEF PARSA KIA WAS PLAINLY NON-PLUSSED. HE CHECKED INTO QUESTION AND CALLED EMBASSY BACK WITH REPLY THAT YAZDI HAD NOT SAID THAT AGREEMENTS WITH THE U.S. | DURING OCTOBER 10 DISCUSSION OF IRANIAN PRESS ATTACKS ON US OVER KURDESTAN,ACTING CHIEF OF MFA FOURTH POLITICAL DIVISION, PARSA KIA, ONCE AGAIN BROUGHT UP SUBJECT OF CHARGE'S TALK WITH INTERIOR MINISTER SABAGHIAN ON HUMAN RIGHTS. PARSA KIA IS INTELLIGENT, FRIENDLY TO US AND HIMSELF VERY WORRIED OVER THE "EXCESSES" OF THE REVOLUTIONARY GOVERNMENT. HE SEEMED MAINLY CONCERNED WE HAD RAISED THE QUESTION WITH SABAGHIAN RATHER THAN COMING THROUGH FONMIN YAZDI. | PARSA KIA

label: PBO
summary: PBO | COMMENT: THE SHAH'S OBSERVATIONS ON THE NEED FOR MORE BALANCED GROWTH AND AT RATES WHICH CAN BE ABSORBED BY THE COUNTRY WITHOUT ATTENDANT DISLOCATIONS (E.G., INFLATION; INFRASTRUCTURE BOTTLENECKS) CAN BE SEEN AS A CONTINUATION ON THEMES WHICH THE MONARCH HAS DWELT UPON OVER THE PAST YEAR. THE PROPOSITION THAT IRAN NEEDS A LOWER, MORE "ABSORBABLE" RATE OF GROWTH HAS LAREADY FOUND RESONANCE IN SOME TENTATIVE THINKING WITHIN THE PBO ON THE 6TH DEVELOPMENT PLAN. ONE DOCUMENT FROM THE PBO (DATED JULY 1976) WHICH THE EMB HAS JUST RECEIVED POSTULATES A GROWTH SCENARIO WITH A 12.8 PERCENT ANNUAL GROWTH RATE. | IT IS NOTEWORTHY, HOWEVER, THAT THE PRINCIPAL AUTHOR OF THIS PAPER TOLD EMBOFFS RECENTLY THAT THE PBO WAS NOW THINKING OF A PER ANNUM GROWTH RATE PROJECTION OF 7.5 PERCENT AND ANNUAL INFLATION AT 12 PERCENT (SEE MEMCON 7/31/77 TO NEA/IRN). THIS OFFICIAL READILY ADMITTED TO DISAGREEMENTS WIT IN THE GOI AS TO WHAT THE 6TH PLAN GROWTH RATE PROJECTION OUGHT TO BE. | WHATEVER FIGURE FINALLY EMERGES AS THE 6TH PLAN GROWTH TARGET IT SEEMS EVIDENT THAT THE ROLE OF THE PBO IN ITS ATTAINMENT WILL BE CONSIDERABLY LESS THAN IN THE LAST FEW YEARS. PBO'S BUDGET OFFICE, THE SINGLE MOST IMPORTANT BUREAUCRATIC INSTRUMENT WITHIN THE GOVT INSOFAR AS THE ALLOCATION OF NON-DEFENSE PUBLIC SECTOR RESOURCES IS CONCERNED, WILL NOW BE GIVEN TO THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE. THE PERSONALITY OF THE PLAN ORGANIZATION'S NEW HEAD, MINISTER OF STATE YEGANEH, SEEMS WILL SUITED TO THE ORGANIZATION'S NEW, ESSENTIALLY NON-OPERATIONAL CHARTER. | THE GOVERNMENT'S INABILITY TO FINE TUNE THE PLANNING AND DECISION MAKING PROCESS WAS SUBSEQUENTLY SEEN IN PBO'S EMERGENCE SINCE MID-1975 AS THE PRINCIPAL NAY-SAYER IN THE GOVT. DOZENS OF PROJECTS, INCLUDING SOME THE US-IRAN JOINT COMMISSION CONTEXT, WERE ABOLISHED, CUT BACK OR PUT ON THE BACKBURNER BY PBO. MANY PROJECTS LANGUISHED UNFUNDED AND THE POSTPONEMENT OF START-UPS INEVITABLY ENTAILED COST INCREASES LATER ON. PBO CAME TO BE SEEN AS A MAJOR BOTTLENECK BUT IT WAS NATURALLY THOUGHT THAT PBO'S DIRECTOR HAD HIS SOVEREIGN'S CONCURRENCE IN WHAT HE WAS DOING. | DOUBTLESS THE MINISTRY OF ECONOMIC AFFAIRS AND FINANCE HAD A HAND IN THIS THROTTLING DOWN PROCESS BUT PBO GOT MOST OF THE BLAME. THE SHAH IN HIS REMARKS TO THE NEW CABINET CLEARLY FIXED THE BLAME ON PBO AND THE DEPARTURE OF PBO'S FORMER DIRECTOR, ABDOL-MAJID MAJIDI, SEEMS IN RETROSPECT A NATURAL OUTCOME. IT REMAINS TO BE SEEN, OF COURSE, JUST HOW MUCH FREEDOM OF ACTION THE MINISTRIES WILL ONCE AGAIN HAVE AND HOW FLEXIBLE WILL BE THE 6TH PLAN GUIDLINES WITHIN WHICH THEY ARE SUPPOSED TO OPERATE. | PBO

summary: PFLO | EVENTS LIKE THIS HAVE OCCURRED FROM TIME TO TIME IN DHOFAR SINCE THE WAR ENDED. THERE WILL PROBABLY BE ANOTHER ONE AROUND JUNE 9, PFLO'S MAIN ANNIVERSARY AND A NATURAL OCCASION FOR PFLO-INITIATED INCIDENTS. THERE IS NO EVIDENCE VISIBLE FROM HERE THAT ANY SIGNIFICANT STEP-UP IN THE INSURGENCY WILL TAKE PLACE SOON, EVEN THOUGH HANDFUL OFHARDCORE PFLO CADRES REMAIN AT LARGE IN EASTERN DHOFAR MOUNTAINS. HOWEVER, SULTANATE FORCES SEEM UNABLE TO WEED THESE REBELS OUT. | DODSON SHOWED CHARGE SOLF'S STAFF REPORT ON THE APRIL 22 INCIDENT. AT MID-DAY A PLATOON-SIZE PATROL OF SOLF'S SOUTHERN BRIGADE CROSSED WADI SHUFLOON IN EASTERN DHOFAR (ON NORTHERN SIDE OF ESCARPMENT DUE NORTH OF MIRBAT) AND WAS FIRED UPON BY BAND OF PFLO FROM SURROUNDING HILLS. THIS IS THE GERNERAL AREA WHERE 55 OR SO HARD-CORE PFLO CADRES ARE KNOWN TO BE HANGING ON SINCE DEFEAT OF INSURGENCY IN LATE 1975. THE PLATOON FIRED BACK AND, AFTER RECEIVING RADIOED PERMISSION FROM HQ TO USE MORTARS, FIRED BARRAGES AT THE ENEMY HIDING AMONG THE ROCKS. AFTER 20 MINUTES THE PFLO BROKE AND RAN. | SOLF UNITS SPENT THE REST OF THE DAY SEARCHING FOR THEM, WITHOUT SUCCESS. EXAMINATION OF LOCATIONS IN HILLS FROM WHICH PFLO HAD FIRED SUGGESTED THERE HAD BEEN FIVE OF THEM IN ALL. THERE WERE NO KILLED OR WOUNDED ON EITHER SIDE. | SOLF JUDGED THAT THE REASON FOR THE ATTACK WAS PROBABLY THAT THESE PFLO CADRES HAD SIMPLY WANDERED INTO THE AREA BEARING WEAPONS, HAD SPOTTED THE PATROL AND SEEN THAT IT WAS SMALL, AND HAD SEIZED THE TARGET OF OPPORTUNITY. AS REFTEL NOTES, SUCH INCIDENTS DO OCCUR FROM TIME TO TIME. | DODSON PREDICTED THAT ON OR ABOUT JUNE 9, PFLO'S MAJOR ANNIVERSARY, THERE ALMOST CERTAINLY WILL BE A PFLO-INITIATED CONTACT OF SOME KIND. THE SHAH, NEVERTHELESS, WAS ALSO ABLE TO INDULGE IN ONE OF HIS FAVORITE PASTTIMES-LOOKING AT MILITARY HARDWARE- AS THE GOC SHOWED OFF THE PRODUCTS OF ITS ARMS INDUSTRY (AND PROMPTED CONSIDERABLE SPECULATION HERE OVER POSSIBLE BILATERAL ARMS DEALS). | DEGREE IN LAW FROM TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. AT HOME HE HAS SERVED IN THE DEPT OF INFORMATION AND PRESS, THE DEPT OF STUDIES AND RESEARCH, AND WAS FOR FOUR YEARS HEAD OF THE WESTERN EUROPEAN DEPARTMENT. | HE ENTERED MFA 1957 AND HAS SERVED IN DEPARTMENTS OF INTERNATIONAL COLLABORATION, INTERNATIONAL ORGANIZATIONS, ECONOMIC AFFAIRS, AND AS DIRECTOR OF REGIONAL COOPERATION FOR DEVELOPMENT. HE HAS SERVED ABROAD AS THIRD SECRETARY IN PRAGUE, AND LONDON, FIRST SECRETARY AND COUNSELLOR IN ANKARA, AND MINISTER COUNSELLOR IN PEKING. SINCE DEC. | PRAGUE

label: PRAVDA
summary: PRAVDA | BEGIN TEXT: --THE UNITED STATES TAKES NOTE OF THE FACT THAT SOVIET RADIO BROADCASTS TO IRAN INCREASINGLY COMMENT IN AN INFLAMMATORY FASHION ON THE DISTURBANCES IN THAT COUNTRY, IN PARTICULAR CHARGING THAT THE DEMONSTRATIONS ARE DIRECTED AT ENDING THE "US INTERVENTION IN IRAN'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS." --A FLAGRANT EXAMPLE OF IRRESPONSIBLE AND UTTERLY UNFOUNDED PROPAGANDA IS THE PRAVDA ARTICLE OF DECEMBER 28 WHICH ALLEGED THAT THE UNITED STATES HAS SENT IN A "SPECIAL GROUP" OF 60 PEOPLE TO TEHRAN TO FIND WAYS TO KEEP THE SHAH IN POWER. | AS THE STATE DEPARTMENT SPOKESMAN SAID ON DECEMBER 28, THIS CHARGE BY PRAVDA IS FALSE, AND SUCH FALSE REPORTS ARE CLEARLY UNHELPFUL AT A TIME WHEN THERE IS A NEED TO CALM PASSIONS, NOT TO EXCITE THEM. --THE SOVIET GOVERNMENT IS WELL AWARE OF THE CONSISTENT POSITION OF THE UNITED STATES WITH REGARD TO THE SITUATION IN IRAN, AND FALSE SOVIET COMMENTARIES CAN ONLY HAVE THE EFFECT OF EXACERBATING THE EXISTING DISORDER. MOST EMPHATICALLY, THERE CAN ONLY BE OBVIOUS NEGATIVE CONSEQUENCES IF COMMENTARIES ON THE SITUATION HAVE THE EFFECT OF INCITING ACTIONS AGAINST AMERICANS IN IRAN. | OSMANOV MAINTAINED THAT SOVIET PRESS ACCOUNTS WERE PURELY FACTUAL ABOUT EVENTS IN IRAN AND ADDED THAT ONLY PRAVDA SHOULD BE TAKEN SERIOUSLY, OTHER MEDIA BEING MORE "FREE." DEPTOFF SUGGESTED SOVIET EMBASSY SUFFERED FROM LACK OF INFORMATION ABOUT WHAT HAD APPEARED IN SOVIET PRESS AND TASS STORIES AND OFFERED TO PROVIDE COPIES. OSMANOV SAID THAT HE HAD TAKEN NOTE OF US VIEWS ABOUT SOVIET PRESS STORIES AND WOULD REPORT SAME. | AUGUST 22 PRAVDA CARRIES AN ARTICLE NOTEWORTHY FOR ITS STRONG ATTACK ON IRANIAN NEWS COVERAGE OF AFGHANISTAN AND THE USSR. UNDER THE HEADLINE "CONTRARY TO TRUTH," THE ARTICLE BY M. | THE SOVIETS WERE RATHER SILENT ABOUT THE TRIBAL UNREST IN AFGHANISTAN UNTIL LAST WEEKEND, PERHAPS OUT OF A BELIEF THAT THE LESS SAID THE BETTER; DRAWING TOO MUCH ATTENTION TO THE REVOLT WOULD ONLY SPOTLIGHT THE SOVIET INVOLVEMENT IN ITS SUPPRESSION. ON MARCH 19, HOWEVER, PRAVDA BROKE THE SILENCE WITH AN AUTHORITATIVE COMMENTARY BY I. ALEKSANDROV ACCUSING PAKISTAN, EGYPT, AND CHINA OF SUPPORTING COUNTER-REVOLUTIONARY CONSERVATIVE MUSLIM GROUPS IN AFGHANISTAN. ALTHOUGH A PRAVDA EDITOR SUBSEQUENTLY CLAIMED THAT THIS ATTACK WAS MAINLY DIRECTED AT CHINA, THE PRESS LATER IN THE WEEK ACCUSED THE US, UK, AND IRAN OF MEDDLING IN INTERNAL AFGHAN AFFAIRS. | PRAVDA

THE PROSECUTOR SAID INVESTIGATORS WOULD BE SENT TO THE CBI TO INVESTIGATE THE ALLEGED TRANSFERS AND IF THEY ARE UNTRUE THE PERPETRATORS OF THE FALSE LIST WOULD BE PROSECUTED. THE BBC ON NOVEMBER 28 CARRIED THE ACCOUNT OF THE LIST, THE REFUTATION BY THE CBI AND THE CALL BY THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL TO INVESTIGATE THE LIST. | AS REPORTED IN REF B, RADIO AND TV NEWS REPORTED ON DECEMBER 20 THE MINJUSTICE/PROSECUTOR GENERAL'S FINDING FROM HIS INVESTIGATION AT THE CENTRAL BANK OF THE LIST OF IRANIANS WHO TRANSFERRED FUNDS OUT OF IRAN IN THE TWO MONTHS ENDING OCTOBER 22, A LIST ALLEGEDLY COMPILED BY THE CENTRAL BANK EMPLOYEES ASSOCIATION (SEE REFTEL). PROSECUTOR GENERAL SAID THAT FOUR INVESTIGATORS HAD COMPLETED PRELIMINARY FINDINGS AND COULD CONFIRM TRANSFERS BY 102 OF THE 178 LISTED. THE NAMES OF SOME WERE GIVEN IN THE NEWSCASTS (SEE FOLLOWING LIST OF 44) BUT NO AMOUNTS WERE IDENTIFIED WITH THE NAME, MERELY AN AGGREGATE TOTAL OF RIALS 112,820 MILLION (ROUGHLY DOLS 1.6 BILLION). | THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL CAN ALSO ORDER THE IMPOUNDMENT OF THE PROPERTY OF ANY INDIVIDUAL UNDER INVESTIGATION AS WELL AS THE PROPERTY OF ANY HIS RELATIVES IF HE HAS REASON TO BELIEVE THAT THE INDIVIDUAL UNDER INVESTIGATION HAS TRANSFERRED HIS OWN PROPERTY TO THEM TO AVOID IMPOUNDMENT. THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL CAN SUBPOENA WITNESSES AS REQUIRED BY ADVERTISEMENT IN THE NEWSPAPERS AND CAN ORDER THE ARREST OF ANY WITNESS WHO DOES NOT APPEAR. INDIVIDUALS ARRESTED ON THE ORDER OF THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL CAN BE HELD INDEFINITELY PENDING INVESTIGATION; HOWEVER, ONLY THE COURT ADMINISTRATOR, A RELIGIOUS JUDGE, CAN ORDER INDIVIDUALS DETAINED RELEASED. | FURTHER, WHILE THE PROCEDURES NOMINALLY GIVE THE GOVERNMENT A CENTRAL ROLE IN THE JUDICIAL PROCESS IN THE PERSON OF THE PROSECUTOR GENERAL, THE PROCEDURES ARE IN FACT AN ADMISSION BY THE GOVERNMENT THAT IT HAS BEEN UNABLE TO WREST CONTROL OF THE ADMINISTRATION OF JUSTICE FROM THE REVOLUTIONARY COMMITTEE STRUCTURE. THE ISLAMIC FUNDAMENTALISTS AND VENGEFUL REVOLUTIONARIES, IT SEEMS, ARE DETERMINED TO SETTLE SCORES AND LEGAL NICETIES AND INTERNATIONAL OPINION WILL HAVE LITTLE INFLUENCE. | PROSECUTOR GENERAL

PRESIDENT, MY SINCERE CONGRATULATIONS ON THE ANNIVERSARY OF INDEPENDENCE OF-THE UNITED STATES. | HOWEVER, I HAVE TO STATE THAT IN THE VIEW OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN THE RESOLUTION DATED MAY 17, 1979 OF YOUR COUNTRY'S SENATE CONCERNING THE PENALIZATION OF THE FORMER REGIME'S CRIMINALS DOES NOT AT ALL COMPLY WITH THE ABOVE PRINCIPLE, BUT IS A CLEAR INSTANCE OF INTERVENTION IN OUR COUNTRY'S INTERNAL AFFAIRS AND, THEREBY COMPELLED, THE IRANIAN GOVERNMENT STRONGLY PROTESTS AGAINST THAT LINE OF ACTION AND RESOLUTION OF THE UNITED STATES SENATE. "IT IS A SOURCE OF SURPRISE FOR THE IRANIAN PEOPLE WHO WONDER HOW IT WAS THAT WHEN THE PAST REGIME WAS RUTHLESSLY FELLING DOWN OUR YOUNG PEOPLE THE UNITED STATES SENATE REMAINED SILENT AND DID NOT SEEM TO FEEL THAT HUMAN RIGHTS WERE BEING VIOLATED IN IRAN, WHEREAS NOW THAT THE REVOLUTION HAS TRIUMPHED AND THE CRIMINALS--REGARDLESS OF THEIR RELIGIOUS AFFILIATIONS--ARE METED THE PENALTY OF THEIR DEEDS, IT HAS RAISED THE CRY OF HUMAN RIGHTS VIOLATION IN IRAN AND SUPPORTS THOSE WHO HAVE COMMITTED THE MOST SHAMEFUL CRIMES FOR MORE THAN HALF A CENTURY. "I AM CONFIDENT THAT YOUR EXCELLENCY IS QUITE FAMILIAR WITH THE FACT THAT ONE OF THE PRINCIPAL AND CONTINUOUS OBJECTIVES OF THE IRANIAN PEOPLE'S REVOLUTION IS TO BRING TO END ANY SORT OF INTERVENTION BY FOREIGNERS IN THE INTERNAL AFFAIRS OF THEIR COUNTRY. | PRIME MINISTER: "AS YOU KNOW, A SERIES OF LARGE DEMONSTRATIONS TO PROTEST THE RECENT RESOLUTION BY THE UNITED STATES SENATE ARE PLANNED FOR THIS AFTERNOON AND TOMORROW. I AM DEEPLY DISTURBED THAT AT NO TIME SINCE THE PREPARATIONS OF THE DEMONSTRATIONS WERE ANNOUNCED HAVE I SEEN ANY ACTION OR APPEAL BY THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN TO ENSURE THAT THE PUBLIC ACTIONS WILL BE PEACEFUL. I URGE THAT THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN TAKE WHATEVER STEPS ARE NECESSARY TO CALL FOR CALM AND A PEACEFUL ATMOSPHERE. "YOUR GOVERNMENT IS AWARE THAT THE U.S. | I HAVE BEEN INSTRUCTED BY MY GOVERNMENT TO EXPRESS ITS CONCERN THAT THE DEMONSTRATIONS TODAY AND TOMORROW MAY THREATEN THE SAFETY OF AMERICAN EMBASSY PERSONNEL IN TEHRAN. WE WOULD LIKE THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN TO CONSIDER ADDITIONAL MEASURES TO PROVIDE PROTECTION IN THE EMOTIONALLY-CHARGED CIRCUMSTANCES. THE UNITED STATES GOVERNMENT EXPECTS THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN TO FULFILL ITS INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNIZED RESPONSIBILITIES TO PROTECT THE LIVES AND PROPERTY OF FOREIGN DIPLOMATIC PERSONNEL. | UNLESS ADVISED TO THE CONTRARY, PLAN SEND FOLLOWING DIPLOMATIC NOTE TO MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS ON SEPTEMBER 25: "THE EMBASSY OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA PRESENTS ITS COMPLIMENTS TO THE MINISTRY OF FOREIGN AFFAIRS OF THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN AND HAS THE HONOR TO EXPRESS ITS DESIRE TO COOPERATE WITH THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN AGAINST THE TRAFFIC IN AND ABUSE OF NARCOTIC DRUGS, AND TO PROPOSE THE FOLLOWING MODES OF COOPERATION. "--EXCHANGE OF INFORMATION ON THE PRODUCTION, PROCESSING, TRANSPORTATION, DISTRIBUTION, AND CONSUMPTION OF NARCOTIC DRUGS. "--EXCHANGE OF INFORMATION ON TREATMENT OF DRUG ABUSERS. "--COOPERATION IN THE IDENTIFICATION OF SAMPLES | PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF THE ISLAMIC REPUBLIC OF IRAN

label: QOMI
summary: QOMI | QOMI DENIED THE CURRENT TALE OF HIS VISITATION IN A DREAM BY THE IMAM REZA AND PROVIDED A COPY OF HIS LETTER OF DENIAL. THE ABSENCE OF HIS BOTTOM PLATE OF TEETH ADDED TO THE IMPRESSION OF AGE BUT THIS, ON THE OTHER HAND, WAS BELIED BY HIS HANDS, WHICH WERE SURPRISINGLY SMALL, PLUMP AND NOT WRINKLED OR SPOTTED. HE WAS BORN IN NAJAF BUT CAME TO MASHAD AT AGE THREE WITH HIS FATHER, WHO WAS A WELL KNOWN AYATOLLAH OF THE PERIOD. IN 1933, BECAUSE OF QOMI'S FATHER'S OPPOSITION TO REZA SHAH, THE FAMILY WAS EXILED TO IRAQ. | BY THEN QOMI THE YOUNGER HAD ALREADY ATTAINED THE RANK OF AYATOLLAH BUT HE CONTINUED HIS STUDIES IN NAJAF. HE RETURNED TO MASHAD IN 1947 AND, WITH THE EXCEPTIONS OF TWO PERIODS OF IMPRISONMENT, HE HAS BEEN IN MASHAD EVER SINCE. QOMI'S INCARCERATION TOOK PLACE IN 1963, DUE TO HIS SUPPORT FOR AYATOLLAH KHOMEINI'S FIGHT AGAINST IMPERIAL REFORMS, AND AGAIN FROM 1975-77, WHEN HE WAS EXILED TO HOUSE ARREST IN KARAJ FOR OPPOSING PASSAGE OF CERTAIN LAWS BY THE MAJLIS. | QOMI AGREED TO PROVIDE EMBOFF ISLAMIC TRAINING MATERIALS BUT THESE WERE NOT FORTHCOMING. HE ALSO AGREED TO ARRANGE A MEETING FOR EMBOFF WITH MASHAD'S OTHER LEADING CLERIC, THE AYATOLLAH SHIRAZI. BUT ON FOLLOWING MORNING QOMI AND SHIRAZI LED MARCH TO COMMEMORATE DAY OF MOURNING DECREED BY KHOMEINI. summary: RAMBOD | RAMBOD, 57, MAJLIS DEPUTY FROM TAVALESH, GILAN PROVINCE, HAS SERVED IN PARLIAMENT SINCE 1956. HE IS A 1939 GRADUATE OF TEHRAN MILITARY ACADEMY WHO SUBSEQUENTLY RESIGNED FROM THE ARMY TO WORK ON HIS FAMILY ESTATE IN TAVALESH. RAMBOD WAS THE LEADER OF THE OPPOSITION MARDOM (PEOPLE'S) PARTY IN THE MAJLIS FOR 14 YEARS UNTIL THE PARTY WAS DISSOLVED AFTER THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE RESURGENCE PARTY IN 1975. RAMBOD WAS THE RECIPIENT OF A USIS INTERNATIONAL VISITOR GRANT IN 1967 AND WAS THE SUBJECT OF AN INR BIOGRAPHIC SUMMARY DATED 28 MARCH 1968. RAMBOD, WHO SPEAKS FAIR ENGLISH, FRENCH AND GERMAN, IS REPUTEDLY A SPELL-BINDING ORATOR WHEN SPEAKING IN FARSI. | DURING HIS YEARS AS A PARLIAMENTARY LEADER OF THE LOYAL OPPOSITION, HE WAS A FREQUENT, WELL-PUBLICIZED CRITIC OF THE GOVERNMENT. AN AVIATION EXPERT, RAMBOD HAS FOR MANY YEARS BEEN THE ALITALIA AGENT IN TEHRAN. AS MINISTER FOR PARLIAMENTARY AFFAIRS RAMBOD WILL ATTEND PARLIAMENTARY SESSIONS AS A REPRESENTATIVE OF THE PRIME MINISTER BUT WILL HAVE TO RESIGN AS AN ELECTED DEPUTY. AS THERE ARE TWO MORE YEARS LEFT IN THE PRESENT PARLIAMENT AND THERE IS NO OTHER DEPUTY FROM RAMBOD'S AREA OF GILAN PROVINCE, AN INTERIM ELECTION WILL BE HELD TO FILL THIS VACANCY. | TABRIZ AUTHORITIES HAVE RECEIVED A MESSAGE TO RELEASE PRISONERS OR THERE WILL BE MORE TROUBLE. label: REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL
summary: REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL | YAZDI SAID THE STATEMENT WAS ISSUED TO CLARIFY THE PRELIMINARY STAGE LEADING TO A TRANSITIONAL GOVERNMENT FOLLOWING THE DEPARTURE OF THE SHAH. DESCRIBING THE STATEMENT, YAZDI SAID THAT THE "REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL" WAS ALREADY IN PLACE TO PREPARE ARRANGEMENTS FOR THE TRANSITIONAL GOVERNMENT. THE TRANSITIONAL GOVERNMENT WOULD HAVE THREE AIMS: FIRST, TO HOLD AN ELECTION FOR A CONSTITUENT ASSEMBLY, WHICH IS TO RATIFY A NEW CONSTITUTION; SECOND, TO HOLD NEW ELECTIONS, BASED ON THE NEW CONSTITUTION, FOR A REPRESENTATIVE ASSEMBLY; AND THIRD, TO TRANSFER POWER FROM THE TRANSITIONAL GOVERNMENT TO THE NEWLY ELECTED GOVERNMENT. | THE SECOND OF THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL'S JOBS CITED BY YAZDI WAS TO PREPARE THE GROUND FOR THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT. THE COUNCIL WILL STUDY AND RECOMMEND INDIVIDUALS FOR THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT AND THE AYATOLLAH WILL ANNOUNCE THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT VERY SOON. | RUHANI WAS FIRM IN THE ESSENTIAL NEED TO MAKE A BREAK WITH THE SHAH'S REGIME. THEREFORE, THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL COULD NOT BE ESTABLISHED UNDER THE AUTHORITY OF THE REGENCY COUNCIL. THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL WOULD, HOWEVER, ADHERE TO THE PROCEDURES SET DOWN IN THE 1906 CONSTITION IN ITS EFFORTS TO MODIFY THE CONSTITUTION. THERE WAS SLIGHT PROSPECT, RUHANI SAID, THAT THE KHOMEINI GROUP WOULD BE SATISFIED WITH THE ABDICATION OF THE SHAH AND THE CONTINUATION OF THE MONARCHY WITH THE CROWN PRINCE AS SHAH. | SINCE IT WILL PROBABLY CONTAIN A NUMBER OF OPPOSITIONISTS SUCH AS BAZARGAN WITH WHOM WE ARE ALREADY IN TOUCH, I WOULD ASSUME WE COULD HANDLE IT IN THE SAME VEIN BAKHTIAR PROPOSES. - (C) THE THIRD, WHICH NEED NOT RPT NOT BE ADDRESSED AT THIS TIME, CONCERNS ANY "PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT OF AN ISLAMIC REPUBLIC" WHICH MAY BE ESTABLISHED BY THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. SINCE THIS WOULD BE A RIVAL REGIME TO THE GOVERNMENT WHICH WE RECOGNIZE, I ASSUME WE WILL WISH TO AVOID ANY DEALINGS WITH IT WHICH COULD CARRY THE IMPLICATION OF RECOGNITION. | MIN OF JUSTIC MOBASHERI ANNOUNCED YESTERDAY THAT THE HOVEYDA TRIAL MIGHT CONTINUE IN EITHER THE SENATE OR THE MINISTRY OF JUSTICE ITSELF, AS SOON AS NEW PROCEDURES FOR THE REVOLUTIONARY TRIALS AND IMPLEMENTATION OF VERDICTS ARE WORKED OUT PER KHOMEINI'S ORDER OF 16 MARCH HALTING ALL THE SUMMARY TRIALS AND EXECUTIONS. NEW REGULATIONS GOVERNING SUCH TRIALS ARE TO BE FORMULATED BY THE BAZARGAN GOVERNMENT AND THE REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL. HOVEYDA IS FACING 17 CHARGES, RANGING FROM MASSACRES TO TREASON AND ESPIONAGE, AND APPARENTLY HAS NOT YET BEEN GRANTED A DEFENSE COUNSEL. | REVOLUTIONARY COUNCIL

FROM THIS AREA, THE THREE MARINES RETURNED THE FIRE OF THE ONCOMING ATTACKERS. MEANWHILE, THE SNIPERS BEGAN TO CLOSE IN THE DOWNEY AND NOBLE, WHO WERE EXPOSED TO THE BUILDINGS ACROSS ROOSEVELT STREET. NOBLE WAS SHOT IN THE FATTY PART OF HIS ARM. | ON MAY 19, 1979, AT APPROX 0030 HOURS AND AGAIN AT APPROX 0230 HOURS, THE MUJEHEDDIN GUARD POSTS LOCATED ON THE COMPOUND AT THE CO-OP AND THE ROOSEVELT GATE CAME UNDER "HIT AND RUN" ATTACKS FROM PASSING AUTOS. summary: ROUDAQI HALL | TEHRAN MARTIAL LAW ADMINISTRATION THIS MORNING ISSUED TOUGH NEW DIRECTIVE. CROWDS DID GATHER YESTERDAY NEAR ROUDAKI HALL AND PARTICULARLY NEAR TEHRAN UNIVERSITY. THEY WERE NOT GUNNED DOWN AS THREATENED. HE EXPRESSED IN VERY STRONG TERMS IRAQ'S CONTINUING SUPPORT FOR THE SHAH, BUT BECAUSE EMPRESS WAS NOT IN A POSITION TO CONDUCT A POLITICAL DIALOGUE, CONVERSATION DID NOT APPARENTLY GO INTO GREATER DETAIL. | MFA'S DIRECTOR GENERAL FOR ASIA AND AFRICA SANANDAJI TOLD US MAY 21 THAT HE WAS AWARE OF SADDAM HUSSEIN'S SPEECH OF MAY 10 (REFTEL) BUT DID NOT CONSIDER IT PARTICULARLY APPLICABLE TO IRAN. MFA OFFICIALS APPARENTLY FOCUSED ON WHAT SADDAM HUSSEIN SAID ABOUT FOREIGN WORKERS IN THE LOWER GULF STATES AND FOUND REST OF SPEECH UNEXCEPTIONABLE. DURING HIS MAJOR ADDRESS ON AUGUST 8, SADDAM HUSSEIN ANNOUNCED YET ANOTHER AMNESTY FOR ANY KURDS ABANDONING ARMED STRUGGLE AGAINST THE GOI; SQADDAM'S TIMING OF THE AMNESTY AMMOUNCEMENT MAY WELL BE RELATED TO A RETURN OF SOME JAF TRIBAL ELEMENTS. IF, IN FACT, ELEMENTS OF THE CLAN ARE RETURNING TO IRAQ, THE GOI CAN BE EXPECTED TO SQUEEZE MAXIMUM PUBLICITY OUT OF THE EVENT, PARTICULARLY IN VIEW OF RECENT RUMORS THAT MAS'UD BARZANI HAS RETURNED TO NORTHEASTERN IRAQ. | SADDAM HUSSEIN

label: SADEGHI
summary: SADEGHI | EMBASSY POLITICAL OFFICER ON MAY 21 DISCUSSED IRANIAN REACTION TO U.S. SENATE RESOLUTION CONDEMNING EXECUTIONS BY REVOLUTIONARY COURTS WITH IRANIAN CHARGE SADEGHI. SADEGHI POINTED TO THE STATEMENTS OF FOREIGN MIISTER YAZDI AS A WELL-REASONED AND CALM EXPLANATION OF EVENTS. SADEGHI WAS VERY PLEASED TO SEE SUCH STATEMENTS FROM THE MINISTRY. | EMBASSY OFFICER POINTED OUT THAT YAZDI'S STATEMENTS WERE BITTERLY CONDEMNED BY TEHRAN RADIO COMMENTATOR LATER SAME DAY (MAY 21) WHO SAID THAT YAZDI, WHO HAD LIVED SO LONG IN THE UNITED STATES, "SHOULD KNOW THAT THE SENATE IS THE CENTER OF POWER IN THE UNITED STATES AND THAT SOME SENATORS HAVE MORE INFLUENCE THAN THE PRESIDENT HIMSELF." SADEGHI SAID HE HAD NOT HEARD THAT STATEMENT, BUT THAT IN ANY CASE NOW THAT THERE WAS FREEDOM OF SPEECH AND FREEDOM OF THE PRESS IN IRAN, ONE SHOULD EXPECT TO HEAR CONFLICTING OPINIONS ON SUCH MATTERS. HE AGREED, HOWEVER, THAT THE STRONG DENUNCIATIONS WERE AN OVER-REACTION TO THE SENATE RESOLUTION. | WITH SOME AMUSEMENT, SADEGHI POINTED OUT THAT NOW IRAN HAD MADE GREAT ADVANCES ON THE POLITICAL STAGE. HE SAID IT WAS A SIGN OF GREAT POLITICAL MATURITY THAT PASSIONATE DEBATE RAGES THROUGHOUT THE COUNTRY ON THE ROLE AND RELATIVE IMPORTANCE OF THE SENATE IN MAKING AMERICAN FOREIGN POLICY. | SADEGHI

summary: SALEH BANAFTI | (C - ENTIRE TEXT) | SUMMARY: IN LENGTHY TALK WITH POLOFF, NON-RELIGIOUS OPPOSITIONIST BANAFTI EXPLAINED HOW U.S. HAS BROUGHT IRAN TO ITS PRESENT PASS AND ASKED THAT U.S. SAVE ITS FUTURE IN IRAN BY QUICK SHIFT TO FORCES OF LIGHT. BANAFTI EXPRESSED VIEW THAT FOOLISHNESS BY ARMY IS NOW ONLY THING THAT COULD DELAY OR DISRUPT VICTORY OF KHOMEINI FORCES. EMBOFF AGREED THAT ARMY IS THE CONTRARY FORCE BUT EMPHASIZED THAT WHILE USG HAS LIMITED AND POSSIBLY DECREASING INFLUENCE WITH ARMY, IT DEFINITELY DOES NOT HAVE CONTROL. EMBOFF NOTED THAT ATTACKS ON GENERALS IN PRESS AND ELSEWHERE (SUCH AS HAJ-SEYYED JAVADI ARTICLE REPORTED SEPTEL) COULD HARDLY LEAVE GENERALS IN RELAXED AND FRIENDLY STATE OF MIND. | BANAFTI COMMENTED THAT "THERE IS NO TELLING WHAT GENERALS LIKE OVEISSI, RABII AND KHOSROWDAD MIGHT DO." label: SHIRAZ REFINERY
summary: SHIRAZ REFINERY | DIRECTOR OF PUBLIC RELATIONS AT SHIRAZ REFINERY, MOHAMMAD SHIRAZI, TOLD POL COUNS MAY 27 THAT REFINERY IS OPERATING BUT CONTINUES TO SUFFER FROM LABOR UNREST. SHIRAZI SAID THAT FOLLOWING FEBRUARY REVOLUTION LARGE NUMBERS OF STAFF AT REFINERY WERE REPLACED BY PERSONNEL FROM ABADAN, KERMANSHAH AND TEHRAN. THOSE FROM ABADAN HAVE GENERALLY BEEN PROFESSIONAL AND INTERESTED IN GETTING THE REFINERY BACK INTO FULL PRODUCTION, BUT THOSE FROM TEHRAN AND KERMANSHAH HAVE PRIMARILY BEEN ENGAGED IN FOMENTING TROUBLE BETWEEN LABORERS AND HOLDOVER MANAGERS. SHIRAZI SAID THAT HE BELIEVES AGITATORS HAVE AFFILIATION WITH FEDAYIN-E-KHALQ. THE PRO-MOSCOW TUDEH PARTY APPARENTLY HAS LITTLE INFLUENCE AMONG SHIRAZ REFINERY WORKERS. | SHIRAZ REFINERY MANAGING DIRECTOR, ASGHAR SHAHRIAR, IN AN EARLIER CONVERSATION WITH POL COUNS, ALSO SAID MUCH THE SAME THING. HE WAS VERY DISCOURAGED WITH THE SITUATION AT THE REFINERY, SAYING THAT HARDLY A DAY GOES BY WITHOUT SOME KIND OF INCIDENT WITH THE WORKERS AND LOWER LEVEL WHITE COLLAR PERSONNEL. | ACCORDING TO SHIRAZI, THE ABORTIVE ATTACK ON THE SHIRAZ REFINERY BY AN UNIDENTIFIED GROUP OF ARMED MEN MAY 23 WAS UNRELATED TO LABOR DIFFICULTIES AT THE FACILITY. | AS NOTED REF A, EMBASSY ECONOMIC OFFICERS TOURED IRAN'S KHUZESTAN OIL PROVINCE FROM SEPTEMBER 23-30, MEETING IN THE COURSE OF THE TRIP PROVINCIAL GOVERNOR GENERAL MADANI, THE GOVERNOR OF ABADAN, A VARIETY OF NIOC/OSCO SUPERVISORY PERSONNEL AND SEDIRAN'S MANAGER IN AHWAZ, THE MANAGING DIRECTORS OF THE ABADAN AND SHIRAZ REFINERIES, THE GENERAL MANAGER OF THE ABADAN AND BANDAR MASHAR PETROCHEMICAL COMPANIES, NIOC PERSONNEL ON KHARG ISLAND, IPAC'S KHARG ISLAND MANAGER, AND A VARIETY OF BUSINESSMEN, BANKING OFFICIALS, ENGINEERS AND TECHNICIANS, AS WELL AS SPOKESMEN FOR WORKERS GROUPS IN THE AREA. AT ALL LEVELS AND ON EVERY OCCASION WE WERE CORDIALLY RECEIVED. | THE MAJORITY OF MANAGER/TECHNICIANS SEEM TO SEE WHAT AN NPC ENGINEER DESCRIBED AS "KHOMEINI'S REVEALED PREFERENCE FOR INCOME LEVELS REQUIRING CONTINUED OIL EXPORTS AT ABOUT THE CURRENT RATE" AS THEIR PROTECTION AGAINST AN ULTRACONSERVATIVE MAJORITY CAPABLE OF "RUINOUS EXCESSES." WE COULD FIND LITTLE INTEREST FOR THE LEFT AMONG THIS GROUP AS A POLITICAL ALTERNATIVE (THOUGH SOME COMMITTEE MEMBERS AT THE SHIRAZ REFINERY SAID THERE WERE LEFTISTS AMONG THE OIL WORKERS AND "THEY WERE NOT AMONG THE LOWEST PAID.") MORALE -- UNTIL RECENTLY AT LEAST -- AMONG THIS GROUP RANGED FROM "ACCEPTABLE TO BAD" WITH MANY CONCERNED FOR WHAT THE FUTURE WILL BRING BUT STILL INCLINED TO BELIEVE THAT MATTERS MIGHT IMPROVE SLOWLY. | SHIRAZ REFINERY

label: SISTAN
summary: SISTAN | FIRST, A FEW FACTS CONCERNING THE PHYSICAL SITUATIONIN SISTAN, THE AREA IN IRAN WATERY THE HELMAND: --THE REGION IS DRYING UP. RECENT ARCHEOLOGICAL EXCAVATIONS IN SISTAN INDICATE THAT THE WATER TABLE HAS FALLEN ABOUT 20 METERS IN THE LAST 5,000 YEARS. --ALMOST NONE OF THE WATER WHICH FLOW INTO THE HAMUN (THE SYSTEM OF SHALLOW LAKES WHICH STRADDLES THE IRAN-AFGHAN BORDER THERE) RISES ON THE IRANIAN SIDE. AMBASSADOR DAVOUDI'S STATEMENT (PARA 9 REF A) IS PATENTLY FALSE. --SISTAN IS A RELATIVELY REPEAT RELATIVELY FERTILE AREA IN AN OTHERWISE EXTREMELY ARID REGION. | ON THE AVERAGE, SISTAN GETS ABOUT 30 MILLILITERS OF PRECIPITATION ANNUALLY, AND EVEN WITH IRRIGATION THE AVERAGE YIELD OF WHEAT PER HECTARE IS ONLY 1.5 TONS, SOMEWHAT BELOW THE IRANIAN NATIONAL AVERAGE FOR IRRIGATED WHEAT WHICH ITSELF IS NOT PARTICULARLY HIGH. --THE HELMAND IS SISTAN DIVIDES INTO SEVERAL DISTRIBUTARIES, SOME NATURAL AND OTHERS MAN-MADE. | CONVERTING THE AREA TO PASTURAGE WOULD REDUCE THE PER HECTAR REQUIREMENT FOR WATER. A CERTAIN AMOUNT OF GRAIN PRODUCTION WOULD BE LOST THEREBY, BUT EVEN NOW SISTAN'S PRODUCTIVE CAPACITY IS ONLY OF LOCAL IMPORTANCE (NO MORE THAN 2.5 PERCENT OF IRAN'S TOTAL WHEAT PRODUCTION COMES FROM THE REGION). MOREOVER, DEMOGRAPHIC TRENDS, IRRESPECTIVE OF THE AVAILABILITY OF WATER, ARE HASTENING THE DAY WHEN A MAJOR SHIFT IN THE CHARACTER OF AGRICULTURE IN SISTAN WILL BECOME INEVITABLE. | THUS, AS SUGGESTED BY AMBASSADOR MAHMUD-GHAZI (PARA 2 REF B), RATIFICATION OF THE HELMAND WATERS TREATY MAY NOT ENTIRELY PACIFY THE GOI SINCE IT WILL DO NOTHING TO RELIEVE (AND MAY EVEN EXACERBATE) LOCAL CONCERNS IN SISTAN. | GHAUS'S HYPOTHESIS (PARA 4 REF C) REGARDING IRANIAN MACHINATIONS HAS A CERTAIN PLAUSIBILITY, ALTHOUGH GIVEN SISTAN'S DECLINING AGRICULTURAL IMPORTANCE AND THE DEMOGRAPHIC PATTERN THERE (IT WOULD APPEAR THAT THE POPULATION HAS ACTUALLY DECLINED ALTHOUGH THE MOST RECENT CENSUS INDICATED A VERY SLIGHT INCREASE OVER THE LAST TWO DECADES), I AM INCLINED TO THINK A VARIANT OF IT MIGHT HAVE GREATER VALIDITY: IRAN NEEDS (AND IS PRESENTLY USING) MORE WATER THAN IT IS ENTITLED TO UNDER THE TERMS OF THE TREATY DURING THE PERIOD OF TIME REQUIRED FOR TRANSITION FROM CEREAL CULTIVATION BY TRADITIONAL METHODS TO SOMETHING ELSE REQUIRING BOTH LESS WATER AND LESS LABOR. | SISTAN

label: SOUTH WEST AFRICA
summary: SOUTH WEST AFRICA | THROUGHOUT THE MONTHS OF DISCUSSION PRECEDING ACCEPTANCE OF YOUR PROPOSAL I MADE IT CLEAR TO YOUR REPRESENTATIVES THAT I WAS NOT PREPARED TO CONTINUE WITH NEGOTIATIONS FOR A SETTLEMENT OF THE SOUTH WEST AFRICA QUESTION IF THE ISSUE OF WALVIS BAY WERE TO BE INTRODUCED INTO THE NEGOTIATIONS OR IN ANY SETTLEMENT PROPOSAL. YOUR REPRESENTATIVES ACKNOWLEDGED ON MORE THAN ONE OCCASION IN MY PRESENCE THAT THEY ACCEPTED THIS BASIS FOR OUR NEGOTIATIONS. | THEY ACKNOWLEDGED THAT WALVIS BAY WAS NOT PART AND PARCEL OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA, ALLUDING MERELY TO THE POSSIBILITY THAT A CONTROVERSY MIGHT ARISE ABOUT THE ISSUE AT SOME FUTURE STAGE. THEY ACKNOWLEDGED THAT THEY WERE NOT ARGUING AT ALL ABOUT THE POLITICAL AND LEGAL SITUATION IN RESPECT OF WALVIS BAY. | FURTHERMORE, IN ITS RESPONSE TO THE FIVE'S MESAGE OF 22 JUNE 1978 THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT AGAIN DEALT IN SOME DETAIL WITH THE ISSUE OF WALVIS BAY. IT SAID INTER ALIA: "IN REGARD TO WALVIS BAY THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT WISHES TO REMIND THE FIVE GOVERNMENTS THAT IN THE COURSE OF THE EARLIER DISCUSSIONS THE FIVE HAD AGREED THAT THE ISSUE OF WALVIS BAY WOULD NOT FORM PART OF THEIR PROPOSAL, BEING A MATTER WHICH COULD FORM THE SUBJECT OF DISCUSSION ON A VOLUNTARY BASIS BETWEEN SOUTH AFRICA AND THE NEW GOVERNMENT OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA. | I WOULD ALSO LIKE TO DRAW YOUR ATTENTION TO A COMMUNICATION ADDRESSED TO THE SECRETARY GENERAL ON 2 MAY 1978 BY MY FOREIGN MINISTER. IN REGARD TO THE GEOGRAPHIC EXTENT AND LEGAL POSITION OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA HE POINTED OUT: "FOR OVER THIRTY YEARS THE UNITED NATIONS HAS CONCERNED ITSELF WITH THE QUESTION OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA, A TERRITORY WHOSE GEOGRAPHIC EXTENT HAS THROUGH THE YEARS BEEN CLEARLY DEFINED, ALSO IN DOCUMENTS OF THE LEAGUE OF NATIONS AND THE UNITED NATIONS ITSELF. BASED ON TREATIES WHICH ALSO DEFINE THE BORDERS OF OTHER COUNTRIES IN THE REGION THE TERRITORY'S BOUNDARIES HAVE BEEN INTERNATIONALLY RECOGNISED FOR ALMOST A HUNDRED YEARS. | THIS MANIFESTO WAS WELCOMED BY THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY ITSELF AS RESOLUTION 2505 (XXIV) ON 20 NOVEMBER 1969. NO ENTITY CAN CLAIM THE RIGHT TO ADD TO OR TO DIMINISH THE AREA OF THE FORMER MANDATED TERRITORY OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA. UNDER INTERNATIONAL LAW SOUTH AFRICA HAS SOVEREIGNTY OVER WALVIS BAY. WHATEVER ARRANGEMENT MIGHT BE REACHED BETWEEN SOUTH AFRICA AND A DULY ELECTED GOVERNMENT OF AN INDEPENDENT SOUTH WEST AFRICA, IS A MATTER FOR THESE TWO GOVERNMENTS.". | SOUTH WEST AFRICA

label: SOUTH YEMEN
summary: SOUTH YEMEN | AT OUR INITIATIVE, ASSISTANT SECRETARY ATHERTON MET IN NEW YORK JUNE 22 WITH PDRY PERMANENT REPRESENTATIVE ASHTAL. ATHERTON ASKED ASHTAL TO CONVEY TO HIS GOVERNMENT THAT,IN ACCORDANCE WITH PRESIDENT'S POLICY OF SEEKING TO IMPROVE RELATIONS WHEREVER POSSIBLE, WE WOULD LIKE TO ENTER INTO A HIGH-LEVEL DIALOGUE WITH A VIEW TO IMPROVING RELATIONS WITH SOUTH YEMEN LOOKING TOWARD THE RESTORATION OF DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS. TO THAT END, WE PROPOSED A MEETING OF SENIOR OFFICIALS OF OUR TWO GOVERNMENTS IN ADEN, WASHINGTON, NEW YORK OR WHEREVER THE YEMENIS FOUND CONVENIENT. | RECENT ASSASSINATIONS AND COUPS IN SOUTH ARABIA HAVE FUELED THE FLAMES OF RUMOR ON THE NUMBER OF SOVIETS, CUBANS, EAST EUROPEANS AND OTHERS IN SOUTH YEMEN. IN ANTICIPATION OF SAG RAISING ISSUE IN COURSE OF YOUR FORTHCOMING DISCUSSIONS, INTELLIGENCE COMMUNITY HAS REVIEWED REPORTS AND OTHER AVAILABLE DATA AND BELIEVES THERE IS NO HARD EVIDENCE TO SUBSTANTIATE REPORTS OF EITHER SIGNIFICANT INCREASES OR REDUCTIONS IN NUMBER OF CUBANS OR SOVIETS OVER PAST MONTHS. | AT THE SAME TIME, SAUD TOLD THE IRANIAN AMBASSADOR THAT, IN LINE WITH CUTOFF OF SAUDI FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE TO PDRY, SAUDI TROOPS HAVE BEEN PULLED BACK AND ARE NO LONGER INTERPOSED BETWEEN SOUTH YEMEN EXILES AND PDRY TROOPS AT SAUDI-PDRY BORDER. THEREFORE, EXILES ARE ABLE TO CARRY OUT RAIDS ACROSS THE BORDER, AND THESE ARE SOMETIMES RECIPROCATED BY PDRY TROOPS. (COMMENT: AMBASSADOR DID NOT SEEM DISPOSED TO DRAW POSSIBLY OBVIOUS CONCLUSION THAT PDRY MILITARY BUILDUP MAY BE DEFENSIVE IN NATURE INTENDED TO PREVENT RETURN OF SOUTH YEMENI EXILES FROM SAUDI TERRITORY TO SOUTH YEMEN.) | MOSCOW'S INTEREST IN THE PDRY APPEARS TO BE MAINLY STRATEGIC. EVEN BEFORE THEIR EXPULSION FROM SOMALIA, THE SOVIETS HAD SOUGHT ACCESS TO SOUTH YEMENI NAVAL AND AIR FACILITIES. THE LOSS OF THE SOVIET BASE IN BERBERA ADDED AN ELEMENT OF URGENCY. | SOUTH YEMEN

summary: SUWAIDI | IN PRECISELY SAME WAY ABU DHABIANS HAVE REFERRED TO MAHDI TAJIR AS BEING TROUBLE-MAKER ON DUBAI SIDE. summary: SWAPO | CESSATION OF VIOLENCE IN SOUTH AFRICA'S COMMUNICATION TO THE FIVE DATED 12 SEPTEMBER 1978 IT WAS STATED THAT SOUTH AFRICA "IS WILLING TO CONFIRM THAT THE MOMENT SWAPO UNDERTAKES TO STOP VIOLENCE AND IN FACT CARRIES OUT ITS UNDERTAKING, ACTION AGAINST SWAPO BY THE SOUTH AFRICAN FORCES WOULD CEASE". IT WAS SUGGESTED IN THE ABOVE MENTIONED AIDE MEMOIRE OF THE FIVE THAT SOUTH AFRICA SHOULD PROCLAIM ITS WILLINGESS TO CONFIRM ITS UNDERTAKING IN THIS REGARD IN A FORMAL MANNER. | OUTSTANDING ISSUES THE SOUTH AFRICAN GOVERNMENT TAKES NOTE OF THE STATEMENT BY THE FIVE THAT SWAPO HAS ACCEPTED THEIR PROPOSAL. THIS CONTENTION HOWEVER DOES NOT RHYME WITH MR. NUJOMA'S SUBSEQUENT STATEMENT IN AN INTERVIEW IN NEW YORK IN WHICH HE SAID THAT WHILE SWAPO ACCEPTED THE SECRETARY-GENERAL'S REPORT, THE PROPOSAL OF THE FIVE WAS NOT ACCEPTABLE. MOREOVER, SWAPO HAS CONTINUED UNABATEDLY WITH ACTS OF VIOLENCE AGAINST THE PEOPLE OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA. THESE ACTS, TOGETEHR WITH THE RECENT STATEMENT BY MR. | NUJOMA, AND THE ASSASSINATION OF ITS POLITICAL OPPOINENTS, WOULD SEEM CONCLUSIVELY TO INDICATE THAT SWAPO HAS NO INTENTION OF WORKING TOWARDS A PEACEFUL TRANSITION TO INDEPENDENCE IN SOUTH WEST AFRICA. INDEED, SWAPO SEENS INTENT UPON WRECKING A PEACEFUL SETTLEMENT BY WAY OF MURDER, KIDNAPPING, ARMED ROBBERY AND OTHER FORMS OF INTIMIDATION DIRECTED, FOR THE MOST PART, AGAINST CIVILIANS. THE EXCHANGES BETWEEN SOUTH AFRICA AND THE FIVE HAVE CONTAINED SUGGESTIONS THAT UNTAG MAY NOT REACH THE NUMBER OF 7500. | MOREOVER IT IS CLEAR THAT THIS FIGURE ALSO CAME AS A SURPRISE TO THOSE WHO HAVE NEGOTIATED WITH US OVER THE LAST YEAR AND A HALF. DURING GHE LENGTHY NEGOTIATIONS THE FIVE WERE REPEATEDLY REMINDED OF THE POLITICAL AND PSYCHOLOGICAL EFFECT OF SUCH A LARGE NUMBER OF UN PERSONNEL ON THE PEOPLE OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA IN CIRCUMSTANCES WHERE THE IMPARTIALITY OF THE UN IS RENDERED SUSPECT BY ITS CONTINUED AND SUSTAINED ASSISTANCE TO SWAPO TO THE EXCLUSION OF ALL OTHER POLITICAL PARTIES IN SOUTH WEST AFRICA. | THUS, FOR EXAMPLE, SWAPO IS RECOGNIZED BY THE UN GENERAL ASSEMBLY AS "THE SOLE AND AUTHENTIC REPRESENTATIVE OF THE PEOPLE" OF SOUTH WEST AFRICA AND RECEIVES CONSIDERABLE FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE. FURTHERMORE IT ENJOYS EXTENSIVE FACILITIES TO BEAM PROPAGANDA TO THE TERRITORY AND ELSEWHERE. INDED THE UN'S WHOLE INFORMATION SYSTEM ITSELF SUPPORTS SWAPO. WHILE SOUTH AFRICA HAS RECEIVED ASSURANCES ON THE COMPOSITION OF UNTAG, THERE IS NOW REASON FOR SERIOUS CONCERN ALSO ON THIS POINT. DURING THE NEGOTIATIONS SOUTH AFRICA MADE IT CLEAR THAT IT COULD NOT ACCEPT PERSONNEL FROM COUNTRIES WHICH HAVE BEEN SUPPORTING SWAPO'S HOSTILE ACTION. SOUTH AFRICA WAS IN NO SENSE OPPOSED TO CONTINGENTS FROM AFRICA AS SUCH. | SWAPO

label: TAIWAN
summary: TAIWAN | PRESIDENT, ON YOUR NEGOTIATIONS WITH CHINA OVER NORMALIZATION OF DIPLOMATIC RELATIONS, DID YOU AT ANY POINT ASK THE CHINESE TO PROVIDE A BINDING WRITTEN PLEDGE THAT THEY WOULD NOT TRY TO SEIZE TAIWAN BY FORCE? AND IF YOU DID REQUEST THAT, WHY DIDN'T YOU GET IT? AND IF YOU DIDN'T, WHY DIDN'T YOU ASK FOR IT? (LAUGHTER) - P: YES. ONE OF OUR GOALS IN THE NEGOTIATION WAS TO GET A PUBLIC COMMITMENT ON THE PART OF CHINA THAT THE DIFFERENCES WITH TAIWAN WOULD BE RESOLVED PEACEFULLY. THIS WAS NOT POSSIBLE TO ACHIEVE. | THE FINAL OUTCOME OF THAT WAS THAT WE WOULD MAKE A UNILATERAL STATEMENT THAT WE EXPECT ANY DIFFERENCES BETWEEN TAIWAN AND CHINA TO BE RESOLVED PEACEFULLY, AND THE AGREEMENT WAS THAT THE LEADERS IN CHINA WOULD NOT CONTRADICT THAT STATEMENT. SINCE THE ANNOUNCEMENT OF NORMALIZATION, VICE PREMIER DENG XIAOPING AND OTHERS HAVE MADE PUBLIC COMMENTS THAT SUBSTANTIATE THE STATEMENT THAT I HAVE MADE. | WE WERE ALSO INSISTENT UPON THE FACT THAT THE TREATY BETWEEN US AND TAIWAN WOULD NOT BE PEREMPTORILY OR IMMEDIATELY CANCELED OR ABROGATED. THE TREATY WILL BE TERMINATED IN ACCORDANCE WITH ITS OWN PROVISIONS WITH A ONE-YEAR'S NOTICE TO TAIWAN. THE CHINESE DID NOT AGREE WITH THIS ORIGINALLY BUT THEY FINALLY ACCEPTED THAT FACT. ANOTHER INSISTENCE THAT WE HAD, WHICH WAS FINALLY AGREED TO, WAS THAT WE WOULD GO AHEAD WITH NORMAL TRADE, CULTURAL RELATIONSHIPS WITH TAIWAN AND ALSO THAT EXISTING TREATIES OTHER THAN THE DEFENSE TREATY WOULD CONTINUE IN EFFECT. | ONE POINT ON WHICH WE DID NOT AGREE WITH THE CHINESE WAS THAT WE WILL, AFTER THIS YEAR, CONTINUE TO SELL DEFENSIVE WEAPONS TO TAIWAN, TO PROVIDE FOR THEIR SECURITY NEEDS. THE CHINESE LEADERS DO NOT AGREE WITH THIS POLICY, BUT THEY UNDERSTAND THAT IT IS OUR POLICY AND, KNOWING THAT, THEY WENT AHEAD WITH NORMALIZATION. | ECONOMIC PROSPECTS IN MY "INITIAL IMPRESSIONS OF IRAN" I WROTE THAT "IRAN IS NOT WEST GERMANY...IT IS NOT EVEN TAIWAN OF SOUTH KOREAM" THE OBVIOUS TRUTH OF THAT ASSESSMENT, FROM THE POINT OF VIEW OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT, HAS LONG SINCE BECOME INESCAPABLE. INDEED, THE DISCREPENCY BETWEEN THE SHAH'S BOAST TO MAKE IRAN THE WORLD'S FIFTH LEADING INDUSTRIAL POWER BY THE YEAR 2000 AND THE REALITY OF IRAN'S FALTERING ECONOMIC PERFORMANCE WAS UNDOUBTEDLY A SIGNIFICANT FACT IN HIS ULTIMATE DOWNFALL. | TAIWAN

THIS VIEW HAS IT THAT THE CORPS IS NOTHING MORE THAN A FICTION, AN UMBRELLA NAME FOR THE UNCOORDINATED LOCAL RELIGIOUS FORCES, CREATED TO GIVE THEM A CERTAIN LEGITIMACY, WHILE DENYING THAT LEGITIMACY TO OTHER ARMED GROUPS, SUCH AS THE MARXIST FEDAYEN, POLITICAL FORCES, OR THE FORCES OF LCCAL STRONG-MEN. | IN UNSIGNED EDITORIAL, ENGLISH LANGUAGE TEHRAN TIMES EXPANDED THIS TO NOTE: "THE ARRAIGNMENT (IN A FOREIGN COURT) OF SOMEONE WHO HAS KILLED...(ONE OF THE THIRTEEN) ...IN ANY FOREIGN COUNTRY WILL BE PROPERLY CONSIDERED AN ACT AFFECTING THE RELATIONS BETWEEN THAT COUNTRY AND IRAN." EVEN IN REPORTING THE QOM STATEMENT, AT LEAST ONE NEWSPAPER (TEHRAN TIMES) USED THE TITLE "AYATOLLAH" IN REFERRING TO HIM. | TO DATE THERE HAS BEEN LITTLE REACTION IN IRAN TO THE FIGHTING IN KABUL OR KHALQI ACCUSATIONS THAT IRAN WAS INVOLVED. TWO MAJOR FARSI LANGUAGE PAPERS (KAYHAN AND ETTELAAT) CARRIED BRIEF ITEMS BASED ON WIRE SERVICES REPORTS JUNE 24 AS DID THE ENGLISH LANGUAGE TEHRAN TIMES JUNE 25. NEITHER FARSI LANGUAGE MORNING PAPER (AYENDAGAN AND BAMDAD) JUNE 25 BOTHERED TO MENTION AFGHANISTAN. ONLY THE TEHRAN TIMES CITED THE CHARGE THAT IRAN WAS SOMEHOW INVOLVED. SO FAR THERE HAS BEEN NO OFFICIAL REACTION TO THIS, EITHER FROM THE PGOI OR THE KHOMEINI ENTOURAGE, ALTHOUGH WE EXPECT SOMEONE TO GET AROUND TO IT SOONER OR LATER. | TEHRAN TIMES

label: THAILAND

ALL THREE ARE CAREER DIPLOMATS WITH PREVIOUS SERVICE ABROAD. | PRESIDENT, NEXT MONTH YOU ARE GOING TO MEET, SUPPOSEDLY, WITH THE PRIME MINISTER OF THAILAND, WHO IS THE HEAD OF A NATION THAT IS NOW THREATENED BY THE VIETNAMESE, AND I NEED TO KNOW TWO THINGS, IF YOU COULD. ONE, WHAT IS THE U.S. PREPARED TO OFFER THAILAND TO EASE THEIR CONCERNS ABOUT THE VIETNAMESE? WILL IT BE MONEY, ECONOMIC AID, MILITARY WEAPONS, OR AMERICAN-PILOTED AIRCRAFT? | NUMBER TWO, HAVE YOU PERSONALLY BEEN IN TOUCH WITH THE LEADERS OF CHINA AND THE SOVIET UNION TO SEE WHAT THEY PLAN TO DO TO HELP EASE THE SITUATION? - P: WE ARE VERY INTERESTED IN SEEING THE INTEGRITY OF THAILAND PROTECTED, THE BORDERS NOT ENDANGERED OR EVEN THREATENED BY THE INSURGENT TROOPS FROM VIETNAM IN CAMBODIA. WE HAVE JOINED IN WITH ALMOST ALL OTHER NATIONS OF THE WORLD AND THE UNITED NATIONS IN CONDEMNING THE INTRUSION INTO CAMBODIA BY VIETNAMESE FORCES. THIS OBVIOUSLY INVOLVES THE ADJACENT COUNTRY OF THAILAND. MR. | KRIANGSAK WILL BE COMING HERE TO VISIT WITH ME, AND DURING THAT TIME, WE WILL REASSURE HIM THAT OUR INTERESTS ARE IN A STABLE AND SECURE AND PEACEFUL THAILAND. WE HAVE CONTINUING TRADE RELATIONSHIPS WITH THAILAND. WE PROVIDE THEM WITH SOME MILITARY ARMS FOR DEFENSIVE PURPOSES, AS HAVE BEEN NEGOTIATED FOR A LONG PERIOD OF TIME. WE DON'T DETECT ANY IMMEDIATE THREAT TO THE BORDERS OF THAILAND. IN SOME INSTANCES, THE INVADING FORCES INTO CAMBODIA HAVE DELIBERATELY STAYED AWAY FROM THE BORDER ITSELF AND OF COURSE THE CHINESE GIVE THAILAND VERY STRONG SUPPORT. THE SOVIET UNION HAS EXPRESSED THEIR SUPPORT FOR VIETNAM, AS YOU KNOW. | AND IN OUR EFFORTS, ALONG WITH OTHERS IN THE UNITED NATIONS, WE HAVE WARNED BOTH THE VIETNAMESE AND ALSO THE SOVIETS WHO SUPPLY THEM AND SUPPORT THEM AGAINST ANY DANGER THEY MIGHT EXHIBIT TOWARD THAILAND. - Q: YOU HAVE INVITED FORMER PRESIDENT RICHARD NIXON TO THE WHITE HOUSE FOR THE DINNER FOR CHINESE LEADER DENG XIAOPING. DURING YOUR CAMPAIGN, YOU SAID MR. | THAILAND

label: UKAEA
summary: UKAEA | QUESTON: DOES AEOI HAVE CONTRACT OR OTHER FORMAL UNDERSTANDING REGARDING SITING, REACTOR DESIGN, OR OTHER TYPES OF SAFETY OR ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION ANALYSES OR REVIEWS WHICH INVOLVES ASSISTANCE FROM A GOVERNMENT AGENCY OR MINISTRY OF A FOREIGN COUNTRY? ANSWER: AEOI HAS CONTRACTS AND UNDERSTANDINGS WITH SEVERAL COUNTRIES; E.G., A CONTRACT IN THE AREA OF NUCLEAR SAFETY EXISTS WITH THE UKAEA; UNDERSTANDING (OR WORKING RELATIONSHIP) EXISTS FOR CERTAIN PROJECTS WITH JAPAN AND TO A LESSER EXTENT, WITH FRANCE AND GERMANY IN THE SAFETY AREA. IN THE CASE OF JAPAN A GOOD WORKING RELATIONSHIP AND CONSEQUENTLY IMPROVED RAPPORT IS THE APPARENT OBJECTIVE OF MITI. | QUESTION: WHAT COUNTRIES AND AGENCIES ARE INVOLVED? ANSWER: AS STATED ABOVE THE UK THROUGH UKAEA, THE GOJ THROUGH MITI, AND TO A LESSER EXTENT FRANCE AND GERMANY THROUGH CEA AND THE MINISTRY OF TRADE RESPECTIVELY. IN THE CASE OF FRG, THE MINISTRY IS THE COORDINATING BODY FOR PROVISION OF SERVICES THROUGH TUV, GRS, AND OTHER GERMAN SAFETY RELATED ORGANIZATIONS. | QUESTIONS: WHO DETERMINED SCOPE, INTENSITY, TIMING AND DURATION OF THE REVIEWS/ANSWERS: IN GENERAL, AEOI ESTABLISHES THESE PARAMETERS; HOWEVER, THE TIMING DEPENDS ON AVAILABLE MANPOWER AND BUDGET. FOR EXAMPLE, IN THE CASE OF THE UKAEA CONTRACT, AEOI PAYS THE COSTS AND THEREFORE ESTABLISHES THE INTENSITY OF SERVICES TO BE PROVIDED THROUGH ITS BUDGET ALLOCATION. SINCE IN THE CASE OF THE JAPANESE UNDERSTANDING, NO DOLLARS FLOW FROM AEOI, A PROBLEM SOLVING EFFORT IS MUTUALLY AGREED UPON AS A FUNCTION OF THE GOJ BUDGET IN THAT FIELD. | UKAEA

summary: US FIRM | DAILY RATE WORKER STRIKE. ACCORDING TO EXECUTIVE OF U.S. FIRM WHICH BELONGS TO CONSORTIUM, GENERAL WALK-OUT OF DAILY RATE EMPLOYEES (DRE'S), MOSTLY IRANIAN, TOOK PLACE ON MONDAY, SEPTEMBER 25, AND INVOLVED ALL MAJOR KHUZESTAN PRODUCTION FACILITIES AS WELL AS KHARG ISLAND LOADING TERMINAL. label: VINOGRADOV
summary: VINOGRADOV | EVENING OF NOVEMBER 14 I HAD AN OPPORTUNITY TO ASK SOVIET AMBASSADOR VINOGRADOV HOW AMBASSADOR MENDELEVICH'S TALKS WITH THE IRANIANS WENT ON THE INDIAN OCEAN. VINOGRADOV TOLD ME THAT MENDELEVICH HAD GIVEN THE IRANIANS A STATUS REPORT ON THE US-USSR TALKS WHICH AS HE DESCRIBED IT WAS VERY MUCH ALONG THE LINES OF THE SAME REPORT WE HAD GIVEN THE GOI ON THE BASIS OF STATE 238371 AND 241701. VINOGRADOV SAID THAT INITIALLY HE HAD SENSED THAT THE IRANIANS WERE WORRIED THAT THE U.S. AND USSR MAY BE WORKING OUT SOME KIND OF ARRANGEMENT BEHIND IRAN'S BACK WHICH COULD PROVE TO BE TO IRAN'S DISADVANTAGE. | HE SAID ALSO THAT THE IRANIANS HAD EXPRESSED SOME IRRITATION AT NOT BEING INCLUDED IN THE TALKS AND/OR NOT BEING KEPT MORE CLOSELY INFORMED. ACCORDING TO VINOGRADOV THE IRANIANS SEEMED MUCH MORE RELAXED AT THE CONCLUSION OF THE SOVIET EXPLANATION AND PLEASED THAT THE SOVIETS HAD TAKEN THE TROUBLE TO SEND THE HEAD OF THEIR DELEGATION TO TEHRAN TO FILL THEM IN ON OUR TALKS. HE SAID THAT MENDELEVICH HAD "DIPLOMATICALLY" MADE THE POINT THAT THE INDIAN OCEAN WAS NOT THE EXCLUSIVE PRESERVE OF THE LITTORAL STATES AND THAT MARITIME POWERS SUCH AS THE U.S. | MENDELEVICH ASSURED THE IRANIANS THAT THE US-USSR TALKS IN NO WAY IMPINGED ON IRANIAN INTEREST WHICH HE ACKNOWLEDGED WERE LEGITIMATE--IRAN BEING ONE OF THE INDIAN OCEAN'S LITTORAL STATES--AND SAID THAT THERE WAS NO INTENTION OF A DEAL BEING MADE BEHIND IRAN'S BACK. IN SUM, VINOGRADOV THOUGHT THAT THE TALKS HAD GONE VERY WELL AND THAT THEY HAD BEEN PARTICULARLY USEFUL AND TIMELY IN VIEW OF THE SHAH'S IMMINENT MEETING WITH PRESIDENT CARTER, WHERE THE SUBJECT OF THE INDIAN OCEAN MIGHT COME UP. | SHAH TOLD ME EVENING JANUARY 5 THAT HE HAD BEEN VISITED THAT SAME MORNING BY SOVIET AMBASSADOR VINOGRADOV, WHO HAD CONVEYED WARMEST NEW YEAR'S GREETINGS FROM THE SOVIET LEADERSHIP. | THE SHAH SAID HE HAD TOLD VINOGRADOV THAT HE WOULD STUDY THE QUESTION, BUT THAT HE THOUGHT THE MATTER WAS SOMETHING BETWEEN THE SOVIETS AND THE NATO COUNTRIES, IN WHICH IRAN HAD NO VOICE. THE SOVIET AMBASSADOR ANSWERED THIS COMMENT WITH A "VERY FLATTERING" REFERENCE TO THE SHAH'S GREAT INFLUENCE AND AUTHORITY THROUGHOUT THE WORLD. | VINOGRADOV

label: VOICE OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION OF IRAN
summary: VOICE OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION OF IRAN | EARLY MARCH 28, HOWEVER, THE GOVERNMENT-CONTROLLED VOICE OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION OF IRAN KTHE ISLAMIC HAS BEEN ADDED WITHIN THE LAST SEVERAL DAYS) CLAIMED THAT THERE WERE NO POLICE OR GENDARMERIE FACILITIES IN THE GONBAD KAVOUS AREA THAT WERE NOT UNDER GOVERNMENT CONTROL (THE CONTORTED SYNTAX OF THE STATEMENT SUGGESTED THAT THE FACILITIES IN QUESTION HAD NOT BEEN UNDER GOVERNMENT CONTROL AT SOME POINT). THE EXACT DEGREE OF SEVERITY OF THE FIGHTING IS NOT YET CLEAR (THE NUMBER OF DEATHS HAS BEEN REPORTED VARIOUSLY AS BETWEEN 7 AND 50). | THE VOICE OF THE ISLAMIC REVOLUTION OF IRAN (IRRI) ANNOUNCED THAT IN VIEW OF "THE DISARMING OF A NUMBER OF GENDARMERIE STATIONS, THE ARREST OF THE LOCAL POLICE CHIEF, THE OCCUPATION OF POLICE HEADQUARTERS AND SEVERAL GUARDPOSTS", IT HAD BEEN "DECIDED TO FILL THE VACUUM CAUSED BY THE ABSENCE OF SECURITY FORCES WITH ELEMENTS FROM THE NATIONAL ISLAMIC ARMY." HE IS INTELLIGENT, CAPABLE AND AMBITIOUS. | (C) AHUJA, 51, IS MARRIED TO THE FORMER AMEENA AHMAD, AN ANGO-INDIAN WHO WAS ONCE A RUSSIAN INTERPRETER IN MEA. THE COUPLE HAS ONE SON. IN ADDITION TO RUSSIAN AND SINDHI,HIS MOTHER TONGUE, AHUJA SPEAKS FRENCH, ENGLISH AND HINDI. GOHEEN | V K AHUJA

summary: Y K GHADIMI | POLCOUNS MET JUNE 29 WITH Y.K. GHADIMI, ONE OF THE BAHAI "NINE WISE MEN." GHADIMI RECOUNTED THE TRIALS AND TRIBULATIONS OF THE BAHAIS IN RECENT WEEKS IN ALMOST EXACTLY THE SAME TERMS AS THOSE PROVIDED BY PRYOR. INDEED, FROM CERTAIN PHRASES GHADIMI USED TO DESCRIBE THE SITUATION WE TENTATIVELY CONCLUDE THAT HE MAY HAVE BEEN ONE OF PRYOR'S SOURCES OF INFORMATION. | DEPTOFF PRECHT AND POLCOUNS MET WITH Y.K. GHADIMI, MEMBER OF THE IRANIAN BAHA'I NATIONAL COUNCIL, OCTOBER 22. TWO INTERVIEWS APPEARED IN ENGLISH AND FARSI PRESS SEPT. 18 AND SEEM TO REVEAL MUCH ABOUT ZIA THINKING AS OF SEPT. 14. PROBLEM OF EXACT COUNT IS COMPLICATED BOTH BY SELF-INTEREST IN ZOROASTRIAN ESTIMATES AND FACT THAT NUMBER OF "CLOSET" ZOROASTRIANS WOULD NEVER REGISTER THAT WAY WITH CENSUS BUREAU. | DR. BAUZARJAMEHR MEHR, MEMBER OF PARLIAMENT IN HIS CAPACITY AS REPRESENTATIVE OF THE ZOROASTRIAN COMMUNITY IN IRAN, MET WITH ICA RESOURCE CENTER DIRECTOR AND PAO DECEMBER 30, AFTER HAVING RECEIVED THEIR ASSISTANCE ON A STUDENT MATTER. IN DISCUSSING HIS OWN SITUATION AND THAT OF THE COMMUNITY HE REPRESENTS, DR. | SUMMARY: ON JUNE 20, PAO MET WITH DR. BOZORGMEHR MEHR, LEADER OF ZOROASTRIAN COMMUNIY. DR. MEHR BELIEVES THAT WHILE ZOROASTRIANS ARE NOT BEING PERSECUTED AS A MINORITY RELIGIOUS SECT, BECAUSE OF THEIR PROFESSIONAL PURSUITS, THEY ARE, ALONG WITH OTHERS OF THEIR CLASS, FACING SEVERE ECONOMIC HARDSHIP. AS A FORMER MAJLIS DEPUTY, DR. MEHR FINDS HIMSELF ESPECIALLY VICTIMIZED AND VULNERABLE. END SUMMARY. | AT THE INVITATION OF DR. MEHR, A LONG-TIME ACQUAINTANCE, JOINED HIM FOR LUNCH AT THE MEHRS' COMFORTABLE TEHRAN RESIDENCE. IN DISCUSSING THE ZOROASTRIAN LO, HE MADE THE FOLLOWING POINTS: --THERE ARE ABOUT 15,000 IN THE TEHRAN COMMUNITY. PRACTICALLY ALL ARE ENGAGED IN COMMERCE, BUYING AND SELLING PROPERTY, PRIVATE ENTREPRENEURSHIP. THE ECONOMIC SLOWDOWN HAS, OF COURSE, SEVERELY AFFECTED THESE PEOPLE, MOST OF WHOM ARE SEEKING WAYS TO LEAVE THE COUNTRY. --THE THREE ZONE OASTRIAN TEMPLES IN TEHRAN HAVE NOT BEEN DISTURBED AND SERVICES ARE CONTINUING WITH NORMAL TURNOUTS. THE COMMUNITY OPERATES SIX PRIVATE SCHOOLS IN THE CITY FROM PRIMARY THROUGH SECONDARY. | OF THE APPROXIMATELY 3,000 STUDENT ENROLLMENT, 95 PERCENT ARE NON-ZOROASTRIANS, MAINLY ARMENIAN CHRISTIANS AND SOME MUSLIMS. THREE MONTHS AGO, THE MINISTRY OF EDUCATION THREATENED TO CLOSE THESE SCHOOLS ALONG WITH OTHER PRIVATE EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTIONS. SINCE THAT TIME, NOTHING FURTHER HAS BEEN HEARD AND DR. MEHR BELIEVES OPERATIONS WILL CONTINUE. AT THE PRIMARY LEVEL, BOYS AND GIRLS ATTEND CLASSES TOGETHER, BUT NOT IN SECONDARY SCHOOL. --THE MOST TROUBLING INTRUSIONS IN THE LIFE OF THE COMMUNITY DO NOT COME FROM MUSLIMS, ACCORDING TO DR. MEHR, BUT FROM DISAFFECTED ZOROASTRIAN YOUTH WHO HAVE RETURNED FROM THE U.S. | ZOROASTRIAN COMMUNITY
